tei:titleStmt.tei:title: pod 1 byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa la 'jug pa'i sgrung 'grel dang gtam rgyud

tei:publicationStmt.tei:distributor: This OCR'd text was generated using UCB's Namsel-OCR application on Jul 23, 2014 at the request of the Tibetan Buddhist Resource Center. Please note this document has not been finalized and is subject to additional changes and corrections.

tei:div.tei:p: mkhyen brtse'i 'od snang gi dpe tshogasabasdu sgriskalas mi'i mtshan tho/spyi khyaspubasdu sgrig 'gan khur bgatsu bo/ gzan dkar thub bstan nyi ma dang /'gro 'dul rdo rje/ bsdu sgrig 'gan khur ba gzhon pa dang / gtso sgrigaya/ kurma bde legs/gtso sgrig gzhon pa/ bstan 'dzin blo gros/ thub bstan nyi ma/ bsdu sgrig pa/ thub bstan 'od zer/ zla ba bstan 'dzin/ dpyid sadapal bzang / dkon mchog bsam gtan/shes rab bzang po/zhu dog pa/ bstan 'dzin blo gros/ thuspubastan nyi ma/ rkarma bde legs/ dku+on mchag bsam gtan/rgyab shog bzo skrun jusa'agod pa/ 'gro 'dul rdo rje dang / lag rtsal pa/ ye shes chosamatsho/par sgrig lag rtsal pa/ ye shes chos mtsho/ byamasapa chos sgron/ bstan 'dzin/bsod nams tshe sgron sogs dpal brtsegs slogaklad lasabyed pa rnams/

dpe skrun gsal bshad/rang re'i mes po mkhas dbang dam pa rim byon gyi rnam dpyod lto ba yangs pa'i rtsal las rab tu 'brungs pa'i gtsug lag ni nam mkha'i mtha' ltar mnyam la ri rab lhun po'i dpangs las mtho ba/ rgya mtsho chen po'i 'jings bzhin zab pa bcas 'dzam gling skye 'gro kun gyi mthong chos su gyur cing / de dag ni rang rigs kyi rin thang gzhal du med pa'i yid bzhin gyi nor bu rin po che yin la/ mes rgyal shes rig bang mdzod nang gi gzi sbyin 'od snang 'phro ba'i gces nor yin pa ma zad/ 'dzam gling shes rig bang mdzod chen mo'i khrod kyi ngo mtshar bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i mchog nor yang yin/ 'on kyang de dag mi lo brgya phrag stong phrag nang mi dang rang byung gis 'tshe bas rkyen pas nyams brlag tu phyin dang 'gro la khad du thug cing / de dag gi nang don kha cig yul dang dus kyis bskal bas shin tu rtogs dka' bar gyur te/ dus phyis zhib 'jug dpyad gzhi bya rgyur 'gog rkyen 'phrad kyi yod/ bod du bcings 'grol btang rjes dang lhag par du tang gi skabs bcu gcig pa'i krung u tshang 'dzoms gros tshogs thengs gsum pa tshun/ tang dang rgyal khab nas mi shugs dang rgyu stobs kyi mthun rkyen bzang po sbyar te shul du lus pa'i gtsug lag mang dag cig myur skyob dang /'tshol bsdu/ legs sgrig /par skrun bcas mdzad de grub 'bras mi dman pa thob dang 'thob bzhin pa lags/ 'on— sang bya ba 'di ni rgya che zhing zhib tshags

dpe skrun gsal bshad/pa dang / gting dpog dka' ba'i las gzhi rlabs po che zhig yin gshis/mdun skyod kyi lam bu kyag kyog kyang kyong dang / tha na tsher ma'i tshang tshing gis yongs su gtums pa'ang 'byung srid pas rang re'i srid gzhung dang / 'brel yod sde tshan/ mnyam sdeb/ spyi dmangs mi sger bcas kyis mnyam las phyar ba gru 'degs dang / blo rtse zong kha gcig sgril/ thabs shes yod dgu rtsal sprug bcas kyis rang ngos nas 'go brtsams pa dang bya ba'i sne mo re re bzhin snying rus chen pos rgyun bskyangs nas bsgrubs tshe/ dka' tshegs mtha' dag las rnam par rgyal te byas rjes drud shul thon pa zhig yong thub snyam/ da phan mi lo bcu grangs nang dpal brtsegs bod yig dpe rnying zhib 'jug khang gis rnam par dag pa'i lhag bsam dang ngal ba khur bzod kyi snying stobs la brten nas 'bad 'bungs lhur len gyis bod kyi sa gnas grong khyer dang / rdzong dang shang /tha na mtha' 'khob lung khug gi grong tsho dang 'brog dgon sogs gang sar phebs nas de khul du shin tu nyag phra zhing thar thor du lus pa'i dpe rnying dpe dkon mang dag cig myur skyob 'tshol bsdu dang / legs sgrig dpe skrun mdzad pa kun gyis mig mthong lag zin byung bas snying khams dbus nas dad gus dang rjes su yi rang zhu rgyu yin/ bod mi rigs kyi phul du byung ba'i srol rgyun rig gnas shul bzhag 'tshol bsdu dang / legs sgrig /dpe skrun bcas byas te deng gi spyi tshogs la zhabs 'degs dang / phyi rabs rgyud bcas rnams la skyes su 'bul rgyu'i dmigs yul dang / dgos pa/ phan rlabs bcas la blo kha gcig mthun thog da lam dpal brtsegs bod yig dpe rnying zhib 'jug khang dang /—2—

dpe skrun gsal bshad/'di ga bod ljongs mi dmangs dpe skrun khang gnyis zhib 'jug gros mol thengs mang byas mthar/ khong rnam pas 'tshol bsdu legs sgrig mdzad pa'i gsung rab dpe rnying dpe dkon gal chen khag nged dpe skrun khang gis rim bzhin dpe skrun bya gtan khel ba bzhin/ da lan mkhyen brtse'i 'od snang zhes pa'i dpe tshogs 〈khongs kyi byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa la 'jug pa'i sgrung 'grel las 'bras gsal ba'i me long zhes bya ba dang / spyod 'jug gi gtam rgyud 〉gnyis deb gnyis par brtsis nas dpe skrun zhus pa yin zhing / dpe deb 'di'i dpe sgrig dang zhu dag thad zhib tshags nan tur byas khul lags kyang da dung skyon cha mi nyung ba zhig yod srid stabs/ mkhyen dpyod yangs pa'i gzigs pa po rnams kyis nor bcos kyi dgongs 'char lhug stsol yod pa mkhyen/ mkhyen/mkhyen/bod ljongs mi dmangs dpe skrun khang nas sgrig pa pos/

sngon 'gro'i zhu tshigade yang 'gro ba lha dang bcas pa'i ma 'dris pa'i mdza' bshes/ phan bde'i rtsa lag tu gyur pa/ bdag cag gi ston pa mnyam med thub pa'i dbang pos gdul bya'i khams dbang mos pa dang 'tshams shing / thar 'dod skye bo yongs kyi 'jug ngogs dam par gyur pa'i/ chos kyi phung po ji snyed cig gsungs pa yang lta ba rten 'byung dang / spyod pa 'tshe ba med pa'i ring lugs dri ma med pa 'di nyid yin la/ de yang gtad rabs bdun dang / shing rta chen po gnyis la sogs pa las/ rim par 'dzam gling gi tha gru kun tu khyab pa las/ rang cag gangs can par mtshon na/ mkhyen brtse'i bdag nyid chen po mes po bka' drin can rnams kyi 'phrin las kyi 'od snang / phyi rabs 'gro ba'i lam ston sgron me lta bu'i bstan bcos sa chen po'i rdul ltar/ grangs tsam yang bsgrangs par dka' ba ji snyed cig bzhugs pa las/ deng dus spyi tshogs la dgos gal che ba khag cig mkho btus kyis/ phyogs gcig tu bsgrigs pa mkhyen brtse'i 'od snang zhes pa'i dpe tshogs 'di nyid/ bod ljongs mi dmangs dpe skrun khang dang / nga tsho'i dpal brtsegs bod yig dpe rnying zhib 'jug khang gnyis mnyam las kyis rgya che'i klog pa po rnams kyi spyan lam du rim pa bstar chags su 'bul rgyu yin/de yang da lta'i char phyi dngos po'i 'phel 'gyur dang / nang bsam pa'i shes tshad cha mi snyoms pa'i dus radisna kyi skyogs mtshams 'dir / smra shes

sngon 'gro'i zhu tshigashing don go ba 'gro ba mi'i rigs spyi dang / khyad par du spyi tshogs la 'gan khur gyi bsam blo ldan pa'i shes yon can rnams kyis/ bsam blo gu yangs dang /mig rgyang ring po'i sgo nas bsam blo'i langs phyogs ma nor bar legs nyes kyi gnas la bsam gzhig dang / spyi tshogs la rang nus kyis 'gan khur dang zhabs zhu gang 'grub byas nas/ 'cham mthun brtan brling dang shes dpal ldan pa'i 'khor yug cig 'dzugs skrun byed pa ni/ rang cag skye bo kun gyi phrag thog tu bab pa'i 'os 'gan zhig yin snyam/de yang nged zhib 'jug khang gi lo ngo bcu phrag lhag tsam gyi ring / gzan dkar mchog sprul thub bstan nyi ma'i bka' slob dang mdzub ston 'og /mdo dbus khams gsum gyi sa gnas so sor dngos su bskyod cing / dpe rnying dpe dkon rnams srung skyob dang / 'tshol bsdu/ nyams gso sogs kyi las ka'i brgyud rim nang / gal che'i dpe dkon mang po zhig rnyed son byung ba rnams/bka' gdams gsung 'bum phyogs bsgrig dang / bka' gdams gsung 'bum gces btus/ mes po'i shul bzhag /phyag bris gces btus/ shes bya'i gter bum/ mkhan slob chos gsum sogs kyi dpe tshogs rnams so sor bsdu bsgrigs dang par bskrun zhus dang zhu bzhin pa las/ da lam mkhyen brtse'i 'od snang zhes pa'i dpe tshogs 'di yang / ji skad du/ 'jug pa las/ snying rje'i sems dang gnyis su med blo dang / /byang chub sems ni rgyal sras rnams kyi rgyu/ /zhes pa ltar/ bdag cag gi ston pas chos kyi rnam grangs ji snyed cig gsung pa'i snying po/ mkhyen dang brtse ba'i rang bzhin de nyid thos bsam sgom —2—

sngon 'gro'i zhu tshigapa'i shes rab kyis rang rgyud la skye dgos pa yin la/ de lta bu'i thos bsam bya yul gyi gzhung lugs ni/ 'chos skyob yon tan gnyis ldan gyi bka' dang /bstan bcos rnam dag la rag las pas/ 'dir yang brjod bya gtso bo deng dus kyi spyi tshogs la dgos gal che zhing bsam blo'i slob gso la med du mi rung ba byang chub sems kyi bslab bya dang 'brel ba'i zab chos du ma dang / dpe rnying dpe dkon gyi rin thang ldan pa/ yig tshogs nyung zhing blta bde ba/ grub mtha' phyogs su ma lhung ba/ spyi tshogs dza drag dang rnyog 'dzing sogs kyis yid sems nyams nyes su gyur tshe/ blta klog byas na blo rnal du dbab pa sogs dmigs bsal gyi dgos pa dang / rin thang ldan pa'i dpe tshogs zhig lags pas/ rgya che'i mkhyen dpyod dang ldan pa rnams kyis dgyes gzigs gnang ste/ nang bsam blo'i shes yon gyi 'phel phyogs yang phyi dngos po'i 'phel rgyas dang do mnyam pa'i/ shes 'byor gnyis ldan gyi spyi tshogs bzang po zhig phyogs dang tha gru kun tu yong thub pa'i re smon yang yang zhu ba lags/'di yang mkhyen dpyod lhag bsam zla dang bral ba'i mkhas dbang gzan dkar mchog sprul thub bstan nyi ma'i bka' yis bskul ma gnang bar ji mi snyam du 'dor ma phod par cung zad tsam du smras pa'o/ /dpal brtsegs bod yig dpe rnying zhib 'jug khang nas 'gro 'dul rdo rjes/ 2008lo'i zla 8 tshes 5 nyin phul/

bsdu sgrig gsal bshad/chos 'di gang las 'byung ba'i khungs ni/ slob dpon chen po zhi ba lhas mdzad pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa la 'jug pa zhes bya ba yin/ bstan bcos chen po 'di ni mgo nas mjug bar tshigs bcad yin la go bde zhing blo la 'dzin bde ba zhig yod/ nang don ni theg pa chen po'i byang chub sems sbyong gi man ngag gtso bor ston pa zhig yin/ 'di la le'u bcu yod cing thog mar rgyal po khri lde srong btsan gyi dus su lo tsā ba sarba dz+nya de ba dang / bod kyi lo tsā ba ska ba dpal brtsegs kyis bod skad du bsgyur ba las snga phyir 'gyur bcos thengs gnyis byas pa/ bstan 'gyur snar thang par ma'i mdo phyogs le tshan (pa)pa'i nang yod cing / de'i 'grel pa la rgya gar gyi paṇ+ḍi ta mang pos mdzad pa'i nang nas khag bcu tsam gong gsal bstan 'gyur snar thang par ma'i mdo phyogs le tshan (sha)pa'i nang yod la/ bod du yang grub mtha' ris med kyi mkhas pa mang pos rgyas bsdus sna tshogs mdzad yod pa las/ 'dir byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa la 'jug pa'i sgrung 'grel las 'bras gsal ba'i me long zhes bya ba dang/ byang chub sems pa'i spyod pa la 'jug pa'i gtam rgyud ces tshan pa gnyis po 'di'i rtsom pa po mi gsal yang rgyal sras zhi ba lhas mdzad pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa la 'jug pa'i dgongs pa legs par rtogs pa —1—

bsdu sgrig gsal bshad/la med mi rung ba'i khyad chos dang ldan pa'i phyir te/ dang po chub sems dpa'i spyod pa la 'jug pa'i sgrung 'grel las 'bras gsal ba'i me long zhes bya ba 'di la le'u bcu las/ bstan tshul ni dang po sdom gyi sgo nas tshigs bcad kyi mdor bstan zhing de nyid tshigs lhug gis rgyas par bshad pa le'u bcu char la khyad par med cing / nang don ni/ gzhung las dngos shugs ci rigs las bstan pa'i gtam rgyud ngo mtshar ba dag gsal bshad byas nas gzhung don la go ba gting tshugs pa lon pa la phan nus shin tu che ste/ gzhung gi brjod don dang mthun par gtam rgyud rna bar snyan pa/ yid la 'jags bde zhing dbang po rno rtul gang yin yang go bde ba'i khyad chos dang ldan yod/ gzhung 'di'i mjug tu dge ba'i bshes gnyen dam pa/ yon tan dbang phyug gis bsam pa bzang ba'i sgo nas bzhengs pa lags zhes pa tsam las mdzad byang mi gsal/gnyis pa byang chub sems pa'i sbyod pa la 'jug pa'i gtam rgyud ces pa 'di yang gong gi byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa la 'jug pa'i sgrung 'grel las 'bras gsal ba'i me long zhes bya ba dang sdom tshig dang gtam rgyud rgyas bsdus ci rigs snang yang rtsa ba'i cha nas nang don dang 'grel tshul 'dra bar snang ngo / /gzhung 'di gnyis kyi ma dpe lag bris yin par brten bshu 'bri byed skabs yig nor ha cang mang ba rang sor bzhag ste mtshams der dag bcos byas pa'i yig 'bru gug rtags nang 'god rgyu yang dpe deb lta klog mi bde khar/rnam pa mi mdzes pa ma zad yig nor de rnams ma dpe bshu 'bri byed mkhan gyi gnad don las rtsom pa pos de ltar bris par ngos 'dzin mi rung bas ma dag —2—

bsdu sgrig gsal bshad/rgyun 'byams mi 'gro ba'i slad du brda dag gi gzhung dang mthun par yig nor rnams dag bcos zhus pa yin/ gzhung 'di gnyis kyi nang skung yig ches mang po 'dug pa rang sor bzhag ste dpe skrun zhu rgyu yang klog pa po mang po zhig la mtshon na cha tshang ji bzhin klog mi thub la go don de bas lon dka' bar brten/ klog pa po rgya khyab kyis lta klog bde ba'i phyir skung yig bkral yod/mjug byang du byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa la 'jug pa'i skabs su mkhas pa'i gtam/ mdo'i khungs brgya pa rdzogs so zhes pa tsam las mdzad pa po mi gsal/ mchan zhig las/ legs pa don grub ni yi ge bstsal rigs su gda'o zhes bkod 'dug /spyod 'jug gtam rgyud gnyis po 'di'i ma dpe 'bras spungs gnas bcu lha khang du bzhugs su gsol ba las g.yar po zhus te ma nyams gong 'phel dang nyams pa sor chud yong ba'i ched nged dpe tshogs nas mkhyen brtse'i 'od snang zhes pa'i dpe tshogs kyi 〈deb gnyis par 〉 btang nas par skrun zhus pa yin/dpal brtsegs bod yig dpe rnying zhib 'jug khang gi bstan 'dzin blo gros pas/

dkar chagabyang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa la 'jug pa'i sgrung 'grel las 'bras gsal ba'i me long zhes bya ba'i bzhugs/ 1dang po/ klad kyi don bshad pa/ 1gnyis pa/ gzhung gi don bshad pa/ 1ka1 le'u dang po'i skabs kyi gtam rgyud/ ༷ ༷ 1ka2 le'u gnyis pa'i skabs kyi gtam rgyud/ 21ka3 le'u gsum pa'i skabs kyi gtam rgyud/ 46ka4 le'u bzhi pa'i skabs kyi gtam rgyud/ 52ka5 le'u lnga pa'i skabs kyi gtam rgyud/ 53ka6 le'u drug pa'i skabs kyi gtam rgyud/ ༷ 69ka7 le'u bdun pa'i skabs kyi gtam rgyud/ 85ka8 le'u brgyad pa'i skabs kyi gtam rgyud/ 92ka9 le'u dgu pa'i skabs kyi gtam rgyud/ 117ka10 le'u bcu pa'i skabs kyi gtam rgyud/ 1301
gsum pa/ mjug gi don bshad pa/ ༷133༈ byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa la 'jug pa'i gtam rgyud bzhugs/ 134

༄7/ /byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa la 'jug pa'i sgrung 'grel las 'bras gsal ba'i me long zhes bya ba bsdokyigs sa/ /dang po/ klad kyi don bshad pa/༄༅/ /osu sti sidhe/ byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa la 'jug pa'i sgrung 'grel las 'bras gsal ba'i me long zhes bya ba/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /thub dbang zhabs rdul mgos mchod nas/ smyu+od phyogs gling bzhi bshad do zhes/ de gsung smṛ ti'i lugs bzhin bri/ tage bsam yid bzhin 'grub gyur cig /de'ang le'u bcu las le'u dang po'i sdomani/ bumoklu sgrubaded dpon dang / /rgyalaponor bzang mdza' bo'i bu/ /tshangasapa legasaskyesakhron pa'i mi/ /dge slong dga' byed phra'u dang //byams pa'i stobs dang bcu gsum mo/ /gnyis pa/ gzhung gi don bshad pa/ka1 le'u dang po'i skabs kyi gtam rgyud bshad pa/phyag 'os kun la'ang gus par phyag 'tshal te/ zhes pa'i skabs su/ byang sems kyis/ nyan rang la sogs yul dman pa la phyag bya ba ma yin te/dper na rgyal po ma skyes dgras gnasda 1sdartan 'od srung sogs nyan/ thos rnams

mkhyen brtse'i 'od snang las/ spyod 'jug sgrung 'grel/pho brang du gdugs tshod la gdan drangs pa na/ rgyal po'i sras mo lo bcu drug lon pa mdzes sdug gcig yod pa khri lasami ldang ba la/ rgyal pos/ 'phags pa 'di 'dra ba byon dus phyag sogs mi byed pa khyod ni dman pa'i gnas so zhes smrasapas/ bu mo na re/ yab rang yang smad pa'i gnasaso zer ro/ /de ci drisapas/ /'khor lo sgyur rgyal mtshan dang rab ldan pas/ /phal pa rnamasal phyag sogasami byed ltar/ /rgyal po'i srasamo mtshan dang rab ldan pas/ /phal pa rnams la phyag sogs mi byed ltar/ /rgyal ba'i sras po mtshan dang rab ldan pas/ /nyan rang rnamasal phyag byed ga ldo'agyur/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ byang sems dang / 'khor lo sgyur bas yab de nyid kyi gdung 'tshob nus pa'i phyir ro//kho mo yang byang sems yin pas nyan rang la phyag mi 'tshal zhes zer ro/ /gser 'gyur rtsi yi rnam pa mchog lta bu/ /bhe ta'i yul grong khyer dzhai tar bram ze rnal 'byor rgyal ba'i lha'i chen ma blo ldan ma la bu blo gros 'phags btsas te/mtshan mkhan la bstan pas/ tshe ring na ston pa gnyis pa gcig ste/ tshe zhag bdun las med zer ba la/ klus shis pa brjod pas lo bdun du gyur/ yang rma bya chen mo bsgrubs pas lo bco lngar gyur pa'i tshe/ chun ma gzugs ldan ma'i bram ze mnyes par byas te/ bdag gi bu bsod nams 'phags la sman gyi mnga' thang gnang bar zhu byas pas/ thub chod du sbyin du mi rung bas thabs kyis sbyin no/ /zhes de la gso rigs kyi man ngag thams cad yongs rdzogs su bslabs tshar ba dang / blo gros 'phags pa dang rgan pas zhag gsum na khyed gnyis su mkhas pa zhig la mnga' thang thams cad gtod do slobs shig zer ro//—2—

spyod 'jug sgrung 'grel lasa'abrasagasal ba'i me long zhesabya ba bzhugs/der yum ngo gnag pa'i rgyu drisapas/ gong ltar bsnyad/ khyod bu thu bo yin yang srid mi thob pa la ma dga' zer/ mi dgyes mi 'tshal gyis mar me sta gon mdzod cig zer nas/ nub dang po la yab kyi bzhed pa gcig /gnyisapa la yab kyi nor ba/ gsum pa la yin lugs bzhin rtogs nas/ nyin gsum rim bzhin bshad pas/ nu bos ye ma spobasapa/ yum gnyis ngo log pa'i tshe/ phu bos yab yum mi dgyes mi 'tshal gyis srid kho la gtod la/ bdag rab tu 'byung bar zhus pas dgyes te gnang nas/ na len+d+rar sgra gcan 'dzin bzang po la rab tu byung ste/ gnas lnga thams cad lan re gzigs pa'am gsan pas mkhyen kyang / bco lnga'i lo grangs tshang nas/ dpal gyi rir mya ngan gyi gling du 'grengasapas/ sar has dris pa na/ zhag bdun lasatshe med zer bas ngas rkang mgyogs kyi dngos grub sbyin gyis/ rtse lngar 'jam dpal la zhus la/ 'chi med sgron ma la gsol ba thob gsungs pa bzhin mdzad pas/ zhag lnga na mthong lam gyi yon tan brgya phrag bcu gnyis mngon du gyur te/ tshe'i dngos grub brnyes nas 'dzam bu gling du byon pas mu ge chen po 'dug nas/ de bskyab pa'i phyir dbyu gu ma mched gsum bsgrubs pas/ mnal lam du zangs gling du song la / gser 'gyur slobs gsung rmis nas/ sang ri sul zhig tu sku khams seng du byon pa'i tshe/ sbrul nag cig gis sbrul dkar cig ded de/ drung du slebs pa dang / shing lo zhig sbor bskus pas 'phur/ me tog cig mgor bskus pas babs pa/ yang ded pas 'bras bu zhig khar bcug pas mi snang bar song ste/slob dpon gyis kyang de gsum grar btums te shing los 'phur/ me tog gi —3—

mkhyen brtse'i 'od snang las/ spyod 'jug sgrung 'grel/zangs gling du babs te/ gser byin la slobs byas pas 'phel du dwogs nas ma byin/ 'dir thon pa ci yin zer/ shing lo 'di'i mthu byas pas/ de ster na bslab zer/ byin te lobs pa dang gra gseb kyi shing los 'phur ba ded pa zin khar 'bras bus bsgribs nas/ me tog gis babs te/ bu mo gtsang ma'i gser khrag btang zhes pa la/ de'i lag nas byung ba'i g.ya' bskrus pa btango yang ma grub par/ mkha' 'gra ma la gsal ba btab pas bza gnas su bu ma rlung gis sngangs te 'goms pas gser mdung snad pa'i khrag lugs phor du lhung ste/ rtsi grub nas/ dngos po gang la des reg tshad gser du 'gyur te/ phyis dpe de bzhin du/ byang sems skyes tshad sangs rgyas su 'gyur bar dgongs nas/sa ra has/ dngos grub mchog gi rdzas gcig gis/ /dngos gang gser du gyur pa ltar/ /byang chub mchog gis semasagazhig gis/ /lus can rgyal ba'i skur 'gyur ro/ /zhesaso/ /'gro ba'i ded dpon gcig pu tshad med blos/ /ded dpon legs sgrol zhes pas gzings chen tshong pa mang po dang bcas te rgya mtshor phyin pas/ rlung gi drod tshad ma zin par mtsho'i gur du chad do/ /de na sngar yang tshong pa mang po shi ba'i rus pa mang po 'dug nas/ rab tu mi dga' zhing smre sngags mang po ston nas ngu ba la/ ded dpon gyis nyin par tshong pa rnams kyi sems gso ba'i phyir thabs yod do/ /zhes smras shing / mtshan mo ni de'i thabs kho na la rtog pa'i tshe/ skabs der de na shing ring po gcig la/ bya kha cig chags 'dug pas/ tshong dpon gyis bya skad shes te nyan pas/ sngar med pa'i bya mgron po gnyis ni shin tu tshon/ gzhi bya rnams ni rid pa la/ gzhi bya na —4—

spyod 'jug sgrung 'grel las 'bras gsal ba'i me long zhes bya ba bzhugs/re/ mgron po khyed tsho ba ji ltar yin zer/ mgron po na re/ nged ni rgyal po bsod nams can gyi 'bras chan la sogs pa'i lhag ma za'o zer/ mgron po na re/ gzhi bya khyed rid pa ci nyes zer/ nged ni rde'u dkar nag las zar med do zer/ der tshong dpon gyis rgyal po de la nged tshong pa 'di tsam zhig mtsho gur 'di lta bur chud pas/ khyed la thabs yod na 'don dgos zer ba'i yi ge mgron bya'i sker mtshan mo ma tshor bar btags pa rgyal pos mthong nas rnga gdungs te tshong pa 'di lta bu 'don nus pa byung na rgyal srid phyed sbyin no/ /zhes bsgrags pas/ bram ze rdzu 'phrul can zhig na re/ rgyal srid tsam mi 'dod yul gru drug 'dod pas ngas 'don zer bas rgya mtsho'i steng na phar rdzu 'phrul gyis phyin pas/ tshong pa kun srin po sogs byung snyam nas skrag pa la/ tshong dpon de na re/ ngas bya la than btang yod pas/ 'u cag 'don pa yin srid kyis/ ma 'jigs shig smras pas/ gam du slebs pa dang / 'don mkhan yin te/ khyed rnams las gang rung gakhrig lus pas gzhan thams cad thon par bya'o/ /zer bas/ ded dpon gyis sdod par byas khas blangs so/ /der bram ze na re/'dir sdod pa des brag khung 'di ni gser gyi rnga gcig yod pa rdungs shig zer ba bzhin brdungs pas/ de na bya mang po yod pa kun 'grogs pa'i rlung shugs kyis gzings skyod nas thon zhing / rjes su tshong dpon yang thon no/ /sdig pa shin tu mi bzad byas na yang / grong khyer nyer ldan zhes bya bar/yab rgyal po dri med sgra dang / yum btsun mo dge ldan ma gnyis/ shin tu sras kyis 'phongs pa la/ rgyal pos phyogasda spya'i drang srong mngon shes can zhig yod

mkhyen brtse'i 'od snang las/ spyod 'jug sgrung 'grel/pa la drisapa/ bdag la ye nas bu'i skal ba med dam/ 'on te rkyen gyisabatsas ma btub pa ci lags zhusapas/ drang srong na re/ rgyal po chen po khyed kyi bu skal ni sa phyogs 'di na bram ze bsam gtan byed pa zhig yod de/ de tshe'i dus byas nas rgyal po'i sras su skye'o zhes smras pa dang / rgyal po 'dod pa can sras rings pa'i dbang gis/ bram ze dus ma yin par 'tsho ba dang phral btang bas rgyal po'i sras su skye bar ma btub par skye ba gzhan blangs so/ /yang rgyal pos drang srong la smras pa/ bram ze tshe'i dus byas kyang / bdag gi sras su skyer ma btub pa ci zhus pas/ drang srong gis smras pa/ dus ma yin par srog dang phral bas lan gyis/ da lcags ri me 'bar ba'i kha na ri bong dmar skya rna ba g.yon pa gtum pa zhig skyes te/ de tshe 'phos ma thag rgyal po'i sras su skye'o zhes smras pas/ yang rgyal pos yul khams kyi mi mang po bzlog nas bshor bas/ ri bong dmar skya rna ba g.yon pa gtum pa zhig byung ba bsad do/ /ri bong des yid la smod pa bor ba/ nga lung stong du su la mi gnod pa'i rtswaza/ chu 'thung ba la rgyal po 'dis mi mang po bsdus nas bdag bsad pas/ nga tshe 'phos nas/ rgyal po khyed kyi gshed ma byed par gyur cig cesaso/ /de tshe 'phos ma thag yum dge ldan ma'i mngal du zhugs te/ mngal na gnas tsam na/sha kho na 'dod pa la/ sha gzhan ni ma phan/ yab kyi khrag cig btar nas btang bas so/ /der lo dus su bltams pa'i ming ni rgyal bu nor bu 'dzin zhes bya bar btags so/ /rgyal bu de ma ma du masabaskyangs te skyed bsrings nas/ skabasaskabs la rgyal po'i spyan sngar phyag 'tshal du 'ongasapa las/ rgyal —6—

spyod 'jug sgrung 'grel las 'bras gsal ba'i me long zhesabya ba bzhugs/po'i 'byor pa chen po de rnams mthong ste/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen gcig la dris pa/ yab kyi phun sum tshogs pa 'di rnams bdag gis nam 'thob/ rgyal po nam 'das pa'i tshe 'thob par 'gyur ro zhes smras pas/ rgyal bu chags shing brkam pas/ yab la mtshon bsnun pas/ yum gyis nga la ma skyes pa'i dgra zhig skyes so byas pas/ ma skyes dgrar gragasaso/ /de'i rkyen gyisayum grongs/dgra bcom ma ut+pa la'i mdog nyes med du bsad/ de bzhin gshegs pa bkrongs 'dod kyi khrag phyung / dge 'dun phyesate/ mtshams med lnga ka'ang byas par grags so/ /blon po rnams kyi rgyal bu spyi gtol can 'di la rgyal srid byin rgyu min na'ang / da sras 'theb mi gnang bas byin zer nasabyin no/ /dusazhig na rgyal po de ri dwags bshor du phyin pas/ nags na drang srong zhig dang phrad nas smras pa/ 'di lta bu'i sdug bsngal gyis khyod la ci zhig bya zhes dris pas/ drang srong gis smrasapa/ rgyal po chen po bdag dkon mchog gsum la brten nas 'bras bu bla na med pa'i byang chub 'tshol ba'i dka' thub kyi sdug bsngal 'di lta bu ni bzod kyis/ khyod tshe 'di'i 'dod pa tsam gyi phyir pha ma sogs bsad nas mnar med pa'i dmyal bar 'gro ba 'di ni bdag gis mi bzod kyis/ zhes smras pa dang / drang srong chen po lha dkon mchog gsum bya ba ci yin/ sdig pa pha ma bsad pa sogasacir 'gyur/ de dag spangs pasa'abras bu ci 'thob dris pas/ drang srong gis las rgyu 'bras kyi chos mang du bshad pas/shin tu 'gyod kyang mthong chos su 'bras bu me dbal gyis btab ste/ lus kyi mdog dbyibs thams cad mi sdug par gyur/ rnag gi dri mas sa'i phyogs —7—

mkhyen brtse'i 'od snang las/ spyod 'jug sgrung 'grel/thams cad gang / dngos su lus sems dmyal ba ltar sdug bsngal ba'i tshe/nam mkha' la da ste zhag bdun na sa'i bar bye ste lus 'di nyid kyis mnar med du 'gro'o zhes thos pas/ sdug bsngal chen pos skrag nas ston pa drug la sdig bshags thams cad dris pas ma shes pa na/ bu 'tsho byed na re sangs rgyas kyi sar phyin na 'di las thar nges zer/ sangs rgyas dag pa/ dgra bcom dag pas bskor ba'i drung du/ bdag dmyal ba'i lus kyis ji ltar 'gro bar nus zer/ sangs rgyas ni shā ri'i bu dang lam chung la'ang chos mtshungs par ston/gsal rgyal dang dbul po yin mnyam du sbyong / sgra gcan 'dzin dang lha byin la'ang thugs mnyam par gnas na ji ltar mi 'gro zer/ 'o na bden pa mthong na ngan 'gror mi 'gro bar gsungs pas/ 'u gnyis glang chen zhig la bzhon la nga lhung na zungs shig zer te phyin nas/ mtha' gcig na yod pa la lan gnyis 'bod kyang nga min snyam pa'i tshe/ gsum pa la rgyal chen ma skyes dgra zhes gsungs pas dga' ches nas lan de'u re ma thebs pa la/ khyod kyis mtshams med pa byasasam/ btsun pa med lagasaso/ de dag gshogasashig /bdag dang sems can thams cad kyi sdig pa so sor bshags shing slar yang mi bgyid do/ /zhes pas/ rgyal rigs bzang po rang sdig tu ma zad thamasacad kyi bshags pa legs so/ /zhes sdig pa kun dag nasabazod pa thob bo/ ter 'jam dpal la 'di'i 'gyod pa sol cig ces pas/ 'jam dpal gyis mtshams med lnga byas pa bden lags sam byas pas/ blo gros chen po mad lagasaso/ /gang gisabyasasemasakyisabaslang nas lusakyisaso/ /slong mkhan —8—

spyod 'jug sgrung 'grel las 'bras gsal ba'i me long zhes bya ba bzhugs/de phyi nang gang na/ mdog dbyibs ci 'dra zhes brtags pas/ chos thams cad rang bzhin med par mkhyen nas 'khrul ngo'i sdig 'bras thams cad bdag la smin la/ de dag thams cad kyis byang chub thob par gyur cig snyam pa dang /'bor 'das kyi de nyid mngon du gyur nas sa drug gi rtogs pa 'khrungs pa dang /nam mkhar/ ma skyes dgras ni mtshams med sdig byas pa'ang / /sems gcig gis ni rnal 'byor grol la ltos/ zhes so/ /byams mgon blo dang ldan pas nor bzang bshad/ ldong po bkod pa'i mdor/ grong khyer skyid pa'i 'byung gnas su/ khong dpon nor rten gyi bu nor bzang gis 'jam dpal la sems bskyed de/ bslab bya bstsal ba'i phyir mthar gyis byams pa'i drung du song ba dang / de lho phyogs rgya mtsho'i 'gram khang pa brtsegs pa rnam par snang mdzad rgyan gyis brgyan pa'i snying po zhes pa'i phyogs gcig na 'khor rgya mtsho lta bu'i dbus na chos ston pa rgyang ring po nas mthong nas/ khye'u de yang / dga' ba dang gus pa bskyed de lus thams cad kyis phab ste phyag 'tshal lo/ /'phags pa byams pas kyang phyag g.yas pa glang po che'i sna ltar brkyangs nas gzhon nu de 'khor kun la ngoms pa'i tshul du bstan nas smras pa / ltos shig bsam pa yongs su dag pa 'di/ /nor bzang nor rnams rab tu brtan pa'i bu/ /byang chub spyod pa dam pa yongs 'tshol zhing / /mkhas pa nga yi drung du legs par 'ongs/ /legasapar 'ongs sam snying rje'i byang chub khyod/ /byams pa'i dkyil 'khor yangs par legs 'ongs sam/ /legs par 'ongs sam lta na rab zhi ba/ /spyad pa spyod sdo 9sdob pa ma gyur tam/ /rnam dag bsam

mkhyen brtse'i 'od snang las/ spyod 'jug sgrung 'grel/ldan tshur shog 'ongs pa legs/ /skye med yid ldan tshur shog 'ongs pa legs//dbang po ma zhum tshur shog 'ongasapa legs/ /spyad pa spyod tshe dub pa med grang ngo / /zhes sogs yon tan gyi bsngagasapa brjod pa tshigs su bcad pa mang po gsungs pa dang / nor bzang giso byams pa'i g.yas phyogs nas bskor ba lan gsum byas/ mdun du thal ma sbyar nasasmrasapa/ 'phagasapa/ bdag bla na med pa'i byang chub tu zhugs na/ de'i bslab pa la ji ltar bslab par bgyi ba dang / ji ltar nan tan du bgyi ba ma 'tshal bas bstan du gsol zhes zhus pa'i lan du/ rigs kyi bu khyod ni dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyis yongs su bzung ba'o/de ci'i phyir zhe na/ rigasakyi ga byangachubakyi semasani/ sangasargyasakyi mosathamasacad kyi sabon ltabu'o/ /'gro ba thamasacad kyi chosadakar po 'phel bsazhing lta bu'o/ /'jig rten rab tu brten pasasalta bu'o/ /zhesabya ba nas/ rdzidang sman dang rin po che la sogs pa dpe bdun cu lhag dang bcas pa gsungs pa'i nang nas 'di dag ci rigs par 'byung ba yin no/ /sems can rnams kyi klad nad tsam/ gang po'i rtogs brjod btags par/ pha ma tshangasadang slob dpon te/ /mkhasapasapha ma bkur byasanas/ /tshe 'dir kun gyis bstod 'gyur la/ /phyi mar bde 'gro dga' bde 'thob/ /ces pa la/ dge slong dag gis pha ma'i bkur sti de tsam du ci bzang zhes zhus pa'i lan du/ bka' bstsal pa/ 'das pa'i dus su nga nyon mongs pa las ma grol ba de'i tshe/ ma la gnod pa chung ngus sdug bsngal chen po 'byung ba nyon cig /dge slong dag 'das pa'i dus na wā rā ṇa sīr ded dpon mdza' bo'i bu —10—

spyod 'jug sgrung 'grel las 'bras gsal ba'i me long zhes bya ba bzhugs/byung ngo cog shi nas/ bram ze mtshan brtag pa la mkhas pa zhig na re/ da bu skyes na bu mo'i ming thogs shig 'tsho zer nas/ ring po ma lon par bud med sems can dang ldan pa ded dpon la gsol bas dgyes te/ bud med khang bzangs kyi steng gi cha la skyes pa med par gcig pur nyams rangs su bzhag /sgra yid du mi 'ong ba mi thos par byas/ zas ha cang kha ba min pa sogs byin/khye'u nas khye'u'i steng du 'gro bar byas te rkang pa sa la 'jog tu mi 'jug pa sogs sbrum ma'i rim gro cher byas pas/ zla ba bcu na khye'u gzugs bzang ba/mdzes pa lta na sdug pa/ mgo bo gdugasaltar 'dug pa/ dpral ba'i dbyes che ba / smin ma 'jam pa/ sna'i gzingasamatho ba/ mtshan nyid thamasacad dang ldan pa btsas te btsas ston rgya cher byas nas mdza' bo'i bu mor ming btags so/ /pha rgya mtshor shi nas/ masaskyed de/ pha'i lasadrisapas/ drang por smrasan shir dwogasanas/ 'bru/ spos/ gos/ rin chen 'tshong bsasozhesapas/rim bzhin de dag gi rnyed pa ka sha pa ne bzhi brgyad bcu drug so gnyis rnyed pa ma la phul nas tshong pa lnga brgya dang lhan cig chas pa la mas ngu zhing rkang pa la 'jus kyang mgor rdog pa bsnun nas song ba la/ mas bu khyod la de'i rnam par smin par ma gyur cig ces so/ /der gru nya mid kyis bcom nas tshal pa gcig la 'jus pas thon nas rgya mtsho'i mthar phyin pas/ grong khyer dga' ba/ dga' byed/ stag myos/tshangs pa'i bla ma zhes pa bzhin lha'i bu mo bzhi/ brgyad/ bcu drug so gnyisakyis bsus nas/ lo de snyed kyi bar du lha'i dga' bde myong ngo / /de nasalho —11—

mkhyen brtse'i 'od snang las/ spyod 'jug sgrung 'grel/phyogs su ma 'gro zhes bkag kyang 'gro 'dod nas/ phyin pa dang / lcags kyi khang pa zhig gi nang du tshud nas sgo rang 'grig ste/ nang na mi bo che zhig gi mgo bo la 'khor lo 'bar ba'i rnag khrag gis 'tsho ba mthong nas dris pas ma la rdog pas bsnun 'bras zer/ 'o na bdag kyang las des 'dir khrid do snyam pa dang /nam mkha' las dga' ba dang ni dga' byed dang / /rtag myos tshangs pa'i bla ma rnams/ /spangs nasaci phyir khyod 'dir 'ongs/ /zhesagrags pa dang / lasakyi dbang gis 'ongs so zhes pa dang / bcings pa grol zhing / grol ba 'ching bar 'gyur ro zer ba dang / de 'phags nas bu mo'i mgo bo la 'khor ro/ de las thar pa de la 'di ji tsam zhig 'khor dris pas lo drug khri dang drug stong zer/'o na thar dka'o snyam nas yi mug ste/ 'dir gzhan 'ong ngam byas pas/ 'di'i las su bsags thams cad 'ong zer/ rang la dpag nas gzhan gces kyi snying rje skyes te/ 'di lta bu myong nges kyi las 'bras bsags pa thams cad bdag la smin la da 'dir su'ang 'ongs par ma gyur cig ces brjod ma thag tu/'khor lo de byang sems mdza' bo'i bu mo'i mgo las ta la bdun srid tsam du 'phags te shi nas dga' ldan du skyes so/ /dge slong dag ma la pa ne me phul 'bras grong khyer bzhir dga' bde myong la/ gnod pa de tsam gyis klad pa gshog pa'i sdug bsngal myong ngo / /zhes so/ /tshangs pa la yang 'di yod dam/ tshangs pa ni/ sems can thams cad kyi skye ba rgyun mi 'chad par gyur cig ces smon lam btab pas/ btab pa bzhin skye ba rgyun ma chad snyam pas sems can thams cad kho'i bu yin bsams nas —12—

spyod 'jug sgrung 'grel lasa'abras gsal ba'i me long zhes bya ba bzhugs/sems can thams cad la tshad sgom pa'o/ /phan btags lan lon gang yin pa / / grong khyer bzang po'i dpal du/ rgyal po lha gnas zhes pas/ bu stong yul so sor rgyal bran la btsud nas/ tha chung dge gnas zhes pa mi dang mi ma yin kun gyis bkur ba zhig yod pa skyed mos tshal na yod pa'i tshe/ gnod sbyin gcig pa gting nas 'thon ste/ mkhyen par mdzod gcig blon po dgra gcan blo ba ring bas yab bsad de rgyal por zhu na/ rgyal phran thams cad bsad nyid kyang gsod du 'ong bas myur du bros shig zer bas sngangs te/ 'bros pa'i lam du bu legs skyes zhes pa'i lo bdun pa de 'dug pa blangs pas btsun mo na re ji ltar rigs zer/ rgyu mtshan bsnyad pas bdag kyang 'chi ba zhu zer te phyin pas/btab pas ring lam du song ste/ mi gcig gi zhag gcig gi rgyags la gsum gyis zos pas zad nas/ bu sdug 'di 'phangs pas/ btsun mo gsad la gsol snyam ste/ gting nas ral gri gzas pas/ bus thal mo sbyar te/ min par bdag 'gum du gsol zhes yang yang gsol te/ de'ang da lta bsad kyang rul nas phan mi thogs kyis/ gson po la gang ran bcad na ring du thub bo zhes pa bzhin byas te/ sha kun zad kyang da dung mi gtol bar shes te/ ral gris btub pa'i bar gyi sha dang / mig la sogs pa khyer te phyin pas bu na re bdag dbug pa cung zad rgyu ba 'di la'ang bag tsam byin la byon zer ba bzhin byas ste song ba dang / bus bdag gi lus kyi sha tshun chad pha ma la phul ba 'dis/ma 'ongs pa na bdag gis sems can thams cad skyob byed sangs rgyas thob par gyur cig /cesasmosapas/ gnam sadrug tu g.yosate/ lha rnams kyang —13—

mkhyen brtse'i 'od snang las/ spyod 'jug sgrung 'grel/mngon shes kyis babasanas/ snying rjes ngu zhing me tog 'thor/ brgya byin gyis nyoms sad pa'i phyi+or sprang por sprul nas de'i sha cung zad de+o yang blangs pas byi+on na/ /yang stag sagasagacan gzan gdug pa can mang par sprul nas/ mchang zhing / ngar sgrasaza bar brtsamasapas/ da bdag la sha ni med/ rusapa dang chu rgyus dang rkang mar dang klad pa la sogs pa 'di dag gis khyed tshims nas ma 'ongs pa na chos kyi bdud rtsis tshim par byed par gyur cig ces bsngos nas/da bdag gi lus don yod par bya'o/ /snyam pa'i bsam pa brgya byin gyis shes te/ rang gzugs bstan pa khyod 'di lta bu'i sgyur rgyal lam tshangs sogs kyi 'dod byas pas/ bdag 'khor ba'i bde 'bras gang yang mi 'dod kyis/bsod nams 'dis sems can thams cad skyob byed sangs rgyas thob par 'dod ces so/ /'o na khyod sha tshun chad byin pa la mi 'gyod dam zer/ 'gyod pa sdug bsngal tsam med do zer/ de la dpang po su yod zer/ bdag la 'gyod pa med cing dga' sems yod na/ lus sngar bzhin gyur te/ mthar sangs rgyas thob par gyur cig /'gyod cing khro sems yod na da lta nyid du shi nas mnar med du lhung bar gyur cig ces brjod ma thag tu/ lus sngar bzhin gyur te gzi brjid dpal dang ldan par gyur te/ pha ma dang grong khyer de'i skye bo kun 'dus nas ngo mtshar du bsgrags shing / mgrin gcig tu/ byas shesadrin du gzo ba'i mi/ tang gi lus la'ang ma chagasapar/ /phan btagasalan ldon gang yin pa/ /'di 'dra kun gyisabasngagasapar 'os/ khekhi/so/ /desanasayul de'i rgyal pos/ yab yum sras gsum pho brang du khrid de bkur sti sna —14—

spyod 'jug sgrung 'grel las 'bras gsal ba'i me long zhes bya ba bzhugs/tshogs byas nas/ rgyal bu de la thugs brtse bas g.yul bshams te/ sgra gcan bstan te yob sras gnyis ka sngar gyi rgyal sa btsud de rgyal srid chos bzhin du bskyangs sa/ /yang bi ha ta zhes pa'i grong khyer stongs shul gyi thang stong kyi khron par/ mi gcig /khra gcig /byi ba gasdig sbrul gcig ste bzhi lhung nas yun ring por/grang skyes sogs sdug bsngal sna tshogs myong ba na/ phyogs der mi gcig 'ongs pas mthong nas thabs sna tshogs kyis snying rjes bton pa na/ de bzhi na re/khron pa gting zab 'di nas nged kyi srog byin pas drin lan bya'o zer/ mis yong srid/ dud 'gro khyed gsum la re dus mi yong zhes khyad du bsad pas/phyis mi de phongs nas nags khrod du rngon pa la phyin pas/ sngar gyi khra dang phrad nas/ grogs po ci byed zer/ phongs nas rngon pa byed cesapas/ sngar gyi drin lan bya zer nas/ rgyal po'i btsun mo skra 'khrud pa'i bar la rgyan rnams khyer te byin no/ /mis nga la khras rgyan byin zhes rang gis khron pa nas bton pa'i mi de la smras pas/ rgyal pos grong khyer pa'i skye bo rnams la nga'i btsun mo'i rgyan sus khyer shes pa byung na bya dga' spyin no smras pas/ mi ngan des sngar srog bton pa'i drin ni brjed/ drin lan bya'o zhesapa'i tshig ni rtswabazhin spangs nas/ don de rgyal po la smras so/ /rgyal pos mi de bzung nas khri mon du bcug bza' btung srog zin tsam las lhags pa gdams te nyams thag pa'i tshe/ sngar gyi byi bas mthong bas bza' rgyu bskyal lo/ khral gyis rgyal po'i lus la 'khyud pa dang / kha rlangs kyis skrangs te/ spra mkhan rnams la rtsis byas pas sbrul 'di ni —15—

mkhyen brtse'i 'od snang las/ spyod 'jug sgrung 'grel/btson de'i bsrung ma ste/ brtson 'di btang na sprul 'di 'gro zer ba bzhin sngar gyi nor rnams kyang byin nas btang ngo / /dmyal bar gnas par 'gyur zhes thub pas gsungs pa/ tshe dang ldan pa mo'u 'gal gyi bus sems can dmyal ba'i nang du phyin pa na/ sems can lus che ba/ kha nas me lce byung ste/ lcags kyi sa gzhi 'bar ba me lce gcig tu gyur pa'i steng du brgyangs nas/ lcags kyi phur pa 'bar bas thang sha bcad cing de'i lce la me+os do stong byung ste/ de rnams kyi rmig pa thams cad sbu gri'i so 'dra ba me lce gcig tu gyur pa ste/ de dag gis phyogs gang du gom pa bor ba de'i phyogs de dang der kun du gcod cing gtub la/ gzhi des sdug bsngal drag po mi zad pa'i tshor ba nyams su myong ba gcig mthong ngo / /de nas bsam pa 'di lta bu rgyu ci las byung zhes snyam par bzhag kyang / dmyal ba nas dmyal ba kho nar yang yang skyes pa tsam las/ las cis skyes ma shes nas/ bcom ldan 'das la gsol ba/ bdag 'chag pa na 'di lta bu'i dmyal ba mthong lags pa/las ci las gyur gsung du gsol/ bka' bstsal pa/ sngon 'das pa'i dus na sangs rgyas bgrod pa ma nyams pa zhes bya ba 'jig rten du byung ste/ de'i tshe dge slong sde snod gsum pa rig pa dang grol ba'i spobs pa dang ldan pa/ chos smra ba 'khor dang ldan pa zhig rgyal po'i pho brang zhig na rten zhing gnas te/ de de na mchod par bya ba'i gnas su gyur to/ te'i tshe dge slong dgra bcom pa sde snod gsum rig pa sogs yon tan du ma dang ldan pa 'khor lnga brgya dang bcas pa zhig phyogs der song ba na/ de 'ba' zhig la skya bo rnams bkur bstir bya —16—

spyod 'jug sgrung 'grel las 'bras gsal ba'i me long zhes bya ba bzhugs/bar sems kyi/ sngar gyi sde snod gsum pa la ni ma yin no/ /des bsamasapa dge slong 'di 'dir ma 'ongs pa'i tshe bdag rnyed grags dang ldan pa la/ 'di 'ongs nas de lta ma yin te/ 'di med na bdag rnyed grags snga ma kho na bzhin du 'gyur pas/ bdag gis ci nas kyang 'di 'dir mi 'dug par bya'o/ /snyam te/dge slong 'di ni tshul khrims 'chal ba'o/ /zhes sogs phyar ka btang bas/ skye bo kun kyang dgra bcom de la mi lta bar gyur te/ dgra bcom des kyang don de go nas gzhan du song ngo / /dge slong dag de ji mnyam du sems/ de'i tshe mdo sde gsum par gyur pa de dmyal ba de yin te/ sangs rgyas bgrod pa ma nyams pa'i ring nas/ da lta nga'i bar du sems can dmyal ba las shi 'phos shing yang dmyal ba 'ba' zhig tu skyes so/ /gsol ba/ bcom ldan 'das sems can de sdug bsngal de las nam thar par 'gyur/ bka' stsal pa/ ma 'ongs pa'i dus na sangs rgyas bla ma zhes bya ba 'jig rten du 'byung ste/ de'i tshe sems can dmyal ba las shi 'phos nas mi lus thob te/ de'i bstan pa la rab tu byung ste/dgra bcom pa mngon du byed par 'gyur ro/ /skur ba mang bar yang 'gyur te/de gang dang gang du 'gro ba de dang der bskur ba 'phrad par 'gyur te/ de kho nas skyo bar gyur nas phung po lhag ma med pa'i dbyings su yongs su mya ngan las 'da' bar 'gyur ro/ /'on te gang zhig yid rab dang byed na/ gsang chen du/bcom ldan 'das kyi 'dod chags kyi dra ba shes rab kyi mtshon gyis dral na/ ma chags pa'i zhing dag par 'gyur ro/ /zhes pa'i tshe/ byang sems dga' byed yang dag 'jog las bzhengs te/ mnyan yod du bsod snyoms kyi phyir —17—

mkhyen brtse'i 'od snang las/ spyod 'jug sgrung 'grel/gshegs pa tshong dpon dpal gyi bu mo dpal yon can gyis mthong nas bsod snyoms thogs te phyin pas/ dga' byed zhi zhing dul ba byad gzugs mdzes pa la mig tshugs su bltasapas/ lhag par chagasate/ dran pa nyamasal/ dga' ba byed kyang tshul min gyi rtog pas myos kyang yud tsam na dran pa rnyed nas chags par bya byed la brtag pas/ chags 'gyur gyi chos gang yang ma dmigs te/ mi skye ba'i chos la bzod pa thob nas/ ta la bdun srid du 'phags nas rgyal byed du 'phags pa dang / kun dga' bo la bka' bstsal pa/ dga' byed kyis 'dod chags kyi sems la brten nas bdud sde bcom zhing 'khor lo bskor zhes so/ /dpal yon can 'dod chagasakyisagadungasate/ de nyid du 'greng bzhin du dus byas nas/ rtsa gsum du skyes ma thag tu/ rin chen gzhal yas khang dpag tshad bcu gnyis par zhabs 'bring pa lha'i bu mo khri byung ba dran pas shes te/ chags sems la 'di lta na/ de la dad sems kyis mchod pa bya'o snyam nas/ lha'i bu mo lnga brgya dang lhan cig me tog sogs kyis mchod cing / phyag 'tshal te/ lan bdun bskor nas tshigs su bcad pa du mas bstod do/ de'i pha ma dag dga' byed kyis byad stem byas so zhes cho nges 'debs shing khro sems kyis bskur ba 'debs la/ bzhams dgos glengs nas sdig pa bshags te phyag 'tshal nas/ pha ma sogs dpal yon gyi nye du lnga brgya dga' byed la sems bskyed do/ /des na byang sems kyi spyod pa la dad par bya'o/ /rgyal srasarnamasal do gal chen posakyang / /skye rabasalas/ ston pa ni sngon nags khrod dpal dang ldan pa zhig na gcig pur rgyu ba'i spre'u zhig tu gyur —18—

spyod 'jug sgrung 'grel las 'bras gsal ba'i me long zhes bya ba bzhugs/pa'i tshe/ phyogs der ba gtor ba 'tshol ba'i mi gcig lam 'chol te 'khyams pa gcig bkres pas g.yang kha'i gting du 'bras bu smin pa'i ljid kyis g.yang phyogs su dud pa gcig la 'dzegs pas/ shing rtser sleb la khad pa dang sgra dang bcas te chag nas/ g.yang du chu 'khyil ba gcig gi steng du lhung bas/ ma snad par langs te ltas pas gang nas kyang thar sa ma rnyed par smre sngags 'don pa spre'us gsan nas khyod thar dka' ba'i g.yang sa 'dir ci byed dris pa'i lan du/sngar gyi lo rgyus gleng te/ thal mo sbyar nas bdag gi skyabs mdzad du gsol zhes pas/ sems dpa' des snying rjes dbugs phyung ste/ rdo ba mi'i ljid tsam la sbyangs nas mchongs te mi de steng du bton pas chad de/ rang nyid ngang rgyud bzang zhing mi de la drin gyis khyab pas/ gnod pa byas su dogs pa med par/ngas rdo leb 'di'i steng du nyal gyis/ gcan gzan sogs gnod pa srungs shig byas te bag phab nas gted log pa la/ ngan sems skyes te lam rgyags bya bar 'dod nas/ spre mgo la rdo 'phangs kyang / kho nyams stobs chung zhing 'khyar bas rdo zur phog nas rto leb la 'phar ba'i sgras gnyid sad nas/mchongs stabs su langs te bltas pas/ mi de skyengs shing skrag pas smra ma nus par 'dug pa la/ khong rang gnad pa'i sdug bsngal la mi gzigs par/ mi de la yi chad de/ snying rjes bltas nas/ khyod mir gyur kyang byas pa mi gzo bar 'di ltar byed pa/ da khyod la yid brtan du mi rung yang / khyod nyams nyes na mi rung gis byas te/ grong 'dabs su legs par bskyal lo/ /de nasami de mthong chos kyis myur bar mdzes zin pa kun gyis spangs te/ 'brog dgon pa —19—

mkhyen brtse'i 'od snang las/ spyod 'jug sgrung 'grel/zhig na mi gzugs su ma shes par 'dug pa la/ yul de'i rgyal po ri dwags shor ba la/ shur ba'i gong bu rnag khrag gis sbags shing dri nga ba de mthong bas dngangasaste/ khyod 'dre'am/ nyi tshe ba ni ci drisapas/ mi la lagasate/ 'di lta bu'i rgyu ni/ byamasapa snying ringasabyasapa yi/ /me tog tsam gcig 'dir smin te/ /'jig rten gzhan du gnag dka' ba'i/ /dmyal ba'i sdug bsngal slad kyisa'achi/ zhesazer ro/ de nasasemasadapa' chen po de/ de la snying rje'i shugs drag po skyes pa la brten nas slar yang dge ba la brtson par gyur to/ /skye rabs las/ ston pa 'di ni rgyal po byams stobs su gyur pa na/kun da'i dga' ston gyi shul du/ gnam sras kyi 'khor gnod sbyin lnga nyes pa 'ga'i phyir bskrad nas/ 'dzam bu gling du sems can gyi mdangs 'phrog ma nus par/ bram ze sprul nas nags khrod cig tu phyin te/ ba glang rdzi gcig gis/rgyal po'i snyan pa brjod nas/ sgo drung du phyin nas bza' btung blangs pas/dkar gsum byin yang zar ma nyan par rang gzugs bstan nas gson po'i sha khrag dron po 'tshal zer nas/ rgyal po nyid kyi sha khrag gnang bsatshim ste/ drin lan ci bzhed dris pas/ 'gro kun skyobs byed sangs rgyas 'dod gsung / de bdag cag gi yul yin yang khyed thugs dam la brtson par gda' bas myur du thob 'chi bas de thog mar bdag cag la dgongs shig zer bas/ chos kyi lam la 'di 'dra'i grogs gyur pa/ /byang chub thob nasarjed par ga la 'gyur/ /rnam par dag pa'i chos kyi bdud rtsi la/ /thog ma nyid du khyed la bgo bar bya//zhes khas blangs pas/ lnga sde la thog mar chos ston pa'i rgyu mtshan gcig de'o//—20—

spyod 'jug sgrung 'grel las 'bras gsal ba'i me long zhes bya ba bzhugs/gnod spyin rnams kyang srog mi gcod pa sogs dam bcas/ phyag 'tshal te mi snang bar gyur to/ ṣe'u dang po'o// //ka2 le'u gnyis pa'i skabs kyi gtam rgyud bshad pa/legasa'ong dpalaskyesargan zhugasadang/ /lhaphrugado+orje masogasabazhi/ /rgan skyesasrin phrug ne+e tso dang / /gro bzhin skyesadang byi ba gnyis/ /'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug dang / /nga rgyal phrag dog bco brgyad do/ /rin chen sems de gzung bar bya ba'i phyir/ zhes sogs skabs su tshogs bsags dgos te/ dper na/ khye'u legs 'ongs sam/ khyim bdag dpal skyes bzhin/ de'ang mnyan yod na khyim bdag phyug po gcig la bu med par/ sde pa drug gi ston pa la chos ston byas pas/ lo dus na bu gcig skyes pa legs 'ongs su btags so/ de cher skyes pa'i tshe pha ma shi /bu yang shin tu rtsings pasardzasathamasacad rlag go /ming yang nyesa'ongasasu sposaso/ /de nasakhol mo gcig gis shing btus nas gso bzhin du/ khol mo rdung 'tshogs pas/der khol mo yang yid byung nas/ ngas 'bad nas gsos kyang nga la sdang bas 'grogs pa'i thabs med kyis khyod 'di nas grong khyer gnyan yod du song la/de nas nyan thos kyi dge 'dun brgya phrag phyed dang bcu gsum dang / thams cad mkhyen pa bzhugs kyis rab tu byung zhig zer nas/ dug po'i mtha' la dngul gyi pa ne gcig btags te btang ngo / /der khye'u nyes 'ongs kyis nyan thosashā ri'i bu la sogs pa la rab tu byung bar zhus pas/ ting nge 'dzin gyis ltas pas —21—

mkhyen brtse'i 'od snang las/ spyod 'jug sgrung 'grel/tshogasam bsags par mthong nas ma gnang ngo / /de nas thams cad mkhyen pa'i drung du phyin nas rab tu 'byung bar gnang ste/ khyod tshogs sogs shig gsung ste/ dug po'i mtha' la dngul gyi pa zhe gcig btags te btang ngo / /dug po'i mtha' la dngul gyi pa ne 'dug pa'ang gzigs nas des tshong dpon gyi bu mo la ut+pa la nyos gsungs pa bzhin phyin pas/ bu mo'ang nyes 'ongs dge ba la zhugs pa la dga' nas ut+pa la khur gcig bkur btang ngo / /bka' bstsal pa / dge 'dun thams cad kyi dbu la me tog re re tshugs shig gsungs pa bzhin btsugs so/ /dge 'dun rnamasakyis nyes 'ongs kyi tshogs rdzogs pa'i phyir me tog la snoms shig gsungs pa bzhin bsnams pas/ nyes 'ongs tshogs rdzogasanas/ bshags pa byas te/ bcom ldan 'das kyisakyang / dge slong 'ongs pa legs so zhes brjod pas dge slong du gyur nas dgra bcom pa'i 'bras bu thob bo/ / yang khyim bdag dpal skyes zhes pa ser sna dang ldan pa gcig la/ rgas khar bu lnga btsas nas de rnams la rdzas thams cad byin nas chung ma re'ang blangs so/ /der khyim bdag lo brgyad cu lon nasachung ma'ang shi /mig kyang mi bde nas/ mna' ma lnga'i bgor lhung nas re mos kyis gso ba la/ mna' ma rnamasakyis rang rang gi khyo la tshod ma bzang po drangs/ rgad po la tshod ma ngan pa drangs pas/ khyim bdag na re bu la nga la tshod ma ngan no byas pas bu rnams kyis chung ma la/ khyim bdag rdzas thams cad gsog gsog pa yin pas/ bya na bzang po byin gcig byas pas/ chung ma rnams kyis phru ba zhabs gnyis par —22—

spyod 'jug sgrung 'grel las 'bras gsal ba'i me long zhes bya ba bzhugs/tshod ma bzang ngan gnyis gnyis byas te/ rgad po la ngan pa drangs so/ /yang rgad pos bu rnams la nga'i tshod ma ngan no smras pas/ bud med na re rgad po bcos pa yin zer/ bus kyang phru ba gcig tu thams cad 'dren gyi 'dug pas skyon med do smras/ nam zhig khyim bdag rid par gyur nas/ lag pas phru bar nyul bas zhabs gnyis par rtogs te/ shin tu yi mug nas 'khyam so/ ldas thams cad gsog gsog pa yin te phan med zer nas/ rgyal byed kyi tshal du phyin nas/ shāri'i bu dang / mo'u 'gal gyi bu dang / 'od srung gi bar du'ang rim bzhin bdag rab tu 'byung bar zhus pas/ ting nge 'dzin gyis tshogs ma bsags par gzigs nas ma gnang ngo / /der khyim bdag gis bsams pa/ 'dir rab tu 'byung ba'i skal ba med de/ slar ldog tu mna' mas bza' ba mi ster/ shin tu yi mug te 'chi bar bsams nas mgon med zas byin gyis kun dga' rwa ba'i them pa la sngas bcas te 'dug cing zas bcad pas/ zhag gsum na bcom ldan 'das kyis thugs rjes gzigs nas/kun dga' bo la mkhyen bzhin du dris so/ khri/ mtshan zhus pas/ 'dir bosagacig gsung ngo / nang du phyin pas/ bcom ldan 'das kyis dge slong legs par 'ongs sam zhes gsungs pas/ rab tu byung ste dgra bcom par gyur to/ /'khor rnams ngo mtshar du gyur nas zhus pa/ 'dir ser sna'i dbang gis sa bon med bzhin du 'di ltar 'gyur ba rgyu ci lagasazhes so/ /bka' bstsal pa/ nga ni thams cad mkhyen par gyur pas/ sa dang bseg ma'i nang na nor bu phra mo ltar/ nyon mongs sdug pa'i nang na sa bon phra mo yod pa mthong ngo / /de'ang khyim —23—

mkhyen brtse'i 'od snang las/ spyod 'jug sgrung 'grel/bdag 'di skye ba snga ma rgyal po gcig gi shing thun te/ grong khyer der byon pa'i sgra thos nas/ shing thun dga' ste/ 'phags pa dang 'phrad 'dod pas nye lam nas grong khyer du 'ongs pa lam du stag mo bu skyes gcig dang phrad de bsad do//de 'chi ba'i tshe sangs rgyas zhes brjod pa dang bcas pas/ sa bon phra mo de lta bu yod pa ngas mthong ba de'i phyir ro zhes gsungs so/ /༈ sangs rgyas rnams la skyabs su mchi/ ṣā+on rgan zhugs blun po zhig bsod snyoms la phyin pa la sbyin bdag mo zhig dad nas/ ras zung sbyar gcig phul nas chos zhus pas/ rgan zhugs kyis chos ma shes par/ nga mi shesapa sdug bsngal lo/ /zhes yang yang smrasapas/ rgan mosargyu mi shesapa lasa'abrasabu sdug bsngal 'byung bar rtogs te bden pa mthong nas/ slob dpon gyis bdag 'khor ba las sgrol lo zhes sogs tshig gi gtang rag du ma brjod nas song ngo / /de'i tshe rkun po gcig blun po 'di la ras 'di la ras 'di brku bar bya snyam nas rjes su 'brang ste/ rgan zhugs nang du zhugs pa la/ ras byin gcig smras so/ /rgan zhugs skrag pas phyir 'byung mi nus kyis/ lag pa gnyis g.yag shing bug nas yar thong zhig smras te btang ba na/ thag pas dam du btags nas/ rgan zhugs phyir byung ste/ gsum la skyabs 'gro re byed du bcug nas/ dbyug pa na nges re spel nas rgyab/ der 'theng gin phyin pa na/mgron po na re khyod su ci ste 'theng zer/ kho bo rkun po zhig ste/ de bas kyang dge sbyong rkun chen zhig na/ des skyabs 'gro re dang dbyug pa re spel gyin brdungs/ sangs rgyas thugs shes mnga' bas skyabs 'gro gsum du bsdus/—24—

spyod 'jug sgrung 'grel las 'bras gsal ba'i me long zhes bya ba bzhugs/skyabs 'gro bzhi pa srid na kho bo nges par srog dang 'bral nges so zer nas sangs rgyas la dad bzhin du zam 'og gcig tu zhugs so/ /der zam pa de la mi ma yin mang po 'gro ma nus te/ sngar bdag cag rnams kyis zam pa 'di la bde blag tu 'gro nus bzhin du/ da mi nus pa ni ci/ zam 'og gi mi de la khyod kyis rig pa ci shes dris pas/ skyabs 'gro gcig shes gzhan ni ga la zer/de thams cad dad nas skyabs 'gro byed cing / rkun po de'ang rab tu byung nas 'bras bu thob bo/ khing / lha'i bu mo nor bu dri ma med pa la 'chi ltas lnga byung te/ shi nas kyang 'dzam bu'i gling du phag mo'i mngal du skye'o zhes grag pas/brgya byin gyis skyabasam nus par/ sangs rgyas kyis skyabasa'agro phog pas/ de shi nas bram zer skyes/ de nas dga' ldan du skyes pa mngon shes kyis skyabs 'gros skyes pa shes te/ sangs rgyas la me tog gtor/ tshigs su bcad de smras pa/ gang zhig sangs rgyas skyabasa'agro ba/ /de dag ngan 'gror mi 'gro ste//mi yi lusani spangasanasasu/ /de nasalha yi lusa'athob bo/ /chosadang / dge 'dun la'ang 'gre'o/ /yang / rgyal po gsal rgyal la/ btsun mo du ma yod pa'i chen ma 'bar le la/ bu mo bongasathung / mdog nag sha rtsub/ gang nasaltasakyang mi sdug ste/ rgyal po'i bla brjod pa gcig btsas pa'i ming rdo rje ma zhes btags so//rgyal po de shin du ngo tsha yang btsun mo gnang chen gyi bu mo yin pas pho brang dgu rim gyi nang du sped cing / tshad du byon nasakhyim gyi dus la bab pa dang / rgyal pos blon po gcig la bka' bstsal pa/ thog mar cho ris che ba la da lta nor —25—

mkhyen brtse'i 'od snang las/ spyod 'jug sgrung 'grel/med nas 'khyams pa gcig nga'i spyan sngar khrid la shog gcig sgo ba bzhin/phul ba dang / rgyal bosadaben par mi de la gsang ste/ bka' bstsal pa/ nga la bu mo shin tu mi sdug pa gcig yod de/ khyod nor med kyang mi rigs mtho bas sbyin gyis longs shig byas pas/ mi des pus btsugs te/ rgyal pos bdag la mi phal pa zhig stsal na'ang blang 'tshal na/ gdung rigs bstsal ba ci ste mi blang byas pas/ mag pa la sgo ba/ nga'i bu mo 'di shin tu mi sdug pas/khyed gzhan du 'gro ba'i tshe phugs su chug la lde mig rang gis chongs shig ces yo byad chog thang gcig dang byin nas byan mor bzhag go /desayo byad 'phel te/ blon po gzhan dang bud med gros byas te 'tshog par byas so/ gzhan kun chad pa bzhin 'ongs pa na/ kho'i bud med med pas rogs po kun the tshom za nas/ yang na 'di la byad gzugs bzang la khyad par 'phags pa/ yang na ldog pas lta'o zer te/ kho bzi ba dang glo las lde mig brkus te lta bar bgros so/ /de'i tshe bud med des bsamasapa/ bdag gis sngon las ci zhig byas pas tshe gang gis khyim mun khung dgu rim du bcug nas nyi zla zer tsam yang mi mthong ngo snyam yi mug nas/ de bas thams cad mkhyen pa la skyabs su gsol snyam ste/ ba spu langs 'chi ma 'brub cing / ston pa'i phyogs na phar lus stabs te/ ston pa bcom ldan 'das thams cad mkhyen pa la phyag 'tshal cing skyabs su mchi'o/ /bdag 'di lta bu'i sdug bsngal las thar par mdzad du gsol zhes brjod pas/ ston pa de nyid du byon nas/ dbu mthong pas mgo bo skyon dang /sku rdzogs par mthong bas lus ngan pa thams cad dor nas mdzes sdug dpe zla —26—

spyod 'jug sgrung 'grel las 'bras gsal ba'i me long zhes bya ba bzhugs/med par gyur pa dang / grogs po kun ltar 'ongs pa shin tu mtshar ba 'di phangs pas ston mi nus nges so zer/ de nas khyo 'ongs pas mthong ste su yin dris pas/ nga khyod kyi khyim thab yin te/ rgyu mtshan de ltar byung bsnyad nas/ khyo la da ha cang skyo ches kyis nga yab la mjal bas khyod kyis zhus shig /der zhus pas/ rgyal pos de skad ma zer bar mo la sgo chod la phyir 'byung du ma ster zer ba la/ sras mo ni sngar bzhin ma lags te da lta lha mi las kyang 'das so zhus pas dgyes te gnang nas/ 'khor bcas kyis sangs rgyas la mchod de rgyu mtshan zhus pas/ bka' bstsal pa/ 'di skye ba snga ma la rgyal po gcig gi bu mo yin te/ des yab kyi mchod gnas rang rgyal mi sdug pa gcig yod pa la/'di'i mgo bo 'di dom mgo 'dra/ rna ba 'di bong bu'i/ mig ni spre'u'i/ sna ni phag pa'i/ so ni khyi'i/ lus 'di ni sbal pa'i zhes sogs yang yang brjod do//der rang rgyal des kyang nam mkha' la 'phags nas rdzu 'phrul du ma bstan pas/bu mo shin tu 'gyod de rang rgyal de la bshags pas/ des kyang tshangs par gnos po sogs rgyu mtshan rgyas par gsungs nas thams cad skyabs 'gro la bkad da/ /gzhan yang / dur khrod kyi mi min gyis mi tshugs pa/ bza' mi gnyis kyi ma gcig skyabs 'gro la dga' ba dur khrod du bskyal pa bzhin dang / 'brog srin za byed kyis ma tshugs pa'i pha bu bzhin dang / snying rje pad dkar las/rgya mtshor tshong pas skyabs 'gro byas pa thob pa'i chu srin gru bshig mkhan gyis kyang 'bras bu thob pa bzhin zhes sogs 'dir rgyas par brjod par ga la nus —27—

mkhyen brtse'i 'od snang las/ spyod 'jug sgrung 'grel/te/ yi ge mang pas 'jigs pa'i phyir ro/ /sprosapa la dga' na gzhan du gzigs shig /༈ nyon mongs sgo nas lus ngag dang / rgyal po'i khab na tshong dpon phyug po gcig gi chung ma la bu chags nas bu snga ma de mngal las ma byung bar 'dug bzhin du/ phyisabu bstobyung yang bu dang po ni mngal na 'dug go /de nasare zhig na bud med na nas rim 'gro byas kyang ma phan par 'chir nye ba'i tshe/ khyim thab la smras pa/ bdag gum pa'i tshe blo g.yas rol mtshon gyis phye la/ khye'u dang po de phyung shig/yang smrasapa/ bsagasapa kun ni tha mar 'dzad/ /mthon po rnamasani tha mar 'jig /'dusapa rnamasani tha mar 'bral/ /gadron pa rnamasani tha mar 'chi/ zhes smras te shi'o/ /de sman pa mtsho byed kyis bsil ba'i tshal gyi dur khrod du khyer te/ gzhar phyin pas/ don de rgyal po'i khab kyi grong khyer du grags te ltad mo mi 'bum phrag du ma 'dus so/ ta ོma ldan 'das kyis kun dga' bo la bka' bstsal pa/ kun dga' bo la/ dge slong rnams la bcom ldan 'das dur khrod du gshegs par bzhed kyis/ khyed cag las rmad du byung ba la lta 'dod pa gshegs shig bgosashig /de nas nyan thos rnams kyis zhabs 'bring byas te byon nas/ mtsho byed kyis bud med de'i blo g.yas dral bas/ kun gyis mthong bar khye'u skra dkar zhing gnyer ma mang la rid pa rgan sha can gcig ma shi bar byung ngo / khyung ma thag de skye bo'i tshogs de snyel ltas te smras pa / kye ma pha ma'am mkhan slob rnams la tshig rtsub mo ma smra zhig /ji ltar zhe na / bdag ni ma'i lto ba dang long kha'i bar du lo drug cur 'dug pa'i sdug —28—

spyod 'jug sgrung 'grel las 'bras gsal ba'i me long zhes bya ba bzhugs/bsngal nyamasasu myong ngo zer nas/ mi smra bar 'dug go /bcom ldan 'dasakyis de bka' bstsal pa khyod rgan po yin nam/ gsol ba/ bcom ldan 'dasabadag ni rgan po lags so/ /bde bar gshegs pa bdag ni rgan po lags so/ /gzhi des rgan po skyes bu btags so/ khyu de lasabartsamasate/ bcom ldan 'das kyis chos bstan pas sems can brgya phrag mang po skyo bar gyur nas 'bras bu thob bo/ /rgan po yang lo bcu'i bar du khyim na gnas te/ bdun cu pa la rab tu byung nas dgra bcom pa thob bo/ /des kyang tshong pa lnga brgya rgya mtshor 'jigs pa lasaskyabs te/ dgra bcom pa la bkod do/ /dge slong rnams kyis gsol ba/ bcom ldan 'das/ rgan po skyes 'di'i 'di lta bu'i rgyu mtshan gsung du gsol/ bka' bstsal pa sngon sangs rgyas 'od srung gi bstan pa la/ tshong dpon gyi bu gcig /gnasabartan dgra bcom gcig la rab tu byung ngo / /de'i tshe der dus ston gcig byung nas/ gzhon nusaganas brtan de la da ni gshegs ran no zhes lan gsum du brjod kyang / da dung ltas kyis/ dge ba'i phyogs gyis shig ces yang yang brjod do/ /gzhon nu lto 'dun can des/ khyod lo drug cu'i bar du khyim nas ma byung zhig /nga ni song zin no zhes ngag rtsub smras pa'i las so/ /lus can dag gi las rnams ni/ 'kha sogs rgyas par gsungs so/ /thams cad 'dren pa rnams la 'chags/ bram ze gcig rang gi pho brang na gnas pa na/ mi shin tu mi bsrun pa/ dman pa'i rigs/ bzhin mi sdug pa/ spre'u sdum pa'i cha byad lta bu/ 'gro na gzhogs 'gros su 'gro/ smra na ngu zhing smra/ za na skyug thabs su za —29—

mkhyen brtse'i 'od snang las/ spyod 'jug sgrung 'grel/ba / mi'i rigs min pa gcig la/ btsun mo rnal 'byor gnon pa bya ba/ shin tu mdzes shing lta na yid du 'ongs pa zhig yod pa/ khyo des rtag tu 'tshog cing brdung la/ dus nam zhig mos phyag ma byas pa la gsod du byung ba na/ bred de 'dar zhing bros pas/ sus kyang skyabs ma nus pa la/ bram ze de snying rje cher skyes nas de'i skyabs byas pas/ srin phrug de bram ze de mthong bas shin tu bred de/ a ci'i mi lus gzi brjid can/ /'di lta bu zhig ga na gnas/ kho bo bdag la thugs rjes gzigs/ /dam pa'i gzugasal skyabs su mchi/ zher ba la/ kye ma sems can ngo mtshar can/ /mi lusasrin po'i gdong pa 'di/ /lasangan byas pasalusangan thob/ /'gyod drag skyesan bde ba'i don/ /zhesasmras pas/ de'ang shin tu 'gyod pa drag po skyes te/ snying 'gas pa snyam/ mig 'bras phyung ba snyam lus 'jig pa snyam pa byung ste/ skra 'bal zhing mchi ma khrag tu 'dzag pa lus rengasate smras pa/ kye ma kyi hud lasangan rang la smin/ /su yis ma lan rang la yi re mug /gang du lasabyasad lta smin gyur cig /da lta nyid du sdug bsngal gnang gyur cig /ces 'gyod gdung dang bcas te smrasapas/ de nyid du lus mdzes pa/ ngag snyan pa/ yid du 'ong bar gyur nas/ sngar gyi cha byad spangs pas/ mi rnams na re/ btsun mo rnam par gnon pa'i dpal du bram ze byung ngo zer bas bram ze'i mtshan de ltar grags so/ /blo bur tshe la yid mi brtan/ khyim bdag ke du ta ma'i bu gzhon nu ne tsos/sbrang tshang gi rnam 'gyur las mi rtag pa skyes te/ 'byor pa thams cad sbyin par btang nas pha dang gnyis ka rab tu byung nas dgra bcom pa thob bo/ /—30—

spyod 'jug sgrung 'grel las 'bras gsal ba'i me long zhes bya ba bzhugs/mi bzad gang yin mdun na gnas/ ded dpon stobs kyi sde zhes pa la/bu mgo bo gdugs ltar 'dug pa sogs dang / rin po che'i rna cha rang chas su yod pa zhig skar ma gro zhun la btsas so/ /de'i ming 'dogasapa'i tshe/ rin chen de'i rin gcod du bcug pas sus kyang bcad ma nus pa la 'jig rten na bye ba ri zer bas/ de'i ming yang rna ba bye ba ri'am/ gro zhun skyes su btags so/ /de cher skyesapa'i tshe/ pha ded dpon gyi rigasayin pas/ ma la nor bu ldon du 'gro bar zhus ste/ tshong pa rnams la/ dril bsgrags nas/ rgya mtshor 'gro ba la/ mas tshong pa rnams la smras pa/ nga'i bu 'di sngon la ma btang phyi la ma bzhag par tshur 'ong dus kyang nga'i bu khrid la shog byas te/ zhabal ba yang glang po che drogasam bskur bar/ gsosla dran pa dang ldan pa'i bong bu bskur btang ngo / /de nasargya mtsho nasanor bu mang po nyesamed du lon pa la/ rin 'di la 'di zin gyis rnam rtog yengs nas nam smad gnyid du song ba'i bar la tshong pa rnams song ste/ nyi ma shar ba gro zhun skyes kyi 'gram pa la phog pas gnyid sad de ltas pas grogs thams cad med do/ khos kyang bong bu la 'khal bkal te/ grogs ma snyegs su dogs nas bong bu brdungs pas bong bu rdzi 'tshubs te lam gtor bas/ zhabal bor te bkres pas/ lcags kyi khang pa gcig 'dug pa'i sgo na yar gro bzhin skyes la 'os pa'i bza' btung byin gcig byas pas de nas yi dwags mang po byung nas/ nged kyis lo bcu gnyis kyi bar du bza' btung gi ming yang ma thos na/ khyod kyis nged la bza' btung byin cig zer/ khyed 'dir las cis skyes byas pas/ khyed 'dzam bu gling pa yid —31—

mkhyen brtse'i 'od snang las/ spyod 'jug sgrung 'grel/ches par dka' bas mi smra zer/ ngas mngon sum du mthong ba la yid mi ches rgyu med ci yod smrosagacig /de dag na re/ bdag cag ngag rtsub khro ldan zhing / /bdag cag ser snasa'ajungasapa can/ /sbyin pa ci yang ma btang bas/ /da lta yi dwags 'jig rten lhags/ gnyis pa smrasapa/ nad med rgyags pas myos pa dang / /lang tsho longasaspyod dregasapasamyos/ /sbyin pa ci yang ma btang bas/ /da lta yi dwags 'jig rten lhags/ de rnams skye ba snga ma grong khyer rdo 'jog na yod pa'i byis pa kha cig yin te/ rtsed mo'i phyir chu rnyog pas dge 'dun gyi chu len ma stobs par gro chag pa'i rnam smin no zer ro/ /de nas gro zhun skyes kyis phyogs gcig na phar phyin pas nam sros pa dang / phyogs de na gzhal yas khang gcig na lha gcig 'dug pa la bza' btung blangs pas/ 'grangs ngoms su byin nas mtshan mo zad khar lha de na re ngan pa mig gis ma mthong ba la song gcig zer/ khos ngan pa ci yod dam snyam nas bsdad pas/ lha de sems can dmyal ba gcig tu gyur nas sreg cing 'dug go/yang mtshan mor song ba dang lhar gyur to/ khos lha de la mtshan mo lhar 'gyur la nyin mo dmyal bar 'gyur ba ci dris pas/ nga skye ba snga ma grong khyer rdo 'jog gi shan pa yin pa la/ 'phags pa ka ta ya nas nga la srog gcod spongs gsungs/ ngas mi nus byasapas/ khyod nyin mo srog gcod dam/ mtshan mo gcod gsungs/ ngas nyin mo gcod zhus pas/ 'o na mtshan mo srog mi gcod pa'i sdom pa longs gsungs nas blangs pa las de lta bu'i rgyu las 'di lta bu'o zer/ khyod grong khyer rdo 'jog du 'gro na nga'i bu shan pa zhig yod kyis shan pa —32—

spyod 'jug sgrung 'grel las 'bras gsal ba'i me long zhes bya ba bzhugs/'phro chod la/ shan pa'i gri 'jog pa'i 'og na mar gser bum gang yod kyis thon la nga'i don du dge sbyong dang bram ze dang 'phags pa ka ta ya na la phul la nga'i ming nas thon la bsngo ba gyis shig dang / 'on kyang nga'i sdug bsngal 'di srab par 'gyur ro zer ro/ /yang phyogs gcig na phar phyin pa dang / nyin par gzhal yas khang gcig na lha cig 'dug pas/ bza' btung mang po byin nas nyi ma nub khar ngan pa mig gis ma mthong ba la song zer/ sngar bzhin bsdad pas/ dmyal bar song ba dang / yang lhar song ba sogs rgyu mtshan dris pas nga skyetshob snga ma grong khyer rdo 'jog gi khyim bdag 'dod log spyod pa zhig yin te/'phags pa ka ta ya nas 'dod log spongs gsung / ngas mi nus zhus pas/nyin mo spyod dam/ mtshan mo spyod gsung / ngas mtshan mo spyod zhusapas/ 'o na nyin mo mi spyod pa'i sdom pa longs gsungs nas blangs pas rgyu mtshan 'gre'o//khyod rdo mchog tu 'gro na nga'i bu med la me thab sbas pa'i 'og na gser bum gang yod kyis de thon la/ bdag nyid la'ang dus dus su bde bas tshim par byed pa dang / 'phags pa ka t+ya na po la bsod snyoms phul la/ nga'i ming nas thon lo yon bsngo ba gyis shig dang / nga'i sdug bsngal 'di srab par 'gyur ro zhes sa/ /yang phyogs gcig na phar phyin pas/ gzhal yas khang gcig na lha mo gcig la 'khor yi dwags bzhi 'dug go/bza' btung blangs pas mang po byin nas yi dwags 'di rnams la ma byin cig zer/ khos ma nyan par byin pas/gcig la khro chu khol mar gyur/ gcig la me ma mur du gyur/ gcig la gra phub —33—

mkhyen brtse'i 'od snang las/ spyod 'jug sgrung 'grel/tu gyur/ gcig la me mdag tu gyur te sdug bsngal lo/ /der lha mo de na re da ci ru ma ster byas te/ byin pas phan na nga yang ster te mi phan par sdug bsngal rogs su 'gro zer ro/ khos 'di lta bu'i 'khor sogs rgyu mtshan dris pas/khyed 'dzam bu gling pa yid ches par dka' bas mi smra zer/ ngas mngon sum du mthong bas yid ches kyi smros shig /nged skye ba snga ma grong khyer rdo 'jog gi bza' tshang yin pa la/ 'di rnamasanga'i khyo/ bu/ bu mo/ bran mo bzhi yin pas/sngar mor las la song ste/ ngas g.yos byed kyin bsdad pas/ 'phags pa ka t+ya na byon pa la 'bras chan lhung bzed gang btsos te drangs pas/ kho pa'i lto ba 'phyid zer/ ngas khyod rnams rjes su yid rangs par byos shig dang / ngas 'phags pa ka t+ya na la bsod snyoms phul bas lto 'phyid pa yin gyis byas pas/khyo na re de'i kha ru me mdag sbar gang mi bdug pa zer/ bu na re khro chu khol ma/bu mo na re me ma mur/ bran mos gra phub mi bdug pa zer/ ngas smon lam ma dag pa btab te/ khyed rnams kyis 'phags pa yul khyad par can la ngag rtsub smras pa'i rnam smin ngas mthong bar gyur cig byas pa las 'di lta bu'i rgyu mtshan zer/ de na re khyod grong khyer rdo 'jog tu sdod par 'dod dam zer/ 'dod byas pas/ der sngas ston la nyol zer nas nyal bas/ yi dwags bzhi pos stan gyi gra bzhi nas btegs nas rdo 'jog tu bskyal lo/ gnyid sad nas bltas pas/rdo 'jog tu slebs 'dug nas bsams pa/ 'phags pa ka ta ya na la rab tu 'byung bar zhu snyam nas zhus pas/ khyod rang gi pha ma ma shi bar yod pas/ pha ma la rab tu 'byung bar zhus las shog cig /dmyal ba yi dwags rnams kyi —34—

spyod 'jug sgrung 'grel las 'bras gsal ba'i me long zhesabya ba bzhugs/'phrin yang gyis gsungs nas/ khos shan pa'i bu la 'phrin bzlas pas rdzun yin zer/ gser bum bstan pa ltar byung nas yid ches 'dug pa mtshar nas 'dzum byas pas gser gyi mche ba lhag byung ba dang / der gro zhun skyes su ngo shes nas/ khyod gro zhun skyes yin byas pas 'jig rten na de ltar grags zer/'o na khyod kyi pha ma yod pas 'phrad du song zer ro/ takhrin gnyis pa byas pas kyang / pha ma la 'phrad du song gi bar gong bzhin no/ /gong du tshong pa rnams log pa'i tshe kho med de dris pas/ snga ma rnams na re phyi nas 'ong zer/ phyi ma na re sngon la song zer te/ shi snyam nas dge rtsa byas te/ kho'i don du 'di ltar byas so/ /zhes rdo ring la bris nas bu shi ba'i mya ngan gyis pha ma'i mig long ba/kho phyin pas dga' ches nas ngus pas mchi mas ling thog dag ste mthong ngo / /der pha mas kyang rab tu 'byung bar gnang nas/ 'phags pa ka ta ya na la rab tu byung ste phyir mi 'ongs pa'i 'bras bu thob bo/ /nyin mtshan sdod pa yongs med par/ /mi zhig g.yang kha'i 'bras bu la chags te/ rtswa la 'jus pos/ byi ba dkar nag gnyisagis re mos su rtswade bcad nas g.yang du lhung nga / /zug ngu thams cad 'byin pa yi/ smri tis/ dga' bo sor phreng lam chung ba / ka jigalha sbyin dug lnga'i dpe/ zhegagasungasapa ltar/ dang po 'dod chags kyi zug rngu 'byin tshul ni/ ston pa rgyal byed na bzhugs pa'i tshe/ gcung mdzes dga'o/ ṣi dha ri ka la chags nas de yid 'byung bas gdul ba'i phyir ser skyar byon pa la bsod snyoms 'bul ba pu dhas ma khegs par dpral bar —35—

mkhyen brtse'i 'od snang las/ spyod 'jug sgrung 'grel/tsan dan gyi thig le byas pa ma bskams par shog byas kyang / rgyal byed lta bar 'dod dam zhes khrid de phyag dar la btsud pa zin dus med nas ma tshor bar bros pa dang mjal nas/ rtsa gsum lta bar 'dod dam zhes khrid de/ der khang pa thams cad na lha pho mo zung du 'dug cing / gcig na mdzes ma gcig khye'u med par me tog gi phreng ba rgyud pa la rgyu mtshan dris pas/ mdzes dga' rab tu byung nas 'dir skye ba'i phreng ba'o zer/ der legs smon gyi rab tu byung ba'i tshe/dmyal ba'i gnas lta 'dod dam zhes khrid de/ thams cad na 'tshod yang /gcig na sems can med par chu tshan skol ba'i rgyu mtshan dris pas/ gcung dga' bo mi yul na legs smon gyi sdom pa bsrung ba'i 'bras bu zad nas/'dir skye ba'i chu skol lo byas pas skrag nas nges 'byung gi tshul khrims bsrungs te bsgoms pas dgra bcom pa thob bo/ /༈ zhe sdang gi zug rngu 'byin tshul ni/ sor 'phreng gi mdo las sangs rgyas dang mdzangs blun las phan par bzhed do/ /rgyal byed na bzhugs pa'i tshe/gsal rgyal gyi blon po zla ba la bu dge mtshan du mas spras pa skyes nas mtshan bstan pas/ mngal du byung tsam nas ma sdug bsngal gyis mi gdung bas/ khye'u mi gdung bar btags so/ /stobs mi stong thub/ yang rtsal bya 'phur yang zin/mgyogs pa rta bas lhag pa gcig ste/ bram ze nor bzang can la rig byed bslabs pas/ nyin re la lobs lhag pa lobs te/ thams cad kyis khur zhing / yid bzhin bzang mo yang yang de'i byad gzugs la chags kyang / gleng pa'i go skabs ma byung ba'i tshe/ bram ze la lho phyogs na zla ba gsum yo byad sbyor —36—

spyod 'jug sgrung 'grel las 'bras gsal ba'i me long zhes bya ba bzhugs/ba yod par gshegs pas/ bzang mo la grogs slob ma gcig bzhag go smras pas/ dga' ste/ khyim gyi so tshis la'ang mkhas yid gtan du rung bas/ mi gdung ba bzhag par rigs so zer ba bzhin bzhag pas/ mos lus brgyan te/kho mo khyod la chags kyang sngar skabs ma byung gi re ba bsgrubs shig byas kyang /khye'u sran gzugs te/ kho bo yang khyod yid du 'ongs kyang / bram ze'i chos lugs la/ slob dpon gi chung ma la log par zhugs na/ tshe 'di phyir brlag pas gsod kyang 'di byed mi phod byas pas/ mo ngo tsha nas khro sems kyis sgyu bya bar bsams te/ slob dpon 'ong khar gosadabral/ gdong brad/ sdug bsngal gyisagos te sa la nyal lo/ /slob dpon gyisargyu mtshan drisapas/ gleng rin mi chog ces pas/ kho bo las snying nye ba yod dam ci nyes smros/ khyod can rtag tu sdod pa'i khye'u 'dis kho mo la nyal po sgugs pa/ ngas ma nyan pas 'di ltar byas so da 'di sod cig zer/ kho blon po chen po'i bu yin cing stobs shin tu che bas/ thub chod du mi rung / thabasakyis bsad do zer te/ khye'u can song nasakhyod las dang po pa so tshis kyis nyon mongs par ma gyur tam/ kho bo ni khyod kyi drin dran pas gsang ba'i chos gzhan la ma bstan pa gcig yod pas khyod la bstan no zer/ khye'u pus btsugs te zhus pas/ khyod zhag bdun dge ba bsrungs te/ mi stong gi mgo bo chod la sor mo'i phreng ba rgyan du gyis shig des tshangs par skye'o zer ba la/ kho shes rab shin tu che bas slob dpon lhar skye ba'i rgyu ni de min na ji skad zer/ bden par smra zhing khro mi bya/ /slong la chung yang sbyin par bya/ /dngos po 'di gsum ldan gyur na/ /lha yi gnasasu nges—37—

mkhyen brtse'i 'od snang las/ spyod 'jug sgrung 'grel/par skye/ zher gyi/ srog bcad pasalha thob bo zhes ma gsungasabyasapa/ bram ze na re khyod nga'i chos la the tshom za bas/ dam tshig nyams so zer/ der kho kha rog bsdad pas bzhin 'gyur bar rig nas/ bar der bram ze la pha rol gyi snying sgul ba'i ngan sngags yod pa btab pas/ zhe sdang skyes pa la/ ral gri la sngags btab te bskur btang bas/ zhag bdun gyi bar du mi dgu brgya go dgu bsad do/ khi+or mo ji snyed pa rgyan du byasaso/ /de thamasacad kyis thosate rgyu 'grul chad do/ /ma'i bsam pa la 'dod khams kyi sems can zhag bdun zas ma myong na 'chi snyam nas zas khyer phyin pa dang / ma gsad par bsams te rgyugs pa dang / ma na re nga ni khyod shir dogs pas zas skyel gyis/ nga gsad na mtshams med 'ongs byas pas/ nga'i slob dpon gyi man ngag yin pas/ ma mi gsad pa thabs med do zer/ slob dpon ci zer/ 'dir ltar ro/ to na nga'i sor mo chod la khyer zhig /khyod la mtshams med kyang mi 'ong sor mo yang tshang bas so/ /des mi phan pas bsad dgos zer bar der sangs rgyas kyis khong 'dul ba'i dus la bab par mkhyen nas/ kho'i mthong sar byon pa dang /ma gsod mi dgos btsun pa pha gi bsad pas chog par 'dug snyam nas/ ral gri khyer te rgyugs pa na/ sangs rgyas ga le gshegs kyang khos ma zin par/btsun pa sdod gcig byas pas/ de ci la zer/ nga ni rtag tu sdod sdod pa yin/khyod ni rtag tu 'gro ba yin gsung / kho dran pa rnyed de dge sbyong de skad bya ba ci la zer/ bka' stsal ba/ nga ni tshul khrims bsrungs pas lha dang mi'i nang du rtag tu sdod sdod pa'o/ khyu+od ni slob dpon ngan pa'i man ngag la brten nas —38—

spyod 'jug sgrung 'grel las 'bras gsal ba'i me long zhes bya ba bzhugs/srog bcad pas ngan song du rtag tu 'gro 'gro ba'o gsungs/ skabs der 'gyod pa skyes te/ ral gri sa la skyur/ kha nas khrag skyugs te/ dge slong khyod la skyabs su mchi'o zer/ rab tu byung bar zhus nas/ sangs rgyas kyis kyang dge slong 'ongs pa legs so gsungs pas dge slong du gyur te man ngag phog nas bsgoms pas dgra bcom thob bo/ /de ltar gyur kyang da dung mi'i rgyu 'grul chad pa la/ sangs rgyas kyis/ mi gdung sor phreng can ni nga yin na/ ngasani srog chags grog sbur gcig kyang gsod ma myong ngo gyis la sgra sgrogs shig gsungs pas/ bdag gis ni mi dgu brgya go dgu bsad na/ bdag la brdzun mi mchi'am zhus pas/ khyod so skye'i dus su bsad kyi/ 'phags par gyur nas gcig kyang ma bsad pa'i phyir brdzun mi 'ong gsungs pa bzhin bsgrags pas sor phreng can sangs rgyas kyis gdul snyam nas 'grub bar gyur to/ /de'i tshe gsal rgyal dpung bcas kyis sor phreng 'dul du yong bas rta gnyan yod du mgo bstan de 'gror ma 'dod pa la/ blon pos 'di na dge slong shin tu dbyangs snyan pa gcig yod pas so zer/ 'o na dpung bcas gnyan yod du sgyur zer ba bzhin bsgyur te/ sangs rgyas kyi spyan sngar de lta bu yod par gda' bas mjal cing phyag rten 'bul bar zhus pas/ phyag rten da lta phul/de nas mjal snying 'dod pa srid byas pas/ ci gsung / phyag rten bya ba mjal nas 'bul ba las/ sngon la 'bul ba ga na'ang ma mchis so zer te/ ma phul/de nas gzugs ngan pa mthong nas 'bul snying ma 'dod do/ /rgyal pos/ 'di lta bu'i rgyu mtshan zhus pas/ bka' bstsal pa/ sngon 'od srung gi bstan pa la —39—

mkhyen brtse'i 'od snang las/ spyod 'jug sgrung 'grel/rgyal po ling shri bya bas mchod rten gcig bya bar 'dod nas rmi lam du bram ze'i khye'u lngas mchod rten ni rin po che las byed dam zer ba rmis nas blon po bzhi la bgos nas/ gsum pos phyogs gsum 'byongs so/ /gcig gib/rgyal po glen pa 'di tsam ga la 'byongs zer nas bzhag go /phyis kun log nas phyogs gcig kyang byas te rin chen las grub pa khyad par 'phags pa gcig byung rjes/ blon po le lo can des kyang da tsam ci 'dra zhes ltar phyin pas khyad par can de byung bas kho'ang dad nas gser gyi dril gcig btags pas/ding sang tshe dang ldan pa snyan pa bzang ldan dang gang la 'byongs kyis skye ba lnga brgyar gzugs ngan no zhes sogs pa gsungs nas/ rgyal po 'khor bcas 'gro 'dod pa la/ mkhyen bzhin du drisapas/ sor phreng 'dul du zer/ 'dir dgra bcom gsungs pas/ 'o na mjal zer phyin pas/ sor phreng gi glo gog pas rgyal po rgyal lo/ tāspyi mtshan zhusapasasngon yang bred bred pa ste/ sngon bya shin tu gdug pa can de'i grib mas phog pa'i sems can thams cad kyang nyon mongs 'gro ba gcig ste/ bya de shing rtser babs nas skad grag pas shing grib la glang po che gcig yod pa rgyal lo/ /de lta bu'i bya dang glang chen ni 'di gnyis po zhes sogs gsung ngo / /༈ gti mug gi zug rngu ni/ bram ze gcig la bu byung ngo gcig shi nas/phyis gcig byung ba gsos pa'i thabs su lam po cher khyer la dge sbyong dang phrad na smon nam/ kun tu rgyu dang 'phrad na shis pa brjod zer bu bzhin byas pas dge sbyong gis smon lam btab nas lam par btags/ yang gcig gis lam —40—

spyod 'jug sgrung 'grel las 'bras gsal ba'i me long zhes bya ba bzhugs/chung bar btags/ yang gcig gis lam phran par btags/ des lo gcig la sidhe bud dha ma zin par rab tu byung nas lham gyi dri ma 'phyi ba dang phyag dar yang ma zin par yi mug ste lceb 'dod pa'i tshe/ sangs rgyas kyis 'dul ba'i dus la bab par mkhyen nas chos bstan pas dgra bcom pa thob nas dge slong ma la chos ston par bskos pa na/ nged sde snod gsum shes pa'i dge slong ma la/gti mug can gyi mthar thug lam phran lta bu bsko ba zer te brnyas pa la/ khri chen po brtsegs nas 'dir sangs rgyas dang 'dra ba'i dgra bcom zhig chos ston du 'ong zhes dril bsgrags pas/ mang du 'dus te khrel ba la rdzu 'phrul gyis khri la gshegs te chos rgya cher bstan pas skye bo du ma lus kyi rdzu 'phrul gyis kyang 'dun par byas sa/ /༈ nga rgyal gyi zug rngu ni/ bcom ldan 'das mnyan yod na bzhugs pa'i tshe/ de'i rgyal po gsal rgyal byed do/ /lho phyogs gser pa'i rgyal po ka pi na'i rgyal tshab ka pi na posaso/ /de la rgyal phran stong phrag so drug go /de'i dmag gang babs par me tog rlung gis btab pa bzhin 'gro la/ gzhan gyis dpal thos na bzhin mdog dmar por 'gyur ba zhig yod la/ de'i tshong pas dbus kyi ras bzang po bzhi gser pa'i rgyal po la phul bas/ 'di lta bu'i ras bzang po gang nas 'ongs/ dbus nasaso/ khril dbusade gang / de'i rgyal po ci/ de nga la phyag dang bca' 'bul du ci'i phyir mi 'ong / da ste zhag bdun na nga la phyag 'chal du ma byung na khyod kyis ming tsam yang med par bya'o/ /zhes gsal rgyal la bsrings pas/ skrag nas bcom ldan 'das la zhus pas/—41—

mkhyen brtse'i 'od snang las/ spyod 'jug sgrung 'grel/bka' bstsal pa/ nga bas rgyal po che ba gcig yod pas de la srings shig gis gsungs pa bzhin bsgo nas song ba dang / bcom ldan 'das kyi sgyur rgyal du sprul/ mo'u 'gal la sogs blon po dang / sna bdun dang / nye ba'i sna bdun sogs sprul/ kun dga' ra ba rin po che'i khang bzangs 'bos rim pa bdun gyi nang rin po che'i shing ljon pa rgyas pa sogs su sprul pa'i rgyal po/ pho nya bas mthong bas sngangs te/ bdag cag gi rgyal pos 'di la 'gran mi bzod mod/'on kyang yi ge dbul snyam du phul bas/ 'phrul gyi rgyal po'i rkang 'og tu bcug ste/ nga gling bzhi la dbang ba'i rgyal po yin/ glen pa khyod nga'i bka' thos nas 'gro 'chag za gsum na/ da ste zhag bdun na nga can ma slebs na khrims dang sbyor zhes bsrings pa thos pas/ bzhin mdog gyur te/ khri las langs nas ral gri bshams pa las 'phrul gyi rgyal po'i mthu dpal gleng bas 'gyod par gyur te/ drung du thal byung du 'gro mi rigs pas/ da dung lan gcig brtag go snyam nas/ pho nya mngags te/ nged phyag 'tshal du dmag dpung 'bum phrag bco brgyad/ rgyal phran stong so drug mchi na/ de dag rim gyis mchi'o/ /zhes pas/rgyal phran phyed bcas pa shog gsungs pas/ rgyal phran khri stong dang bcas pa phyag 'tshal nas/ 'di'i dpal dang byad gzugs bdag pas lhag kyang /stobs ni bdag tsam mi phod snyam pa dang / 'phrul gyi rgyal pos/ blon po la/nga'i gzhu 'ode la byin cig ces pas/ ka pin gyis blangs ma theg go /de nasa'aphrul gyi rgyal pos mthe'u chung gis brdungs te/ rgyud bsgrengs pas stong gsum g.yos so/ /de nas mda' zhig ltongs te 'phangs pas/ mda' lngar gyur te/—42—

spyod 'jug sgrung 'grel las 'bras gsal ba'i me long zhes bya ba bzhugs/de dag gis rtse mo la 'od zer grangs med byung nas/ pad mo shing rta'i phang lo tsam re la sgyur rgyal sna bdun can re re byung nas sems can gyi don byas pas/ka pin dga' mgu rangasate/ chos kyi mig rnam par dag go /rgyal phran rnamasatshim ste/ de nas rdzu'aphrul bsdus te/ sangs rgyas kyi sku dge slong gi dge 'dun gyis bskor ba bstan te/ gser pa'i rgyal po rab tu byung bar zhus nas/ ston pas kyang tshur shog 'ongs pa legs zhes pas/ dge slong du gyur te bsgrubs pas/ dgra bcam pa thab ba/ /༈ phrag dog gi zug rngu ni/ ston pa bya rgod phung por bzhugs pa'i tshe/ sku gser ma'i bsnyun cung zad kyis bzung nas/ 'tsho byed kyis sman sna so gnyis mar dang sbyar te/ nyin re la srang so gnyis gnyis gsol bas/ lhas sbyin gyis thos ste phrag dog skyes nas/ don grub gang za'i sman de tsam nga la yang sbyor te byin cig zer ba bzhin sbyar nas nyin re la srang bzhi bzhi las lhag pa ma za zhig byas pas/ don grub ci tsam za zer/ sangs rgyas nyin re la srang so gnyis gnyis gsol/ 'o na kho bo la yang de ma byin cig zer/ sangs rgyas dang khyod gnyis mi 'dra ste/ khyod kyis de tsam zos na nges par nad du 'gyur byas pas/zas ci tsam 'ju'i tshod kho bo rang la yod kyis/ don grub kyis 'ju na kho bo ci'i phyir mi 'apu don grub dang / pha ma'i rigs cho 'brang sogs gang yang /ma mnyam pa med na/ khyod kyis khyad cig shes sam zer ma nyan par srang so gnyis zos pas ma zhu bar rtsa kun tu zug nas/ lus 'gre ldog /ngag smre sngags/ sems mya ngan gyis non pa la thugs rjes rgyang nas phyag brkyangs te/—43—
