mkhyen brtse'i 'od snang las/ spyod 'jug sgrung 'grel/mgo la byugs ma thag sman kun zhu ste/ nad lasagrol ba dang / phyag yin par shes te/ don grub kyi lag sngon de reg pas cham pa ma byung khar rje che/ phyin chad ye ma reg gyis shig zer ba la/ 'tsho byed kyis sngar yang nad las bkrol/da dung na'ang byin brlabs zhu dgos mod byas pas/ nga nad pas ci byung yang don grub la re dus mi 'ong zer/ yang sang lhag ma gsol bar thos pas kho bo la yang byin zer/ khyod sngar lto nyen pas da gcig kyang bzar mi rung ngo byas kyang ma nyan par zos pas/ nang shugs su tshud de srog la thug pa/ kun dga' bos nu bo 'gum pa ma bzod nas byon par zhus pas/ sgra gcan 'dzin drung na 'dug da lta 'ong gis/ byasapas/ chagasasdang can de kho mi 'ong / sgra gcan 'dzin gyisachog /gzhan shi na'ang shi zer/ kun dga' bosaringasapar phyin te/da ni 'gum pa la thug pas/ myur du brtse bar dgongs su gsol zhus pas/rings par byon nas phyag spyi bor bzhag nas/ shin tu gus pa'i sgra gcan 'dzin dang shin tu sdang ba'i lha sbyin gnyis la byams pa'i sems su mnyam na/lha sbyin gyi nad 'di da lta nyid du drag par gyur cig gsungs pas 'phral du drags pas/ kho na re/ don grub kyis kyang shes bya'i rtsal du sman rgyob cig shes kyin 'dug ste/ kho rang rgas kar rgyags rten 'dra la phan mod/ nga kun de la mi re'o zer/ de nas tshe'i dus byas/ dbyen sogs lnga'i sdig 'bras kyis mnar med du lhung ba/ kun dga' bos 'od srung gi spyo ba la brten nas dgra bcom thob ste/ mig gi mngon shesakyisabaltasapas/ du kha ba gzigasanas ma bzod par sku gdung gcig bsnams te byon pas de dag gi sdug bsngal —44—

spyod 'jug sgrung 'grel las 'bras gsal ba'i me long zhesabya ba bzhugs/gzigs pas/ mnyam bzhag las g.yengs te/ ma mkhyen par dmyal srung la dris pas/ 'od srung mar me mdzad sogs su'i zer/ thub pa'i lha sbyin no byas pas/ de 'di na 'di ltar sdug bsngal lo zer/ 'di las nam thar dris pas/bka' ltar mi byed sems dpa' ni/ tshen tu gti mug smad pa'i gnas/ /sdig 'bras mi bzad bskal bar ni/ /sdug bsngal yang brgyud thar skabs med/ zher/ myur bar byon nasakhyod sdug bsngal lam byasapas/ btsun pa shin tu sdug bsngal lo zer/ ston pa la log sgrub byas pa'i sdig 'bras yin gyis/ nyid la skyabs su song la myur du gshegs shig byas pas/ kho bo kun dga' bo 'di la kha col med pa/ thal mo ya med brdeb tu gar rung / nga sdig gsog mkhan yin na/ kho sdig bsags yul yin/ kho rang la yang shog gyis zer ro/ de skad ma zer ston pa ni bde ba nas bde bar gshegs pa yin/nyes skyon thams cad spangs pa la sngar yang log sgrub byas pas 'di ltar sdug bsngal/ de'ang byas na thar blags med kyis/ sku gdung 'di la skyabs su song la / 'gyod sems kyis gshegs na grol bar gsungs so byas pas/ kho bo/kun dga' bo 'di la pho tshod ye mi 'dug /zer dgu bden par ma 'dzin/ smra tshad gtam du ma re/ sbang ma chu phyogs ma byed/ nga drung spun pas kho pha spun nye ba / dge sbyong g.yo sgyu can de'i rus gog la skyabs su song bya ba'i gtam gcig rang 'ong ba/ nga las ci la thug kyang / rgan zhugs rdzun rlabs can de'i rus dum la mgon skyabs re ba'i dus mi yong zer nas gtan 'khyams su song ngo /mdo kha cig nas gshegs ste brtson pas grol bar bshad cing / mdo kha cig 45—

mkhyen brtse'i 'od snang las/ spyod 'jug sgrung 'grel/nas ston pa'i che ba dbyung ba'i phyir sprul pa'i dge slong du byas pa'ang yod do/ /le'u gnyis pa'o// //ka3 le'u gsum pa'i skabs kyi gtam rgyud bshad pa/rgyal sras sala'ang yi rang ngo / khi dang desapa ye shesaldan/ /glang po gser mdog thams cad grol/ /dbang med bde stobs mchog rnams brgyad do/ /gsal rgyal gyis gzhan phan gyi blos/ sangs rgyas dge 'dun dang bcas pa la/ nyi ma bdun du bsnyen bkur dang rim gro rgya cher byas pa'i nyi ma dang po la / rgyal po khyed kyi dge ba bsngo'am/ khyod pas dge ba brgya 'gyur gyis che ba zhig gi dge ba bsngo gsung / de ring bdag las che ba cang yod dam snyam nas/bdag pas dge rlabs che ba de'i yon bsngo bar zhus pas/ sgo drung na sprang po sa da zhes pas/ rgyal po 'di gzhan phan gyi blos sangs rgyas 'khor bcas la bsnyen bkur mdzad pa ngo mtshar che snyam du theg chen gyi dge ba la yid rang khor yug tu byed pa de'i dge ba bsngos so/ /de bzhin du nyin drug gi bar du bsngos pas/ rgyal po mya ngan gyi phyag rgya bcas pa la/ de ci nongs/ 'di ltar ro zer/blon po thabs mkhas shig na re/ mi dgyesami 'tshal/ rgyal po'i bsngo ba 'grub pa'i thabs mchis kyis zer te/ sang thon ston la 'bras chan nyis 'gyur 'tshod du bcug ste/ 'dren dus phyed phyed pho la/ sprang po sdud pa kun brdungs shig ces pas/ sprang po kun 'khrugasanas yid rang shor te/ gzod rgyal po'i dge ba bsngosanasalung bstan thob bo/ /gzhan yang shing thun gcig —46—

spyod 'jug sgrung 'grel las 'bras gsal ba'i me long zhes bya ba bzhugs/gi chung mas/ drang srong gcig la 'bras tshod drangs pa la khyos yid rang byas pas nang du gter thon no/ /sman dang sman pa nyid dag dang / dkon brtsegs las/ zhi ba'i blo gros 'das pa'i dus na 'dzam gling 'dir mi rnams la nad sna tshogs byung nas gzer ma btub ste smre sngags sna tshogs 'don pa na/ ston pa 'di de'i tshe rtsa gsum gyi brgya byin mig bzang su gyur pas mngon shes kyis 'di lta bu phan par mkhyen te/myur bar 'dzam gling dbus ku ru zhes pa'i grong dang ha cang yang mi ring sar/des pa zhes pa'i srogs chags su brdzus te skyes nas/ bar snang nas/ mi rnamasal smras pa/ ku ru zhes bya'i grong khyer na/ /desapa zhesabya'i srog chagasayod/ /de yi sha la su za ba/ /de ni nad rnamasakun lasathar/ zhesapa ltar/de'i sha zos ma thag nad las thar cing / tshe stobs phun sum tshogs par gyur te/ sha yang zad par ma gyur to/ khaṃ rnams na re sman dang sman pa'i sgo nas drin lan btang rag bgyi'o bka' stsol cig zer ba la/ bar snang la lha lus su 'dug nas/ kho bo rtsa gsum 'tsho byed des par bstan pa de/ nga la zas nor mchod pa mi dgos kyis/ mi dge bcu spongs la byams snying rje bskyed cig ces pas lus bde bar ma zad sems kyang bde ba'i rgyu byas pas bka' bzhin bgyi'o/ /zer ba bzhin bsgrubs pas thams cad byang chub thob bo/ /de yi nad g.yog byed par shog /ting nge 'dzin rgyal por/ myur du sangasargyas par 'dod pas/ chos smra ba na ba la rim gro bya'o/ /de'ang 'dasapa'i dusan sangs rgyas smon lam khyad 'phags rgyal po 'jig rten du byon nas/ sangs —47—

mkhyen brtse'i 'od snang las/ spyod 'jug sgrung 'grel/rgyas pa'i nyin par sprul pa sna tshogs kyis sems can du ma theg pa gsum gyi 'bras bul bkod nas/ phyi dro mya ngan las 'das shing / dam pa'i chos lo bye ba stong du gnas te/ bstan pa'i gzugs brnyan la spyod pa'i tshe/ gling bzhi la dbang ba'i rgyal po ye shes stobs kyi slob dpon chos smra ba yan lag blo gros sam yang dag blo grosakyang zer/ 'brum bu me sbal nag pos zin nas sman pa kun gyis kyang spangs te/ 'gum pa la thug pa'i tshe/ rgyal po 'khor bcas ngu zhing mya ngan byed pa na/ rgyal po'i srung ma lha mo ye shes mchog gis/ rgyal po yab sras kyi rmi lam du/ 'di la mi'i gson khrag gis byugs shing gson sha'i snag khu byin na sos so zhes bstan to/ khyol pos thams cad bsogs te/ spro ba dris pas gcig kyang ma byung bar/ rgyal po'i bu mo ye shes ldan lo bco lnga lon pa des bdag gi lus don yod par bya'o/ /snyam ste/ rang gi gnas su song ste/rtsa bo che kha phye nas khrag gis khyab par byugs te/ sha bcad nas snag khur byas pa drangs pas dge slong nad las grol te chos bstan pas srog chags du ma phyir mi ldog pa'i 'bras bu la bkod do/ /rgyal pos bu mo la khyod kyis sman de dag gang nas rnyed dris pas/ lha mos lung bstan pa la/ su'ang spro ba ma byung bas/bdag gis lus btang ba la gso zhes so/ /'o na khyod rang lus la zug gzer skyed pa la 'gyod pa med dam dris pas/ de 'das na chos kyang nub la 'gro kun mdongs par 'gyur bas/ bdag gi don de tsam grub pa la ga la 'gyod zer/mi 'gyod pa'i dpang por su yod dris pas/ gal te 'gyod na da lta 'gum pa dang / mi 'gyod na bdag lus sngar bzhin du gyur cig ces pas/ lus sngar —48—

spyod 'jug sgrung 'grel las 'bras gsal ba'i me long zhes bya ba bzhugs/bzhin du gyur nas rgyal po 'khor bcasayi rang ngo / /gzhon nu/ nga nyid de'i tshe ye shesaldan no/ dge slong mar me mdzad do/ /rgyal po ni byamasapa'o/ /lha mo ni mi zhabrugasapa'o/ /zhesaso/ /bdag ni zasadang skom du gyur/ snyon pa ni sngar rtsi shing du 'bab chu sogs kyis mdzes pa/ mya ngam gyi thang gis bskor bas grong dang thag ring ba zhig na/ glang chen zhig tu gyur te/ re zhig mthar rgyu ba na/smre sngags kyi smra zhig thos te snying rjes ltar phyin pas/ rtswa chu sogs kyi bsgribs g.yogs med pa'i mya ngam gyi thang de la mi rid stobs zad mang po zhig 'dug pas/ glang chen gangs ri 'gro zhes pa lta bu de mthong te 'jigs yang bkres ngal gyis 'bros ma nus pa'i tshe/ des khyed nga la skrag mi dgos zhes dbugs phyung ste/ drung du phyin nas rgyu mtshan dris pas/ glang po mi skad smra bas sems rtas te phyag byas nas smras pa/ bdag cag rgyal po mi srun pas yid dang mi mthun pa cung zad kyi rkyen gyis spyugs na/ da bdag cag rnams sdug bsngal 'di las skyabs su gsol zer/ khyed du yod dris pas/ stong las gum pa'i lhag ma bdun brgya tsam mo/ k+ṣ-ing rjes 'di dag thar pa'i skabs gzhan med bdag gi lus btang snyam nas/ sna sbrul mgo ltar phyar te smras pa/ ri bo pha gi'i 'gram na chu gtsang gis gang pa'i mtsho 'gram na/ ri nas lhung ba'i glang po'i ro zhig yod kyis de'i shas lam rgyags dang rgyu mas chu snod byas te lam 'di nas phyin na thar ro zhes smras nas/ lam gzhan nas rings par song nas/ri'i khar 'dzegs te/ bdag gis nyams thag pa'i skye bo 'di rnams bsgral ba'i bsod nams kyis sems can thams cad kyi mgon skyabs su gyur cig —49—

mkhyen brtse'i 'od snang las/ spyod 'jug sgrung 'grel/ces smon te/ rang gi sdug bsngal la mi lta bar de dag skyabs pa'i phyir mchongs so/ /de'i ro de dag gisamathong nas sngar gyi de dang 'dra ste de'i nye ba zhig go zer/ kha cig sa g.yos sogs kyis ltasadang sbyar na 'ong / 'o skol gyi don du nyid rang lhung bas/ 'di'i sha za mi phod pas mchod sbyin du sreg zer ro/ kha cig khong rang gi thugs dgongs bzhin byas na ngos drin sobs zer zhing thams cad ma mdzangs ma shi ba'i bu bzhin mya ngan byed do/ /der khong rang zer ba bzhin byas te/ mya ngan de las thar nas glang po'i rus pa bsdus nas sku gdung byas nas bla ma bzhin dus mchod la brtson par gyur to/ /zas dang skom gyi char phab ste/ ṣā+on byung ba 'das pa'i dus na rgyal po gser mdog gi yul du lo bcu gnyis su char mi 'bab ces ltas mkhan gyis bstan pas/ yod dgu khod mnyam pa ste brtsis kyang 'phral skyes mang posazos pas lo bcu gcig las ma thub pa na/ rgyal po nyid la 'bras chan bre'u gang lus pa/ rang rgyal zhig gis tshogs rdzogs par mkhyen nas bsod snyoms la byon pas rgyal pos/ da nges par 'chi snyam la/ 'di ni gser mdog gi sbyin pa'i tha ma yin te 'khor rnams yi rang byos shig ces smon lam btab ste phul bas/ de'i mod la 'dzam gling kun tu zas gos sogs ci 'dod pa'i char babs so/ /de'i tshe rgyal po ni nga nyid do gsungs so/ /༈ phangs pa med par btang bar bya/ /thams cad sgrol sbyin pa la dpa' ches nas glang po'i mchog bram ze la byin pas shi pi ba rnams khros te/ ri bo 'bang khar sprugs pa'i tshe'ang shing rta dang gzhon nu gnyis dang / btsun mo'ang —50—

spyod 'jug sgrung 'grel las 'bras gsal ba'i me long zhes bya ba bzhugs/byin pas/ shi pi ba rnams kyang yid rang nas slar gyi rgyal srid la btsud pa sogs te/ mdor na/ skyes rabs las/ tshong dpon gnyis dang ri bong dang /thams cad sgrol dang mchod sbyin no/ zhes sogs sbyin pa las brtsams pa bcu po 'dir yang / sbyin pa'i skabs su rgyas bsdus ci rigs su bshad do/ /༈ mi zad gter yang 'di yin no/ /sngon byung 'dasapa'i dusan/ wārā ṇa sī na/ rgyal po dbang chen sde la chos dang 'jig rten gyi srid phun sum tshogs pa'i tshe/ nyi 'og gi rgyal pos dpung bshams te wārā ṇa sīr yul btab nas 'dug go /dbang chen sdesa'akhor rnamasal/ nga tsho gcig gi 'tsho ba tsam gi phyir sdig byed mi phod kyis/ khyed rnams nyi 'og gi rgyal po la phyag tshol cig gsungs pa bzhin byas te dbang chen sde rang nyid nags su song ste rtsa ba dang 'bras bu za zhing 'dug go /de'i tshe bram ze dbul po zhig dbang chen sdesaci 'dod ster bar thos nas phyin pa na/ rgyal pos nga chings la nyi 'og gi rgyal po'i drung du khyer zhig khyod la ci 'dod ster ro smras pas/ bram ze na re ngas ni khyod 'ching mi phod do zer yang / rang nyid kyi bcings nas byin te/ bram zes nyi 'og gi rgyal po la smras pa/ 'di ni lha'i dgra lags te/ bdag gis bzung ste mchisaso/ /nyi 'og rgyal pos bsamasapar/ 'di stobs che ba/ bram ze nyamasachung 'dis bcing ga la nus/ 'di rang gis rang bcings nas bram ze 'di la byin nges so snyam nas/ bram ze la 'di ji ltar bcings drang por smros shig ces pas/ bram zes kyang drang por smras pas/ nyi 'og ngo mtshar nas bzod pasagasol te/ rgyal srid slar phul nas rang gi yul du song ngo / /bram ze'ang nor —51—

mkhyen brtse'i 'od snang las/ spyod 'jug sgrung 'grel/gyisatshim par byas te/ thams cad dge ba bcu la bkod do/ /dge slong dag nga nyid de'i tshe rgyal po dbang chen sder gyur to zhes so/ /༈ dam chos 'o ma bsrubs pa las/ khri)la po stobs mchog gis rgya mtsho bsrubs pas/ nyi zla dang / dug bum dang / chang zhes pa'i bud med dang /bud med bum pa gang sogs byung ba bzhin no/ /le'u gsum pa'o// //ka4 le'u bzhi pa'i skabs kyi gtam rgyud bshad pa/sngags kyis rmongs par byas pa bzhin/ bden pa mthong ba gzugs can snying po la/ sgyu ma mkhan dge bzhin gyis sgyu ma'i gzigs mo zhig kyang 'bul/bka' phabs shig kyang zhu byas pas/ rgyal po na re/ ngas chos thams cad sgyu mar bltas shing mthong zer/ 'o na bdag gis sang sgyu ma zhig sprul gyis de ltar mkhyen par mdzod cig byas te/ rgyal po ci la mnyes phag tu dris pas/ rta bzang po la'o zer/ des cha lugs bsgyur te/ sgyu sngags kyis rmongs par byas pa'i rta bzang po zhig sprul te khyer phyin nas mjal bar zhus pas rin gyis zer/rta mchog 'gro ba'i tshe na shes pas/ nga rang gis brtag dgos zer/ 'di ni thul dka'o zhus pas/ ngas rta rgod gang yang mi thul ba med pa gsungs nas bzhon pas ring du khyer te/ yul mtha' zhig tu skyur bas rta ma zin par rmos pa zhig 'dug pa la bza' btung blangs pas/ glang ma shor bar rmos ded gyis shig /blang ngo zer ro/ /rmos pas shor nas drud de/ srog la thug pa tsam du sdug bsngal/ kho na re/ gang nas gang du 'gro zer ba la rgyu mtshan bshad pas/—52—

spyod 'jug sgrung 'grel las 'bras gsal ba'i me long zhes bya ba bzhugs/da 'gro khungs med na nga'i bu mo sbyin gyis sdod zer te bsdad pas bu sring gnyis byung ste/ gyos sgyug gnyis shi ba'i ro rim bzhin bskyal/ de nas chung ma'ang shi ba'i ro skyel ba la bu sring gis 'jus nas ngu rkyen gyis rgyal pos kyang ngus te nga bsod nams che nas rgyal por/ chung nas 'di lta zhes smre ba la/ dge bzhin gyis se gol gtogs te/ rgyal po ci nongs zhes pas/ rgyal po shu na sku rid par song ste 'dug go /der thamasacad sgyu mar gzigasanas/ bdag la sdang zhid / rmos pa pha bur chen pa sdug bsngal gyi rgyu lags mod ces pas/ rgyal po skyengs te lan med par gyur to/ /le'u bzhi pa'o// //ka5 le'u lnga pa'i skabs kyi gtam rgyud bshad pa/stag dang seng ge glang chen dred/ k+ṣi+oṃn wārā ṇa sīr/ rin chen go cha la/btsun mo lnga brgya yod kyang bu med par mya ngan gyi phyag rgyas nyal ba'i rmi lam du lhas bstan pa/ phyi rol na drang srong lcags mdog dang gser gyi mdog can gnyis yod kyis/ gser mdog la bur gsol ba thob cig ces rmis nas/dge slong don pha'u glang po'i mchog /la bu dge tshul ut+pal mig /la ba pu dbyer su ta pa/ /tshong dpon gser yig de dpon dang / snyun chung ma te bcu gsum mo/ /gsol ba btab pa khasablangasapas/ gcig gisakyang ngo / /de gnyis shi nas chen chun gyi mngal du zhugs pa zhag bdun gyi rim pa bur shes terim gro skyed de zla ba tshang nas btsas pa mtshan mkhan la bstan pas dge don sdig don du btags te/ gtsug lag thams cad la mkhas par bslabs shing /—53—

mkhyen brtse'i 'od snang las/ spyod 'jug sgrung 'grel/cher skyes nas skyed mos tshal ltar phyin pas/ 'bangs thams cad bya ba so sos nyams thag pa dris pas/ pha mes rigs rgyud nas/ so nam na bzhis rang yang 'tshong zhing / rgyal po'i bca'ang 'bul zer bas de dag la snying rje bzhin du nags su byon pas/ yengs te gcig pur gol ba'i lam na/ chu bran cig 'dug pa yid du 'ong nas smras pa/ phu chu'i rgyun sgra rnga ltar snyan pa khyod/ /gang nasa'ongasashing gang du 'gro/ /ku co ma che ji ltar rings/ /yud tsam 'dug la gtam gsum thong / /zhesapa'i lan du/ ngas/ da nang skye med gangasadakar gyi steng nasa'ongs/ /do nub 'gag med rgya mtsho'i klong du 'gro/ /ku co bdag med stong pa'i rang sgra yin/ /mi sdod 'dus byas 'jig pa'i dpe ru rings/zer bas/ 'di ni sprul pa'i 'bab chu'o snyam nas/ yang smrasapa/ nga yang dge don rgyal po'i bu/ /srog dang bcasapa'i dpal yang g.yo/ /rigasaldan byang chub sgrub rnams kyis/ /lam gyi dang po gang la bslab/ rtes pa'i lan du/khyod sngon bram ze 'phrin gyur tshe/ /skyob ba mar me mdzad dpal gyis/ /lam gyi dang po sbyin pa zhes/ /rgya cher gsungs pa bsnyel lam ci/ 9u bskul te/sngar gyi sdug phongs gzigs pa'i rkyen gyis mi dga' nas/ ngu bzhin du yab kyi drung du phyag byas te/ bdag 'chag pa na/ bran 'bangs thams cad lho'i phyir sdig sdug sna tshogs kyis nyams thag pa 'di dag bskyab pa'i phyir/ sbyin pa gtong gi yo byad stsal du gsol/ zhes pas yab na re/ ngas nor mdzod thams cad khyod kho na'i ched du bzung ba yin gyis/ ci bde bar byin cig /cesapa'i lung thob nas/ thams cad du ci 'dod pa sbyin pa la zhugasaso/ /de nasamadzod —54—

spyod 'jug sgrung 'grel las 'bras gsal ba'i me long zhes bya ba bzhugs/bsrungs kyis mdzod phyed zad do byas pas zad kyang bla zer/ da ni sum gnyis zad do byas pas/ ngas bu'i ngo mi bzlogs kyis/ khyod kyis thabs legs kyis khog cig gi lung thob nas/ mdzod sgo btsud de gzhan du phyin pas/ 'dis 'di mi nus kyis/ yab kyi lung thob par nges la/ spyir yang bus pha'i mdzod stong par byar mi rigs la/ da nor gyis sems can la phan thogs pa'i thabs drisapas/ zhing / tshong / 'brog /gling zhesasosonasazer ba'i phyi ma yid la babs nas/ yab la zhus pas/ khyod sbyin pa byed 'dod na/ khyim na ci 'dod yod thams cad byin la/ nyam nga ba'i gnas rgya mtshor 'gror mi gnang ngo zer te/ 'dod pa ma grub par zas bcad de nyal ba la/ thams cad kyis gros btab kyang ma nyan par/ zhag drug lon nas/ da ni do nub ma zos na 'chi bas/de bas rgya mtsho nas ldog kyang srid do zhes bgros te gnang bas/ ded dpon dge dpal la zhus pas ma nyan par/ rgyal pos bsngags pas/ bdag lo brgya nyi shu lon zhing / mig rna yang med pas mi nus mod/ 'on kyang rgyal po'i bka' bcag tu mi rung ngo zhes khas blangs so/ /der sdig don yang 'gran nas/ tshong pa lnga brgya dang bcas pa chas te/ pha mas bskyal nas/ thag pa bdun rim gyis btul nas/ rlung 'dod phyogs nas langs te/ stobs po che'i mda' bzhin song nas/ rin chen gling du slebs te/bzang ngan dang mang nyung dang / lci yang sogs kyi tshad bstan nas sdig don la 'di dag 'go thon cig byas nas/ khong rang ded dpon dang gnyis yid bzhin btsal ba'i phyir gzings chung zhig tu zhugs te song ba yang zhig nas/ rkyal —55—

mkhyen brtse'i 'od snang las/ spyod 'jug sgrung 'grel/bsaded dpon chad de/ ri dkar/ sngo/ ser/ sna lnga'am/ de dag gser dngul be+eḍūr+ya'i ri'o/ /gser ri de'i mdun na gser gyi bye ma zhig yod kyis der ngal bsos shig zer nas/ da nga 'chi bas/ khyed gser ri 'di'i g.yas nas phyin pa na/ lam gyi gsang stong nas/ stag seng sbrul srin sogs bza' ba'i bsam pa 'ong ste/ de dag la byamasapa'i blosasong zhig /de dag dul nasapha ma'i 'du shes kyis gnas so/ te nas rin chen bdun gyi mkhar zhig yod do/ /de'i sgo rdos brdungs pas/ lha mo lnga brgyas so so nasanor bu 'bul lo//de nas lha mo lhag par gzugs bzang ba zhig gis nor bu sngon po zhig phul te/de yid bzhin yin pas/ de ma thobade thob ma thag ma shor bar bzung la/chags zhen med par sems can la byams brtse'i sems kyis dbang po'i sgo sdoms la myur du bros shig /de cilam̐ phyir na/ yid bzhin shin tu dkon pas/klu dag phrag dog cing 'dod pa srid pasaso/ /zer nasatshe'i dusabyasaso/ /de nas de'i dus bu la bskor ba byas te bye ma la sbas nas/ ded dpon gyi ngag bzhin phyin pas/ de bzhin du thob nas nor bu'i mthus de ma thag tu slebs nas sdig don dang 'phrad de/ tshong pa rnams dris pas/ gzings nya mid kyis bcom nas/ ngas ro la 'jusapa gcig pur thon pa'o/ /tshong pa snying rje te/khyod thon pa'i legs so byas pas/ nor med par gson kyang ci rung zer/de'i mya ngan mi dgos nga la yid bzhin yod kyis zhes bstan pas phrag dog skyes pa'i tshe/ dge don gyis nga dub pas gnyid log gis/ khyed kyis nga dang nor bu la gnod pa bsrungs shig ces pas/ glags rnyed de mig tu tsher ma btsugs —56—

spyod 'jug sgrung 'grel las 'bras gsal ba'i me long zhes bya ba bzhugs/nas nor bu khyer te bros pas/ de bsad kyis dogs nas/ chom rkun byung ngo nor bu khyer la bros shig byas pas/ lhas chom rkun sdig don nyid zer bas/yi mug nas bros pas/ dred gnas su song ste/ za 'dod de/ drung du phyin pas bu bzhin gyur nas tsher ma bton nas li shi'i ri 'dabs su bskyal bas/ glang khyu'i brdzi ba khyu mchog gis bskyabs te mig la ldag pas zug ngu med par byas so/ /de nas glang rdzis gsos pas/ de'ang skyo bar shes te/ li shi'i grong 'dabs su+o bskyal pas/ rol mo dang legs bshad kyis kun dga' bar byas nas sprang pa lnga brgya yang sas sa/ /de nas rgyal pos skyed mos tshal bsrung bar bskos pas mig med pas so zer mig med kyang bla'i/ skye shing la g.yer kha btags te/ the gus 'then la bsrungs shig ces pas thams cad 'dus te/ rgyal po'i bu mo yang bdag ni 'di dang zas lhan cig za zer ba la/ sprang po dang lhan cig zos nas rgyal pos chad pa yong byas kyang ma nyan par/ dgong mo'ang bos kyang bdag 'di'i khyim thab tu 'dug pas nang du mi 'ong zer/ khyod ni dge don la byin tshar na/ sprang po la dga' ba smyos sam zhes bkag kyang ma khegs par gnyis ka khab tu blangs te bzhag go /der bu mo gzhan du song ba la/ khyod skyes pa gzhan dang / spragasaso byas pas/ khyod sprang long zhig la ngas gtam khyad du bsad de dga' bar byas pa la khyod snyon 'debs pa mi rigs mod/ 'on kyang nga skyes pa gzhan la rdul tsam zhig kyang sems pa yod na bdag kyang long zhig /de med na khyod kyi mig gcig gis mthong bar gyur cig ces pas/ mig gnyis gsal bar gyur pa —57—

mkhyen brtse'i 'od snang las/ spyod 'jug sgrung 'grel/ dang / khyod kyis nga su yin shes sam/ shes te sprang po dmu long ngo / rin chen go cha'i bu dge don thos sam/ de nga yin no/ /de la dpang po su yod zer ba la / de nga yin na bdag gi mig ya gcig gis kyang mthong bar gyur cig byas pas/ mig gnyisaka 'gran pa bzhin gyur to/ /der bu mosargyal po la glengasate/ bzod par gsol nas/ rgyang grags gcig skyed de/ gdod rgya mtsho nas 'khor ba skad byas te bsus nas/ bu mo yang byin te/ yo byad thams cad kyis bskur ro/ /sdig don yul du slebasanas/ dge don dang / tshong pa thamasacad shi'o zhes pas thams cad rgyal ste/ sangs pa dang / dge don chung ngu'i rtser grogs ngang pa dkar po'i mgul du yi ge btags te rgya mtsho'i bar du btsal bas der rnyed nas/ sdig don gyis 'di ltar byas so zhes pa'i yi ge lan bskur bas/ sdig don khri mon du bcug ste de/ li shi la nga'i bu g.yog dang bcas te ma bskyal na/ nga da dung bcas der 'ong zhes bsrings pas/ skyug nas rta glang lnga brgya nor gyis mnan te/ bu mo g.yog dang bcas pa bskyal pas/ yab yum gyis bsu ba la phyag byas nas/ sdig don drisapas/ khri mon na yod de/ de btang du mi rung zer/ 'o na bdag kyang nang du mi mchi'o/ /zhesapas/ btang nas nu bo la bsnyun sman de lhag par byams so/ /gleng langs te nor bu lam du sbas pa btsal kyang ma rnyed par dge don gyis phyin pas nor bus rgyang grags gcig bsu de rnyed pa la/ 'di nor bu yin yang dag na/ bdag gi pha ma'i mig gsal ba dang / khang khri na bza' gdugs sogs thams cad rin chen las grub pa dang / sngar sbyin gtong gis zad pa'i mdzod kun lhag par yang 'byor —58—

spyod 'jug sgrung 'grel las 'bras gsal ba'i me long zhes bya ba bzhugs/par gyur cig byas pa bzhin gyur te/ der dus bzang po la gos gtsang gyon/ nas khrus byas te/ rgyal mtshan gyi rtse la btags te yid bzhin yin yang dag na/thams cad du ci 'dod 'bab par gyur cig ces pas/ rlung gis mi gtsang ba phyags te/ char gyis mnan nas/ zas gos 'bru dbyig sogs 'dod dgu babs te/ thams cad gang gis kyang 'bral ba med pa'i tshe/ ngas lus srog la ma bltas par 'bral 'bras 'dzam gling kun phongs pa rgyun chad pas/ thams cad kyis sdig bcu spongs/ dge bcu bsgrubs shig ces/ bkar btags te/de bzhin bsgrubs pas/ shi ba thams cad kyang lhar skyes so/ /spong ba'i sems ni thob pa la/ mi pha bu gnyis yod pa gnyis ka dge slong byas pa na/ pha shin tu dka' thub la gnas pas/ droyol na mi gsol bas/de lta na pha rgud par dwogs nas/ 'grogs te phyin pa'i tshe myur bar bskul kyang /pha 'gros zhan pa la/ bus rgyab nas phul bas/ mgo rdo la thug ste shi yang /bu de rtsa gsum gyi lhar skyes pa ni theg chen pas sems gtso bos so/ /khro ba'i sems 'di gcig bcom na/ /rgyal po gtsug na rin po ches/ /glang po'i mchog bram ze la byin pa rgyal phran cig la btsongs te/ des nyid dmag drangs pas/ tshe 'di'i phyir sdig mi nus gsung ngo / rgyal srid kyang de la byin no/ /sems gsal cig skyed 'bras bu yang / lda bu gnyis chus khyer ba na byang sems gsal por skyes pas shi 'phos nas tshangs par skyes so/ /bud med khrod na gnas kyang rung / stan pa 'das nas ring po ma lon pa'i —59—

mkhyen brtse'i 'od snang las/ spyod 'jug sgrung 'grel/tshe/ yul ang gha dha na khrims lnga bsrung ba'i bram ze zhi dpal ces pa rnam thos kyi bu ltar 'byor pa gcig la/ mchod gnas gser mchog zhes pa sde snod gsum mkhyen cing / bslab gsum 'dzin pa sbyangs pa'i yon tan la gnas pa de/ nyin re bzhin gdugs tshod la spyan 'dren pa la/ lam du tsha drang gi nyon mongs shing / dge sbyong gi bar du gyur pas/ phyin chad skyes par zhus so/ /yul de'i khyim bdag gi bu gcig bstan pa la dad nas/ ston pa dam pa la brten par 'dod nas/ dge slong de la zhus pas/ de'i lha mig dag pas gzigs pa na/ tshul khrims kyi snyan grags phyogs bcur rgyas te/ bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan 'dzin pa zhig 'byung bar shes nas/ dge tshul du byas ste lha mchog ces btags so/ /dge bsnyen gyi khyim gang gi mi kun mdza' bos ston mo la bos te/ de'i bu mo bde dpal zhes pa lo bcu drug lon pa de khyim bsrung du bcug go /de na de dag gis mi rgyud tshun chad kyi mchod gnas bram ze g.yon can na gu le zhes pa/ de dag la phrag dog pas skur ba gdab pa'i skabs rnyed de/ gser mchog can phyin nas/ dge bsnyen brel bas gdugs tshod blang bar rigs so zhes bskul bas/ long med na za spyod pa mi rigs kyis/ khyod bag yod par gyis la zas longs shig ces pas/ lha mchog gi bka' bzhin bgyi'o/ /zhes mkhan po'i rkang pa la phyag 'tshal te song bas/ sgo brdung ba la/bu mos su yin dris pas/ bdag mkhan pos bsod snyoms len du btang byas pas/ bu mo dga' ste bdag gi bsam pa grub mod/ 'on kyang 'di gnyen po goms shing / tshul khrims la gshes spras che bas/ glags rnyed dka' bas —60—

spyod 'jug sgrung 'grel las 'bras gsal ba'i me long zhes bya ba bzhugs/brtag go snyam nas/ bu mos sdig pa'i gzugs shig byas/ bran mo lha rten gyi phag tu sbas te/ sdig gzugs 'di la skrag na bden pa ma mthong nges kyis/khyod kyi tshul khrims ma dag pa de thong la/ bu mo dang lhan cig bde ba'i ro myangs pas gnyen po'i stobs 'phel te/ slar blangs nas bsrungs na myur du grol lo zhes lhas bstan pa'i tshul du smros shig byas te/ sdig gzugs skyur bas sngangs pa na/ bran mos smras pa'i rjes su 'jam pos gleng ste/ khyim 'di'ang rnam thos kyi dpal ltar 'byor kyang bdag la ming po med pas/ khyod kyis bdag po mdzod cig /bdag gisakhol mo bgyid do/ /de min na'ang / lhasabastan pa bzhin de ring bdag gi re ba bsgrubs la/ slar blangs te bsrungs na stobs che bar thob kyis/ phyin chad lhag par yang zhabs thog go zhes pas/ dge tshul 'di snyam du/ kye ma/ 'di'i 'dod chags kyi mes bdag gi tshul khrims kyi shing sreg go /bros te bltas na sgro skur sna tshogs kyis bram ze dag gis 'dod pa'ang grub la/ bsdad na ni sangs rgyas kyi rigs sun phyung ste bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan bcag par gyur gyi/ de bas srog chad pa bla'i/ bcas pa nyams na mi rung ngo snyam nas/ bu mo la khyod kyis sgo chod cig /kho bos cho ga cung zad cig bya'o/ /zhegakhang phugs su song ste/ chosagosagadang bu la gzar nas/ thal mo sbyar te/ bdag dkon mchog mkhan po sogs spong ba min gyis/ tshul khrims mi spang ba'i slad du/ lus spangs pas khrims 'bras dal 'byor thob nas/ gzhon nu la rab tu byung ste/ lam goms 'bras sangasargyas myur du thob par rgyur cig khresasmosanas/ spu grisamagul ba bcad de tshe 'phosaso bu —61—

mkhyen brtse'i 'od snang las/ spyod 'jug sgrung 'grel/mos/ thogs te bos kyang ma byung bar nang du phyin pa dang / tshe 'phos pa mthong ste nas sngangs te/ 'dod chags kyi me zhi/ mya ngan gyi mtsho rdol/ 'gyel te rgyal ba'i tshe/ phas 'khor te sgo brdung kyang ma thos par grong rgyud de 'ongs pas/bu mo rgyal ba mthong nas chu gtor dris pas/ drang por smras nas ngo tsha zhing /dge tshul gyis rkyal ka byas so zhes skur ba btab nas dmyal bar skyes/ 'on kyang / khong sku tshe'i bar chad kyi sdig gis chog snyam nas/ drang por smras pas/pha mgo smad de/ 'dus byas thams cad gyi mtshan nyid mi rtag pa yin/ mod/ mya ngan ma byed ces te/ phugs su ltas pas de'i ro khrag gis sbags kyang mdangs ma yal bar mthong nas/ e ma ho/ lus srog la'ang mi gzigs par tshul khrims bsrung ba ngo mtshar che/ zhes bstod de phyag 'tshal nas/ de'i rgyal khrims kyis tshul ldan khyim du grongs na gser gyi dong tse stong gi chad pa yod pa khyer nas/ rgyal po la/ bdag gis cung zad nongs kyis/ dong tshe 'di dag bzhes shig byas pas/ yul 'di na drang zhing chos la dad pa ni khyod kho na yin na / nyes pa dag cing srid de byas pas/ bu mo la smad de/ dge tshul la bstod nas/ drang por zhus pas/ bu mo la smad du ci yod/ 'ching ba las ma grol ba kun gyi chos nyid yin no mod/ dge tshul lusasrog la ma gzigs par tshul khrimasabasrungasapani/ 'jegarten na dgon no/ /de lakhyod lanyesapa gar yod/dong tse khyo rang khyer gcig /nga de'i rusapa la mchod dad cig la 'gro'o/ /zhesagaser rnga brdungs te/ zhabs 'bring ba sum cu dang bcas pas/ rus pa la phyag 'tshal te bstod nas/ rus pa rin chen shing rta las spyan drangs te/ spos —62—

spyod 'jug sgrung 'grel las 'bras gsal ba'i me long zhes bya ba bzhugs/dang tsan dan gyis bsregs shing mchod pas/ sa g.yos te me tog gi char babs/ bu mo de kun gyi mthong sar bzhag nas/ nga'i chab 'og tsam na 'di las gzugs bzang ba med na/ de la'ang ma chags par tshul khrims kyi phyir sku srog gtong pa ni shin tu yang ngo mtshar ro/ /zhes/ slob dpon yang spyan drangasate chos bstan pas thams cad kyis tshul khrims la gces spras byas nas byang chub tu sems skyed do/ /srog la bab kyang srungs shig ces/ k+ṣal ka shi ka'i rgyal po tshangs byin gyis/ gdol pa lnga la/ khyed song la/ ri kha ba can gyi drung nas/ glang po che ut+pa la'i mig ces bya ba yod pa'i mche ba longs shig bsgo bas/ rngon pas chos gos gyon nas/ dge sbyong gi cha lugs la mchan du dug mda' sbas pas bsad kyang / glang pos cha lus la gus pa dang bkur sti byas pa'i phyir/ ma 'ongs pa'i dus na nga'i bstan pa la rab tu byung ba snod du 'gyur tam/ ma gyur kyang / de la 'tsho ba sogs byed pa de ni/ dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas la 'tsho ba'o/ /zhes sogs rgyas par gsungs so/ /༈ slob dpon lwa ba pas/ u rgyan du sbyod pa la phyin pas/ phyi pa'i rnal 'byor mas lag pa la yid kyis ut+pal bris pa/ rjes su nang pa'i rnal 'byor mas mthong ste khyod la phyi pas glags 'tshol bas/ lha sgoms zhes pa bzhin bsgoms kyang / me ri rdo ra sogs skyed rim gyis thub pa mi 'dra nas/ stong par bsgoms pas/ la ba logs su bor ba rnal 'byor ma rnams kyis bgos nas zos pa la/ sang rgyal po la zhus te/ rnal 'byor pa sems stobs che ba bas/—63—

mkhyen brtse'i 'od snang las/ spyod 'jug sgrung 'grel/blon po rnams kyi chung ma tsher lcag gis brabs pa na/ lwa ba mtho re bskungs so/ /gong ba nas mtho gang ma tshang ba rgyal po'i btsun mo che ba gser thod can gyis bskungs te bsgrigs pas tshang ba lta bu'o/mkhan po rjes su bstan pa dang / rgyal byed kyi tshal na 'phags pa ka t+ya na ya bzhugs pas/ pu dbyi ra'i rgyal po 'byor ldan de la mi rtag pa'i chos bshad pas dad nas rab tu byung ngo / /de dgon pa zhig na sems srung zhing sgom pa'i drung du/ rgyal po gzhan zhig ri dwags bshor ba'i btsun mos chos zhus pa la phrag dog skyes nas/ pu dbyi ra tsher lcag gis brabs pas bu ga dgu nas khrag 'dzag pas/ sems 'khrugs te/ ka t+ya na'i drung du phyin nas rgyu mtshan bshad de/ kho mos sdom pa dbul lo/ /nga'i dpung bzhi po blangs te rgyal po 'di brlag par byed do zer ba la/ mi rtag pa'i chos bshad kyang ma nyan pa na do nub nga'i gam du nyol la sang sdom pa phul zhig byas pas/ de'i nub mkhan pos byin rlabs kyis/ kho'i rmi lam du/ rang gi dpung bzhi blangs nas rgal bas pham nas/ pu dbyi ra rang nyid kyang rtul po'i lag tu shor ba rmis nas/ sad de skrag nas/ mkhan pos skyabs su gsol zhes rmi lam bzlas pas/ mkhan po na re mang bas nyung ba rgyal ba yod/ /zhes sogs chos bshad pas sdom pa dbul bshol te/ rtse gcig tu sgom pa mkhan po'i drin no/ /sangasargyasachuzla/ sud pa'i bul/ dmaparnamasadangalan gconatsam/ /ji ltar 'dod par phrad kyang rung / /'drisapar bya bar mi dgosapar/ /rab tu brtan pa nyid du 'gyur/ /zhes sogs chos sho lo ka gsum bshad nas dad de/—64—

spyod 'jug sgrung 'grel las 'bras gsal ba'i me long zhes bya ba bzhugs/dam bca' bzhi 'bul lo zhes pa la/ bden pa'i brtul zhugs longs la srog chags gsod pa spongs/ skye bo btson du bzung ba 'di rnams btang bar gyis//dpa' bo khyod kyis mi sha za ba thong / /dam pa'i nang nas 'di bzhi byin par gyis/ zhes sogs kyis btul nas/ slar kho rang gi rgyal srid la btsud pa'ang mkhan po bsten pa'i phan yon no/ /yon tan shesapar rig par bya/ /med la yon tan sgrog pa ni/ /dam pa rnams la skur 'debs 'dra/ snyon pa 'di/rgyal po bsod 'phel gyi blon po dpal 'phel du gyur pa na/ tshong dpon rgyal po'i drung du song shul du sgyug mo bu mo la phrad pa'i tshe/ khyod kyi khyim thab de spyod tshul ci 'dra/ bu mo khyim thab la sdod pa ngo tsha bas mgo smad de bcom skyungs nas/ de lta bu'i spyod tshul ni rab tu byung ba la'ang ma mchis so zhes pas/ ma rgas shing rna ba mi gsang bas/ rab tu byung zhes pa'i sgra tsam gcig thos te/bdag gis mag pa rab tu byung zhes ngus pas/ 'o na ma bdag gi mya ngan sel du 'ongs so snyam nas/ bu mos kyang ngus/ nang mi khyim mtshes kun 'dus te ngu ba/tshong dpon gyis ci nyes snyam nas g.yog gcig bltar btang bas/ jo bo 'byor pa'i khyim spangs te rab tu byung zhes thos pas/ mya ngan byed zer/ khong rnams re ba ma grub par khyim du mchi ba g.yar ngo tsha zer te/ rings par rgyal po'i drung du log ste rgyu mtshan zhus pas/ khyod la mi bde ba gang yod gsal gyis/ de skad ma zer zhig /byasapas/ khyed lta bu la brten pa la mi bde ba gar mchi/ thams cad bdag la rab tu byung ba re ba la/ de ma grub par khyim du mchi ba ngo tsha zer/ 'jig rten pa'i mu gcor gyi tshig tsam la brten nas nged —65—

mkhyen brtse'i 'od snang las/ spyod 'jug sgrung 'grel/thams cad yal bar 'dor ba mi rigs so zer kyang / nan gyis zhus pas gnang ste/ nye 'brel thabs sna tshogs kyis bzlog pa'i tshig rnams bags kyis brisanasanagasasu song ngo / /desan/ dge bshesaston pa/ dge slong sogasabarjod na de'i spyod tshul la 'bad do/ /yon tan dang ni phan thogs shing / snyon pa mnyan yod na 'khor brgya phrag phyed dang bcu gsum dang thabs gcig bzhugs so/ /de'i tshe khyim bdag la gcig gi chung ma la khye'u mdzes shing lta na sdug pa khu tshur gnyis bcangs pa gcig skyes pa de/ shis sam mi shis snyam nas khu tshur kha phye bas gser gyi dong tse re re byung ngo / /pha ma gnyisarab tu dga' ste/ dong tse blangasate yang khu tshur 'chang ngo / /mtshan mkhan la bstan pas mtshan rab tu bzang ste/ ming yang gser yig tu btags so/ /de'i khu tshur phye res kyis gser gyi dong tse re byung bas/ pha ma'i bang mdzod thams cad gang yang da dung zad pa med do/ /de cher skyes nas pha ma la rab tu byung bar zhus nas/ dge slong du gyur pa'i tshe yang /phyag gar 'tshal par gser gyi dong tse byung bar gyur te/ de nas dgra bcom pa'i 'bras bu thob bo/ khun dga' bos ston pa la/ dge slong gser yig 'dis sngon las ci bgyis te 'di lta bu'i tshul lags zhus pas/ bka' bstsal pa bskal ba dgu bcu rtsa gcig gi sngon rol du/ sangs rgyas gser thub 'jig rten du byung ba de 'khor bcas/ khyim bdag rigs gnyis kyis spyan drangs te 'byor pa phul bas/ de'i tshe shing thun dbul po gcig kyang dad nas/ nyin ring btus pa'i shing btsongs pas gser gyi dong tse gnyis rnyed de/ khyim bdag gi —66—

spyod 'jug sgrung 'grel las 'bras gsal ba'i me long zhes bya ba bzhugs/sgo drung du bcom ldan 'das byon pa la/ gzhan dga' ba dang gus pa'i sgo nas phul bas/ ston pas kyang brtse bar dgongs nas bzhes te smon lam btab bo//zhes sogs rgyas par gsungs so/ /gzhan yang / nag po pa'i dkyil chog las/ skye bo phal pa stong phrag gnyis/ /bram ze gtsang ma gcig dang mnyam/ /bram ze gtsang ma stong phrag gnyis/ dge slong gcig la rab tu sbyar/ tage slong stong phrag gnyis dag ni//rdul med pa ni gcig dang mnyam/ rdul med stong phrag gnyis dag ni/ ṣe shes ldan pa gcig dang sbyar/ ṣe shes ldan pa stong phrag gnyis/ slab dpon gcig dang mnyam par brtag /ces sogs kyi bar du gsungs so/ /phan 'dogs pa'i zhing ni mdza' bo bu sogs bshad zin to/ /rdul gyi zhing pur pa'i mdo la sogs pa bzhin/ yang gal te yod na dge 'dun mchod/ /yang na byis pa'i ston mo bya/ ldagon mo rnams la byin pa ni//bsod nams phung po dpag tu med/ /ces so/ /༈ bkag pa rnams kyang de la gnang / /dedadapon snying rje che ldan des//sems can gyi dbul ba bskyab pa'i phyir rgya mtshor 'gro nus pa su yod ces dril bsgrags te/ tshong pa lnga brgya dang lhan cig chas pas/ 'phongs rtsal la goms pa'i chom rkun bha tsi zhes pa gcig kyang tshong pa'i cha lugs kyis zhugs te/ don grub na tshong pa rnams rgya mtshor pho la/nor rnams kho bos bya'o/ /snyam du semasaskyed do/ /der gzings nor dbyig gis gang ste/ 'dzam gling du zhabor khar chom rkun des da ni dus la bab bo snyam pa'i tshe/ rgya mtsho'i lhas/ ded dpon gyi —67—

mkhyen brtse'i 'od snang las/ spyod 'jug sgrung 'grel/rmi lam du/ 'di na bha tsi zhesapa bong che ba/ ngam gnag pa/ mig dmar ba/stobs rgyas pa gcig 'dug pa des sems skyed pa myur du brtsams pas de bzlog pa'i thabs la myur du 'bod gcig /ma bzlog na tshong pa 'di rnams phyir mi ldog pa kho na yin pas/ bha tsi dmyal ba mtha' med du lhung ngo / /zhes rmi ba sad nas/ der rlung log ste/ zhag bdun sdod pa'i tshe bsams pa/ smras na tshong pa rnams kyi stobs shugs kyis bsad de/ tshong pa dmyal bar lhung /gzhan na tshong pa srog dang 'bral zhing bha rtsi dmyal bar lhung / bha tsi gsad na bdag rang dmyal bar lhung ste/ gang ltar yang dmyal ba'i gnas las ma 'das pas/ bdag gis tshong pa'i srog bsrung zhing / bha tsi dmyal ba'i sdug bsngal las bskyab pa'i phyir/ bskal ba 'bum du dmyal ba'i sdug bsngal bdag gis bzod par bya'o/ /snyam du snying rje'i blos/ kho rang gi seng ldeng gi mdung phrogs te kho rang la bsnun pas/ nga'i skal ba 'bum gyi 'khor ba phyir bsnyil la/ tshong pa rnams 'dzam gling du bde bar phyin nas dge ba la bkod cing / bha tsi lhar skre)sa so/ /༈ ma gus pa la chos mi bshad/ rnal 'byor ma sgur chung mas stan dma' ba la 'dug ste/ rgyal po'i btsun mo gser khri mthon po la 'dug pa du ma la chos yang yang bshad kyang / dngos grub rdul tsam yang ma rnyed de/ slob dpon gyi drung du phyin nas nga'i slob ma la yon tan mi 'byung ba ci zhus pas/ ma gus pa'i nyes pa ste/ btsun mo rnams khri las phob cig zer ba bzhin btsun mo rnams kyis rang rang gi rigs kyi nga rgyal bcom nas khri las babs te stan —68—

spyod 'jug sgrung 'grel lasa'abras gsal ba'i me long zhes bya ba bzhugs/dma' ba la 'dug /sgur chung ma gser khri la bzhag ste chosamanyan nas dngosagrub rnyed do/ /le'u lnga pa'o// //ka6 le'u drug pa'i skabs kyi gtam rgyud bshad pa/drangasrongadad rgyalagadamapa'ogorab/ rma byatsherama.ut+palamadog /lha sbyin gser 'bum ma he dang / /dkon gnyer glang lug mang nusasogs/ /ser thub lnga sde zhi dge dang / /rgyal po zla 'od byan lag dang / /gtum po dang ni nyi shu'o//༈ khong khro gcig gis 'joms par byed/ ༈ bcom ldan 'das mnyan yod na bzhugs pa'i tshe/ mu stegs mang po mtsho ma pham la khrus byed du song ba dang / bcom ldan 'das 'khor brgya phrag phyed dang bcu gsum dang bcas pa/rdzu 'phrul gyis nam mkha' la ngang pa khyu lding ba bzhin du gshegs pa/ bal yul gyi thad du slebs pa na/ sangs rgyas 'od srung gi skra spu las byas pa'i mchod rten de la dge slong gcig gus pas phyag 'tshal ba mthong nas/ de'i bsod nams kyi tshad ni ci tsam zhes bstan pa/ 'bor rnams kyi zhus pa'i tshe/bka' stsal pa/ kho rang 'dug sa nas/ gser gyi sa gzhi la thugs pa'i bar gyi rdul phra rab kyi grangs dang mnyam pa'i 'khor los bsgyur ba'i rgyal por 'gyur ro/ /zhesaso/ /der mtsho drung du/ tshul shing la brisapa rnamasakyi nang nas/ gnas brtan 'od srung ma tshang ba la/ mchog gnyis sbron du btang bas/'gror ma nyan pa la/ rdzun 'phrul gyis khrid par brtsams pas/ sgul bar yang ma nus pas/ bcom ldan 'das kyi rdzu 'phrul gyis 'od srung gi ting nge 'dzin —69—

mkhyen brtse'i 'od snang las/ spyod 'jug sgrung 'grel/bzhig ste bkug go /der sangasargyasa'akhor bcasakyisakhrusabyasate/ slar gshegs pa na/ bal yul gyi thad du slebs pa na/ sngar gyi dge slong de grogs tshangs pa mtshungs par spyod pa gcig dang 'thab cing / khong khro drag po'i sgo nas man ji phar 'phen tshur 'phen byed pa mthong nas/ zhus pa/ 'di'i sdig pa'i tshad ni ji tsam lags/ bka' stsal pa/ sngar gyi rgyal por skye ba'i las bcom nas/ gser gyi sa gzhi'i bar gyi rdul phra rab kyi grangs dang mnyam pa'i dmyal bar skye'o/ /gsungs nas mnyan yod du gshegs so/ /bka' bzlog dad dang garna pa/ /lha rnams pham pa'i tshe/ lha chen dbang phyug dpa' bas dka' thub las bzlog nas g.yul du 'jug pa'i thabs su/de 'dod yon la sred pas/ lha rnams tshogs te sha son mo re bsdus nas/ lha mo dbu ma zhes pa'i gzugs byad shin tu mdzes pa gcig sprul nas/ dbang chen la phul te/ dka' thub las bzhengs nas g.yul du 'jug par zhus pas/dka' thub las bzhengs kyang / 'dod pas g.yengs te g.yul du 'jug tu ma 'dod par/ de dbral ba'i phyir me lhas sbyor mtshams nas me sbar bas/ khong 'khrugs te sa bon brabs nas rgyab pa/ thal nas rgya mtshor lhung ba lan tshar chagasate/ lhas sbyin lan tsha mi za ba'i rgyu de'o/ /der dbang chen 'brugs nasadrag por gyur te/ dbu ma yang gyed nas/ lha'i bu stobs 'phel gyis rang lus bsregs te/ dbu ma mchod pas mnyes nas/ dbang chen mgu bar byas te g.yul du zhugs nas lha rnams rgyal bar byas pas/ ding sang yang dbu ma mnyes pa'i thabs su rang lus sreg pa bzod par byed do/ /garna pa ni bod skad —70—

spyod 'jug sgrung 'grel las 'bras gsal ba'i me long zhes bya ba bzhugs/drongs nag pa ste/ kho sgrub pa byed pa'i nye 'khor du/ nyi zla gzas zin pa'i tshe/bsam gtan pa gnyis khon cung zad kyis mgo bo gcod res byas te shi ba/nag po'i mngon shes kyis tshangs par skyes pa mthong nas/ der de lta bus skye'o zhes khos smras pas/ deng sang yang de'i ched du mgo bo gcod res kyis sdug bsngal bzod par bya'o/ /sogs khongs nas/ lha chen rgyal ba dam pa dka' thub kyi gnas na 'dug pa'i nye 'khor du/ nang pa'i rang rgyal zhig yo byad cung zad kyi phyir mi rgod kyis bshus nas shing la bcings te shi ba/ rgyal ba dam pa'i mngon shes kyis gang du'ang skye ba ma mthong bar/ des/ de lta bus shi na skye med du grol zhes grags pas/ deng sang yang gcer bu pa'i dka' spyad de lta bu bzod par byed do/ /goms na sla bar mi 'gyur ba'i/ /gso thigs su/ go ra ba bzhin zhes pas/ tshangs byin gyis blon po go ra ba'i mal la bde bar gnyid myangs par bltas pas/ 'bol bar nas rta rnga gcig byung ba thos pas/ de lta bu'i tshor rtog ni rgya byin la'ang med do zhes/ slob 'dabs nas phyung nas/ rang khyim du bu smad kyis bskul nas shing 'tshong ba na brag rong nas rkang rjen du tsher khur khur te glu len pa/ rgyal pos gsan te/ khyod dang po rta rnga la smre sngags 'don/da lta tsher khur 'og nas glu len pa'i rgyu mtshan dris pas/ dang po rgyal po'i sku drin gyis bskyabs pas blon 'bangs thams cade kyis khur te/ dar 'bol bdun brtsegs kyis steng du 'jam 'khril gsum phrug gyon nas zhim mngar gzhan gyis snyod kyang lang yod kyis skyid du tshor ba'ang ma byung / da lta bu smad —71tre

mkhyen brtse'i 'od snang las/ spyod 'jug sgrung 'grel/kyis brnyas/ ri rogs rnams kyis kyang gshe zhing / brag rong nas tsher ma khur te tshigs ma za yang / ngan goms kyisasdug tu tshor ba'ang ma mchisapas/ skyid sdug thams cad lus kyis min par sems goms pa'i shugs po zhes zhus pas/drang po zhig go zhes/ slar blon por btsud do/ /khro ba de bzhin skye bar 'gyur/ /wā ra ṇa sīr/ dge slong bsod snyomasapa gcig 'ongs pas/ khyim bdag cig nor bu zhig skems shing / drung nas rma bya zhig kyang 'dug go /dge slong gi zla ba dmar po'i 'od nor bu la phog pasadamar por song ba/ me byas shar bsams te zosaso/ /khyim bdag gisabasod snyoms blangs te/ 'ongs pa na nor bu med de/ dge slong la btsugs pas/ngas ma khyer tsam las rma byas zos pa ma smras so/ /kho khros te gos la mdud pa byed pa na/ dge slong gis kyang gos la mdud pa byas so/ /der khyim bdag gisarma bya lartogapaphogate shi ba'i tshe/ nor burma byasazosapabashad do/ /sngar mi smra ba ni khyod kyis rma bya gsad kyis dwogs pas so/ kho na re khyod la'ang zhe sdang yod de/ nga mdud pa byed tshe/ khyed kyang byed pas so zer/ nga sems ma 'gyur mod/ khyod kyis nga gsod pas/ spyod lam bsdam pa'i phyir mdud pa byas pa'o/ /byas pas/ khyim bdag dad de nor bu yon du phul nas sems bskyed do/ /de nas/ lwab/ nor bu/ rma bya gsum las/ khyim bdag la zhe sdang skye ba rten 'brel yin mod/༈ tsher ma la sogs gnod pa byed/ /ma ga dha'i na len+d+ra na/ lha khang chen po bcu bzhi/ phran sum brgya yod pa la/ kha che bden pa'i byang chub ces pa —72—

spyod 'jug sgrung 'grel las 'bras gsal ba'i me long zhes bya ba bzhugs/mgron po zhig gis khyim zhig tu nyal bas/ gzhi ba zhig gis nyal du ma bcug pa la/ zhe sdang skyes nas 'di thams cad yul nas phyung la/ nga gcig pus yul 'di bzung snyam nas rang gi lha la re ba cher byas so/ /de lha rmi ba'i phyir tsher phung chen po zhig gi steng du nyal te sdug bsngal bar byas so/ /der shin tu rid par gyur te/ nam zhig lha rmi lam du byung nas khyod ci 'dod zer/ nga yul ma ga dha ri 'dod byas/ de nas sems bskyed pa sogs yul khyad par can mang po yod pas phyung na sdig 'ong zer/ sdig 'ong yang 'dod byas pas/ 'o na yul khyer la sdig ma byed zer ro/ /der gnyid sad nas tsher gseb nas langs te/ma ga dhar/ rgyal po'i drung du phyin nas/ dge 'dun 'di rnams yo byad thams cad rang gi g.yog la bgos nas dge ba mi byed pas/ 'di thams cad phyung la ngas bzung ngo / /zhesasmrasapas/ rgyal pos kyang de bzhin gnang ste/ lha'i nus pas rang nyidablon po chen po'i khrims bcas te mnga' thang ni shin tu che'o/ /nam zhig de 'chi nad kyis zin pa na/ g.yog rgya gar bas snabs snod gzhan bstsal g.yog pen dha bas snabs lag pas blangs pas/ nga'i blon srid/ da ni pen dha ngos la sbyin bsam/ g.yog gnyis pos nged gnyis su la ster dris pas/khyed gnyis rgyal po'i drung du song la dris shig zer ro/ /der pen dhas gos gsar pa sbas te hrul po gyon/ rgya gar bas sar pa gon phyin nas sdug bsngal byung / pen dhas gos gsar pa brjes te go gnas/ rgyal po la nged kyi blon po shi bas/ blon srid nged gnyis su la ster byas pas/ rgyal po na re/ rgya gar ba khyod rang gi gos kyang ga dar mi nus na blon po ga la 'ong zer te/ pen dha ba la —73—

mkhyen brtse'i 'od snang las/ spyod 'jug sgrung 'grel/byin nasad lta desabazung skad do/ /bdag sdug nyid kyang gsod byed pa/ /nyo chang pa zhig bzi ste nam phyed na 'ongs pa la/ chung ma bu skyes te sgo 'byed ma nus pas/ khong khrosate sgo bcag nasakhyod bu shosal zo zhig /de min gsod zer bas/ chung ma rang srog la chagasanas/ bu bshasate zosaso/ /der ya mtshan che bar gyur te/ rgyu mtshan ni skye ba snga ma rgyal po gcig gi chen mar gyur kyang bu med nas/ chun la bu gcig btsas pa'i tshangs bug tu khab bcug ste bsad pas/ chun ma na re/ nga'i bu khyod kyis bsad zer/ mosam bsad/bsad na phyi ma rang gi bu bsad nas rang gis za bar gyur cig /bu la la spyang gis za zhing / la la chur khyer bar gyur cig /gson po la dur du yang yang 'jug par gyur cig /sogs brjod pa'i lasate/ rgyasapar dge slong ma ut+pa la'i mdog gi rnam thar sogs las shes so/ /bzod pas bdag sdig mang du 'byang / /sngon tshe lo dpag med kyi dus na/grong khyer sum stong gis rim pa bzhin bskor ba'i rgyal pos sbyin pa dang tshul khrims ni rdzogs par mdzad pa na/ gnod byed med pas nga la bzod pa sgom du med do/ /da 'khor rnams kyi nang nas/ nga la su snying brtse ba gcig gis nga la ci gnod gyis shig nga bzod pa sgom zhes pas/ de'i tshe mi zhig la rim pa tha ma'i sgo gnyer gtad pa lo stong thub ste/ rim pa gnyis pa'ang gtad pas/ lo stong stong du sgo gnyer thub pas mthar rgyal po nyid kyi pho brang yang gnyer byas pa des/ rgyal po la phan na/ ngas gang gnod bya zer te/ byas pas bzod phyin rdzogs te/ de ni lhasabyin no/ /bdag gi rnyed pa 'dir 'dor gyis/ /rdo rje —74—

spyod 'dug sgrung 'grel las 'bras gsal ba'i rdzelong zhes bya ba bzhugs/gdan gyi byang phyogs na/ kha che'i btsun pa zhig la gser bum pa gang yod la/de 'chi ba'i tshe 'gro mi nus bzhin du phyin nas gser de la shin tu chags nas chab khung du bskyur ro/ /de'i ro dur khrod du bskyal te/ gser btsal bsam rnyed do/ /phyis rigs ngan gyis lud 'don pa na rtog rtse then gyis byung ba de bltas pas/ gser bum la sbal pa zhig 'khril 'dug pa/ phral bas ma phrel bar/ sbal pa bsabasanas gser khyer ro/ /der rdo rje gdan gyi byang phyogasasu mgar ba zhig la gser bag tsam zhig gsang nas btsongs pas/ mgar ba 'okhus nas bshad pas/ dge 'dun gyis rigs ngan bskyigs te gser phrogs sa /thams cad las la rag las na/ /tshong pa mang po'i gzings zhig ste/ mi bdun/ ma he dang brgyad thon pa ltogasate/ 'dzan ma 'bi ris/ ma he'i sha ran tsam re gson po re la bcad cing zos/ mi bdun pos de mi gtsang bas/ltogs pa rung ngo zer te rtsa ba sogs zos so/ /der yul du sleb pa dang / ma he'i sha zad de/ shi ma thag zhe sdang gis/ yul de'i jing du chu srin du skyes nas mi skad du nga ro chen po bton pas/ chu len sogs rgyun chad de/ nga ni mi gcig min pa la mi gnod kyis/ ma skrag zer ro/ /nam zhig 'dzan ma bhi ris khrus byed du phyin pas/ chu srin gyis bzung nas/ mgo nas til tsam re bcad cing zos te/ yun ring du sdug bsngal lo/ /༈ dmyal ba bral na cis ma legs/ lho phyogs a mo gha pa sha'i gtsug lag khang gi dkon gnyer/ rgyal po saṃ ga pha la'i blon po lhar bcas kyis/—75—

mkhyen brtse'i 'od snang las/ spyod 'jug sgrung 'grel/ tsan dan gor shi ba'i sgor rgyab nas bzhogs te btsongs pas/ khyim thab bde ldan gyis/ sku tshab gyis la sdig pa sbyong / min na sdig can gcig bde bar mi gnas/ zer ba bzhin byas pas/ dag rtags cung zad kyis brod pa skyes te/nyin mtshan zas gnyid mi dran par 'bad pas/ rgyab thams cad rmar song ste/zug gzer ma bzod par khyim thab bos te/ 'thon byasapas/ dmyal ba'i sdug bsngal mthong chos su 'dren pa yin gyis 'bod cig byas pas/ nam zhig sku rgyab dreg pa can zhig bstan nas zhal phyir gzigs pa mthong ste/ sdig mi 'dag 'dug /snyam nas yi chad de nyal ba/ khyim thab 'tsho ba skyel bsamathong nas/ de ka snga ltas yin gyi longs la sgrubs zer ba bzhin byas pas/ nang zhig mi reng dkar po 'ga' byung nas/ sgo bshig ste/ brag phreng zhig na mar rgyab zad zad drud de shi la khad pa zhig chu 'gram zhig tu skyur nas/ khrag gis bor te brgyal ba sangs pa dang / nam mkhar lha lnga byon nas/ gal te mi yi sdug bsngal gyis/ /dmyal ba bral na ci ma legs/ /bde ldan zhing du myur song nas/ /ring por mi thogs mngon 'tshang rgya/ /zhes dbugs phyung / lung bstan pa / mi snang bar gyur pa dang / byin rlabs kyis chu de las dngos grub kyi shing tog gnyis byung ba gcig zos pas/ rma drag ste 'phral du lha lus su gyur/gcig khyim thab la drin lan du bzhag go /'tsho ba skyel du phyin pasasgo hral hrul du zhig nas/ drud pa'i khrag lam nas phyin pas/ lha zhig 'dug pa la dris pas/ de ka nga yin 'di ltar byung byas te/ shing tog gcig byin pas/ zosam thag lha lus su gyur nas/ bde ldan du song ste/ sgrub g.yog rtogs pa myur —76—

spyoda'aju+ogasgrunga'agrelalasa'obrasagasalaba'imelongazhesabyababozhugs/bar gyur ta/ /mthang dang ma mthang nyams par 'gyur/ stan pa bzhugs dus su/ lung pa phu na mi dbul po zhig la nor du lug gcig yod pa gsod grabs byasapa na/ lug na re/ nga ma gsod rngan pa sbyin zer/ ci sbyin/ mdo na mi phyug po zhig la nor glang gcig yod kyis/ khyod kyi glang dang / nga'i lug kha su drag 'gran gyis/ nga'i glang drag zer na/ gser srang bcu'i rgyal tshugs zer ba bzhin byasapas/ lug na re/ nga la bre dang srang khol zer/ bkal nasadamangs mang pos dpang po byas te/ gang rgyal bas gser thob par byas pas/bre srang khrog zer bas/ glang bros te rgyal thob pa/ der 'jig rten pa/ 'basa'abu ded zer/ ston pa la rgyu mtshan zhus pas/ lug de snga ma mi phyug po zhig yin kyang / sbyin sogs ma byas par/ 'di phyi gnyis la mthong gi las nyams par byas/ glang des kyang / de la bu lon blangs pa ma bcal bas so gsung ngo / kham po gnyis pa/rgyan sogs chang yang bsten dgos so/ /bum pa'i skye rabs sogs brjod do/ /mdor na/ brgya byin/ bram ze/ nyan thosabyed ma/ legasapar pha rol phyin dang nya/ bya dang / bum pa/ phyug po'i bu/ dka' thub can dang / tsho dpon no/ /zhes sogasatshul khrims las brtsams pa bcu po dang / byang chub ngang pa byang chub che/ khre'u ri dwags sha ram bha/ khu ru phro rgyal bzod par smra//tshangs dang glang chen dge ba bcu/ khekho pa/ bzod pa las brtsams pa bcu po dang / su da pa dang lcagasakhyim dang / lda he dang ni shing rta mo/ tartson 'grusalas brtsams pa bzhi po rnams/ 'dir yang phar phyin drug gi skabs su/—77—

mkhyen brtse'i 'od snang las/ spyod 'jug sgrung 'grel/skabs dang gang 'brel rgyas bsdus ci rigs su brjod par bya'o/ /༈ khyim du gter ni byung ba ltar/ ldanyan yod na bu mo sa ga zhes pa zhig btsas ma thag /khyim gyi gra bzhir khron pa re rdol ba'i nang nas ci 'dod thams cad 'byung ngo / /de cher skyesanasakhyim thab byasapas/ bu gsum skyesaso/ /de nas dge bsnyen ma sa ga de/ rdzas yo byad thams cad la gnyer mel tshe mi byed 'dug pa la bu na re/ ma'i yo byad gsor mi 'gro'am zer/ mi gtor ro zer/de ci/ ngas ni skye ba sngon ma la ma byin len spangs pas so zer/ de rtag pa'i phyir bu gsum gros byas nas/ ma'i sor gdub phra gsum yod pa/ phra gcig gibashadug thub/ gnig gibasharims thub/ gcig gis thog thub pa de/ chu bo gha ga la skyur btang ngo / /der bu na re/ ma'i sor gdub gar song byas pas/nam zhig 'ong gis zer/ de nas nya pa rnams kyis dka' dka' nas gha ga las nya gcig zin pa de/ nga/ge bsnyen ma sa gas nyan thosazos tsam na/ de'i mgo bo'i nang nas/ sngar gyi sor gdub byung ba bu la bstan pas sdod yid ches so//༈ 'di la thog mar bdar 'os te/ ston pa thog mar lnga sde la chosaston/ de nas 'od srung spun stong la chos ston pa'i rgyu mtshan zhus pas/ ngas sngon khas blangs pas so/ /ji ltar na/ wār ṇa sīr rgyal po rtsod 'byung 'khor bcas/nags na drang srong bzod pa can 'khor lnga dang bcas pa'i phyogs su song te/rgyal po mnal sad nas btsun mo rnams btsal bas drang srong gi mdun na 'dug pa la/ phrag dog skyes te/ tshad med sogs ci thob ma thob na dben pa skyabs med du bud med dang lhan cig ci byed/ bzod pa sgom mo/ /bzod mi bzod —78—

spyod 'jug sgrung 'grel las 'bras gsal ba'i me long zhes bya ba bzhugs/lta'o/ /zer te/ ral gris rkang lag bzhi rim gyis bcad kyang bzod pa ma nyams par/ 'khor rnams 'phur te sa g.yos so/ /da dung bzod par ci shes/de la ji mi snyam pa bden na/ khrag 'o ma dang / rkang lag sngar bzhin gyur cig/ces pas/ sngar bzhin gyur nas rgyal po 'gyod de/ bag med pas nongs pa bgyis pa bzod par gsol gyis/ brtse bar dgongs shig ces pa'i lan du/khyod kyis phrag dog gis nga'i rkang lag bcad pa bzhin du/ nga sangs rgyas pa na/shes rab kyi mtshon gyis/ khyod kyi nyon mongs kyi rkang lag bcad par bya'o/ /zhes pas/ drang srong la 'gyod tshangs byas te/ rgyun du pho brang du mchod pas/phyogs de'i kun tu rgyu stong gi phrag dog gis rdul bshang gci gtor ba yang bzod par byas te/ nga sangs rgyas pa na/ chos kyi bdud rtsis de dag gi nyon mongs kyi dri ma bkru bar bya'o/ /zhes khas blangs pa'i drang srong yin la/ rtsod 'byung dhi n+ya'o/ /blon po bzhi ni rlangs pa sogs so/ /kun du rgyu stong ni 'od srung spun stong ngo / /de dag gis bzod phyin rdzogs par byas pa'i drin lan no zhebro/ bro+o/ོ/ /༈ gang zhig sku stong gnang med 'jug pas/ ldon 'dzam gling mu ges nyen pa bskyab pa'i phyir/ ded dpon zhi dge gnyis phun sum grogs por byas pa 'bral ma phod par gnyis ka rgya mtshor zhugs pas 'dod gling du phyin nas nor gyis tshim pa'i tshe/ rlung log nas rnga yab tu khyer te/ srin mos bzung nas/ded dpon gzugs bzang bas bzhag ste/ tshong pa rnams za bar brtsams pa'i tshe/ dge ba 'jam dbyangs yin te shes rab che bas/ sngar gyi gzings gling —79—

mkhyen brtse'i 'od snang las/ spyod 'jug sgrung 'grel/mthar bskyal te/ tshong pa bros so zhes bsgragasapas/ gzings bor te bros sam zhes 'tshol du khrid pa'i shul du/ zhi ba spyan ras gzigs yin te snying rje che bas/ tshong pa rnams gzings nang du bcug te/ 'dod rlung dang sdongs btang bas/ tshong pa rnamasan re/ ded dpon zhi ba la gor byon/ dge ba min pa ma lus pas mtshar te/ zer ba la/ grogs po dam pa bor nas bdag nyid thar pasaci zhig bya/ de bsagrogasapo'i mdun du shi na bla'o/ /zhesasmrasate/ tshong pa dag sdod bros nges po la gor byon zhes ded dpon srin mo dang bcas la smras pas/ 'dzam bu gling pa'i khye'u 'di drang po zhig go zhes yid phebs pa'i tshe/srin mo gcig na re tshong pa gzhan la zin nas/ khyed do nub za bar bgros kyis/ rkyal pa 'di dag re re la bzhon la/ la gor bros shig zer nas bros pas/ lam ring bas rkyal pa zags te 'chir nye ba na/ dge ba shes rab che bas/ da rkyal res kyis gshegs so zhes zhi ba skyon te ring zhig nas/ zhi bas yang brjes te/ 'ongs pas/ zhi ba'ang ched de bsam pa/ lam ring bsa'atsho ba'ang med par gnyis ka chad 'chi bas/ bdag gis sems bskyed pa'i rang srog bcad de mnar med du skyes kyang bla'o/ /chos kyi yang po 'di thon na sems can gyi mgon du 'gyur bas/ rgya mtsho ni ro dang zhag du mi 'grogs snyam nas spu gris rtsa bo che bcad pas myur du thar thon nas/ da bzhengs byas pas ldang rgyu ma byung bar grongs par shes te smre sngags bton pa klus thos te 'chi sos kyi sman bskus pas bzhengs nas/ rgya mtsho'i sbu ba byugs pas dkar po rgyan med du'o//klus sems can bskyab pa dang / khyad par du klu'i nad zhi bar gsol zhus pas/—80—

spyod 'jug sgrung 'grel las 'bras gsal ba'i me long zhes bya ba bzhugs/nga'i ming thos pas sems can gyi sdug bsngal zhi ba dang / khyad par du klu'i nad zhi bar gsol zhus pas/ nga'i ming thos pas sems can gyi sdug bsngal zhi ba dang / khyad par du klu'i nad zhi nas/ klu'ang sems can su la'ang 'tshe bar ma gyur cig /ces mi 'jigs pa seng ge'i sgra bsgrags pas seng ge sgra'o/ /gang phyir rang gi sku la'ang mi gzigs par/ snyon pa 'di sngon/ lho phyogs pho brang 'tsho ba bzang po zhes pa na/ 'dzam gling la dbang pa'i rgyal po zla 'od ces pa/ rgyal phran brgyad khri bzhi stong / grong khyer 'bum phrag bco brgyad/btsun mo nyi khri lnga brgya sogs yod par sku zhabrungs pa na/ da lta'i 'byor pa'ang sngon gyi dgo'abrasayin pas/ phyi ma'i rgyur da ltabasod namasabasagapar bya'o/ /snyam nas gser rnga rdung ste/ 'gro ba kun la ci 'dod sbyin no/ /zhesabasgrags te/ thams cad la tshim par byin pa/ de'i snyan pas sa steng khyab pa mtha'i rgyal phran bhi ma se nas ma bzod par/ dge sbyong dang bram ze kun la bsnyen bkur te/ nga'i mya ngan sol cig ces so/ /mya ngan ci zla 'od kyi snyan pas nga'i ming tsasayang med par byasapas/ de srogadang 'bralaba'i thabasala'abod cig /ces pas thams cad sngangs te/ de 'dra ni thos su'ang mi rung ngo zhes thams cad kyis so/ /der kho zhabrugs te/ zla 'od kyi mgo bo longs na rgyal srid phyed dang bu mo ster zer ro/ /der bram ze lo'u du chas khas blangs te/ sgo drung du phyin pas/ sgo srung kyi lhas nang du ma btang ba la/ gtsang ma'i lha rdzas sbyin phyin rdzogs par shes nas/ rmi lam du khyed kyi sbyin gnas dam pa ni sgo drung na sdod do/ /zhes bstan pa sad nas blon po zla chen la khyod song la nang du 'ong ba —81—

mkhyen brtse'i 'od snang las/ spyod 'jug sgrung 'grel/su'ang ma bkag ṣes bzlas pas/ lhas lung bstan nas/ 'di phrag dog gis/ rgyal po'i dbu slong bas btang du mi rung ngo zer kyang / de ltar na'ang rgyal po'i bka' bcag tu mi rung ngo / /zhesabatang bas/ rgyal pos bsu ste/gser dngul sogs ci 'dod dris pas/ phyi yo byad kyis spyin phyin mi rdzogs kyis/ /nang sku lus btang ba sbyin pa'i mchog lagasapas/ dbu stsal du gsol zhesapasadagyesate/ da ste zhag bdun na sbyin no/ /zhesapas/ zla chen sngangs te gser gyi mgo bo lnga brgya byin nas brid kyang ma nyan/ rgyal phran btsun mo sras bcas kun gyis nor gzhan sna tshogs kyis blus kyang ma nyan te/ thams cad drung du lhags mchi ma 'brubs te smras pa/ bram ze zhig gi phyir bdag cag mgon dang bral bar mi mdzad par zhus pas/ ngas lus 'di sngar don med du ji snyed cig chud gzan gyis/ da res myur du 'jig pa'i lus 'di bram ze la byin nas sangs rgyas su bsngos pas sangs rgyas thob pa na khyed rnams kyi mgon bya'o/ /zhes tshig 'jam por smras te/ bram ze la da ni mgo bo blang ba'i dusal bab bo/ /zhes pas/ blon po zla chen thabs gang gisakyang mi bzlogasapar shes nas snying gas te shi'o/ /bram ze na re 'khor 'di tsam gyi dbus su bdag gis dbu gcod par ga la nus/ zhe nas gnang na rgyab kyi skyed mos tshal du gshegs 'tshal zer te/ phyin pa dang / kho na re/ rgyal po ni sku g.yi+on la stobs rtsal che ba gyad dang mnyam pas/ sku zug ma bzod do/ /de 'gyod srid kyis/ dbu shing la btags te dgum mo zer te/ shing brtan po zhig la dam du btags nas/ bram ze la pus btsugs te khyod kyis chod la nga'i lag tu zhog —82—

spyod 'jug sgrung 'grel las 'bras gsal ba'i me long zhes bya ba bzhugs/cig /sbyin pa lag gis btang ngo gsung / bram zes ral gri gzasapa dang /shing gi lha mos thal lcags bsnun nas 'gyel ba dang/ shing gi lha la bka' bstsal pa/ ngas sngar mgo bo dgu brgya go dgu byin nas 'dis stong du tshang ste sbyin phyin rdzogs nas sangs rgyas 'grub pa'i bar chad ma byed ces pas/ shing gi lha yang mchi ma 'brub bzhin du bram ze'i stobs skyed de/ langs nas dbu bcad de phyag tu btang ba dang / sbyin pa chen por gyur pa 'di yis ni/ /'gro ba'i nang nas rang byung sangs rgyas te/ /sngon gyi rgyal ba rnams kyis ma bsgral ba'i/ /skye bo'i tshogs rnams bdag gis sgrol bar shog /cesagasungasanasabram ze'i lag tu btad pas/ sagayos/ me tog gi char babs/ nam mkha' thams cad 'ja' 'od du gyur pas/ se na 'gyod de snying gas nas shi ba thos te/bram ze re ba ma grub par snying gas te shi nas/ gnyis ka'ang bar do med par mda' bzhin dmyal bar song ngo /rgyal po'i 'khor mya ngan gyis shi ba rnams lhar skyes so/ /dper na rgyal po'i mi 'ga' zhig /ka na dha zhes pa'i rgyal po shin tu stobs che ba zhig yod pa'i 'khor bram ze zhig /rgyal phran cig gi yul du phyin nas/ bram zesanya zhig nyosathos te khyim du song ba'i bar du nya de bya glag gis khyer ro/ /der bram ze rang gi rgyal po snyems pas/ rgyal phran blon po dang bcas pa'i gseb tu phyin nas/ngas nya nyos pa khyed kyi yul gyi bya glag gis khyer bas/ da nga la bya glag zung la byin cig zer/ der rgyal blon rnams na re/ bya glag nged kyisami rnyed pas/ nya rin sbyin byas pas/ bram ze na re/ ci nas kyang bya glag 'dod zer te ma nyan pa —83—

mkhyen brtse'i 'od snang las/ spyod 'jug sgrung 'grel/la / rgyal po ka na dha bskyod pa'i dgos pa'i mig rgyang ring po bram ze de gcig pu thub kyang brnyasapa ma byas par/ rgyal blon de rnams kyis/ bram ze de la nya'i rin mang du byin no/ /༈ de ltar dmangs kyis rgyal gtum bzhin/ ṣā+on rgyal po chen po zhig la btsun mo du ma yod pa'i/ chen mas sdig pa zhig brten pa la bu gcig btsas pa / cher skyes shing sdig la dga' zhing gnyid mi 'ongasapar mi za'o/ /desargyal srid kyang bzung ste/ ming yang rgyal po gtum po rab snang zhes bya'o/ /de gnyid mi 'ongs pas gtam zla re/ 'bangs rnams kyis re mos su bkral 'jog pa gsod do/ /nam zhig na/ sa 'dzin pa zhesapa'i mi zhig la re mos bab ste phyin pa na de'ang gnyid du song ngo / /rgyal pos khyod su yin 'dri ba na ma thos la/ skad cher dris pas gnyid sad de bdag lags so zhes lan byas pas/khyod da ji skad mi 'byin pasabasad do/ /zer ba la/ bdag 'jig rten sems dpa' la zhugs pas lan no/ /de ci drisapas/ 'jig rten srang bcu gzhal te/srang gcig 'phri nasabacal yang / da dung srang bcu mchis pas so/ /de gang yin drisapas/ mngon du 'gyur lags kyis/ bya zhig la srang brgyabyung ba/ sgro spu srang gcig 'phri nas bcal yang srang bcu 'byung bas/ 'di la rgyu mtshan ci yod zer/ sgrosabategasapa'i slad du'o/ /zhesapas/ rgyal po dga' ste/ de ma bsad par/ nub phyi ma rnamasakyang nyal bas/ sngar gyi de bzhin la/ lan tsha chu/ byed ma chu/ mar zho rnamasabre re re/ sres kyang bre re re shong ba sogasabastan pas/ sa'adzin pa/ khyod ni mkhasapa'o/ gsung / lha'i bka' drin —84—

spyod 'jug sgrung 'grel las 'bras gsal ba'i me long zhes bya ba bzhugs/lags mod zer/ nga la gnyid mi yong ba la rgyu mtshan ci yod gsung / lha mi 'jigasapa rtsol zhig /sbyin no/ khyod ni sdig pa'i bu lagasapa'i slad du'o/ /yum la nga su'i bu yin drang por smros shig byas pas/ mi 'jigasapa rtsol zhig /sbyin no/ khib dang phrad dka' nas/ kho mo zla mtshan dang ldan pa na sdig pa gcig dang phrad de/ 'di skyes pa yin nas/ bdag la 'dod pa brten nus na ci ma rung snyam nasamatshan mar bcug pas so/ /zhig zhusapa na ngo tsha zhing / sa'adzin pa de la ni dngos po chog thang gcig byin nas/ yul gzhan du thabs kyisabaskrad do/ /'tsho byed kyis yul dbus kyi chang mar dang sbyar te/ byin pasaganyid du song shul du bros pa la/ gnyid sad de mar gyi sgregs pa byung bas/ nga la mar byin 'dug pas 'tsho byed ded la sod zer/ 'khor rnams na re/ lha la mnal 'ong ba'i thabs bgyis pa bzhin byung ba drin tshor lags na/ de gsad par ga la 'os zhes sogs kyi thabs sna tshogs kyi sgo nas mgu bar byed do/ /le'u drug pa'o// //ka7 le'u bdun pa'i skabs kyi gtam rgyud bshad pa/bu mo phyug mo khra dang ni/ /yi dwagasasrin bu blo brtan dang / /yungasamar bkang ba'i snod dang bdun/ /de bzhin srin bur gang gyur pa/ khyol po kri rdzil bu mo shin tu mdzes pa bdun yod pa de rnams shin tu bstan pa la dad de/rab tu byung nas dgra bcom pa thob pa/ yab kyis/ ston pa la 'di lta bu'i rgyu mtshan ci lags zhus pas/ bka' stsal pa/ sngon phyi'i rgya mtsho'i nang na mchod —85—

mkhyen brtse'i 'od snang las/ spyod 'jug sgrung 'gre' /rten bzhi yod pa la/ shing lo la gnas pa'i srin bu bdun rlung gis ded pa'i shugs kyis skor ba gcig byung bas/ rigs ngan gyi bu mo bdun du skyes/ de rnams rang gi rigs dang longs spyod la skyo nas shing btsongs te/ sbyin sogs byas pas/ rgyal po'i sras mor gyur te chos la dad par gyur to/ sgogs gsungs sa/ /cho ga shin tu 'jam po yis/ ldanyan yod na khyim bdag phyug po ser sna can rdul tsam mi sbyin pa zhig yod pa la/ 'phags pa mo'u 'gal gyi bus 'dul du byon nas/ nyi ma bdun du sbyin pa'i gtam 'ba' zhig byas te/ bsod snyoms blangs pas kho khros te bsod snyoms mi ster bar/ khyod la lab rgyu gcig pu de ka min pa med dam zer/ bcom ldan 'das la rgyu mtshan gsol pas/ nga kho na'i gdul bya yin gsungs nas byon pas/ khyim bdag sog ma'i bya ba byed pa la ba blangs pas sog ma zhig byin pa la dga' ba'i tshul gyis sbyin lan sogs byas pas/ phyis ldum rwar lo ma byin pa la sngar bzhin yon gyi khyad nga ra bshad pas/ de 'dra zhig la de lta na/ sang 'khor bcas chos ston la spyan drangs/ de nas rim bzhin/ rdzas thamasacad zad par ston pa 'khor bcas la mchod do/ /mthar lus la'ang zhen pa med de/ rasasnum can gyisalus dkris te mar mer phul te rgyun du zhugs pa'i 'bras bu thob po/ /༈ rim gyis rang gi sha yang gtong / ṣā+on bskal ba grangs med pa'i sngon rol na/ 'dzam gling 'dir yul de ba dha na zhes par/ rgyal po shing byi zhes pa/'byor pa dang / byamasasnying rje tshad med pa zhig byung ngo / /de'i tshe brgya byin la —86—

spyod 'jug sgrung 'grel las 'bras gsal ba'i me long zhes bya ba bzhugs/'chi ltas byung ba/rgyal po des skyabs nus zhes bi shwa kar mas smras nas/ rgyal po de nyams sad pa'i phyir/ bi shwa kar mas phug ron dang / brgya byin gyis khrar sprul nas ded pas/ phug ron bzung la ma reg pa de rgyal po'i nang du zhugs pa dang / khras kyang rgyal po'i spyan sngar phyin nas/ phug ron 'di ni bdag gi zas lags kyis/ tshur myur du byin cig byas pas/ 'di ni nga la skyabasapas/ khyod la spyin pa'i thabs med do/ /'o na kho'i skyabs byas nas/ bdag gi skyabs mi mdzad dam bdag ni ltogs te shi la khad do zer/ khyod sha gzhan zhig gis blus na 'dod dam byas pas/ 'phral du bsad pa'i sha khrag dron mo byung na 'dod do zer/ rang gi brla nas phug ron tsam zhig bcad de byin pas/ khra na re srang la bsgrin 'tshal lo/ /zer te bcad pas brla gnyis ka dang gnag pa thams cad kyis kyang ma khyer nas brgyal ba'i tshe gnam sa yang drug tu g.yos so/ /brgya byin rang gzugs bstan nas/ rgyal po 'di lta bu'i dka' spyad kyis 'bras bu ci bzhed 'jig rten gyi bde 'bras gang yang mi 'dod kyis/ sems can thams cad skyob byed sangs rgyas 'dod zer ro/ /'o na sku lus la zug zer 'di lta bu skyed pa la 'gyod pa med dam zer/ med do zer/ de la dpang po su yod ces pas/ ngas dang po phug ron blu bar khas blangs pa nas/ da lta'i bar du 'gyod po rdul tsam med na bdag lus sngon bzhin gyur cig ces pas sngar bzhin gyur ta/ /༈ phongs pa 'di 'dra byung gyur na/ te dang ldan pa mo'u 'gal/ yi dwags kyi gnas su song ba na/ yi dwags kha khab mig tsam pa rang gi skras g.yogs pa/—87—

mkhyen brtse'i 'od snang las/ spyod 'dug sgrung 'grel/lto ba ri tsam lus la me 'bar bas nyams thag nas skad 'byin pa/bshang gci za yang de yang bde blag tu mi rnyed pa zhig mthong nas/ las cis khyod 'dir skyes dris pas/ nyi ma shar ba'i tshe sgron me mi dgosakyis/ bcom ldan 'das la don 'di zhusashig /bdag gi lasakyi rnam par smin pa ston par 'gyur ro/ /zhes zer ba bzhin zhus pas/ bka' bstsal pa/ sngon rang rgyal zhig gis bu ram shing gi khu blangs pas/ khyim bdag des 'phags pa la phul cig ces g.yog la bsgos pas/ g.yog des lhung bzed thong zhig zer nas/ bshang gcis phag tu bkang ste/ steng du bu ram gyi khu ba'i lha ba blugs nas byin pas/las des 'di lta bu'o/ zhes gang po'i rtogs brjod las so/ /༈ sdug bsngal mtshon gyis rnam par 'joms/ khacom ldan 'das bya rgod phung po'i ri la bzhugs pa na/ grong khyer gyi mi gtsang ba'i lteng ka zhig gi nang na/ srin bu sbrul 'dra ba la/ rkang pa ni bzhi yod pa bar 'ga' ni phyir 'byung / bar 'ga' ni chu'i steng du 'byung mod/ der lo mang por/ sdug bsngal tshad med pa myong ba der/ 'khor bcas byon nas/ bka' bstsal pa/ khyed cag legasapar nyon la yid la zung zhig /'di'i sngon gyi rgyu bshad par bya'o/ /sngon sangs rgyas rnam par gzigs kyi bstan pa la/ dge slong stong phrag bcu bzhi dgon pa zhig na gnas pa la/ tshong pa lnga brgyas rin po che'i dam pa zhig bsod snyoms kyi zong du phul ba bzhes nas zhal ta byed pa'i dge slong zhig la gtad do/ /phyisabasod snyoms kyisabrel nas/ zhal ta ba la tshong pasaphul ba'i rin chen 'on cig /bsod snyomasasu btsong ngo zhesapas/ zhal ta ba khrosate/ khyod —88—

spyod 'jug sgrung 'grel las 'bras gsal ba'i me long zhes bya ba bzhugs/skyugs pa za sam/ rin chen btsongs pas kho bo gcig pu la byin du zad kyis/khyedakun lamabyin no/ zherabasnga dgo'adunakyangasosoragyesago /de'i rgyus lus zhig ste tshe 'phos nas mtshams med pa'i dmyal ba chen por lhung ste/ga skyugasakyi nang du bskalabadagu brgyartsagacig gi bar du 'gre 'gre ba'o/ /de las thar nas/ da lta 'dir na ngan skyugs kyi khung bur skyes nas lo mang po lon yang da dung ma thar te/ 'di lta ste/ sngon 'das pa'i sangs rgyas rin chen gtsug tor can gyis kyang / dge 'dun 'khor bcas 'dir gshegs nas/ nye gnas rnams la 'di'i las bstan te/ de nas sangs rgyas thams cad skyob kyis kyang de bzhin du bstan to/ /de nas tshe 'phos nas phyis yang dmyal bar skyes te/ lo khrag khrig grangs med pa zhig lon nas/ phyir yang khung bu 'dir skye'o/ /de'i 'ogatusangasargyasazhaboraba'ajigagisakyangade bzhin dubastan to/ /gser thub dang / 'od srung gis kyang de bzhin du bstan to/ /de bzhin du sangs rgyas stong po kun nye gnasadang bcas te/ 'dir gshegs nas/ srin bu 'di sngon las cir gyur pa'i rgyu ston par 'gyur ro/ /zhes gsungs pa dang /dge slong rnams spu langasate/ lus ngag yid gsum shin tu srung ba la/ btson par gyur to/ zhes mdzangs blun las so/ /༈ ngan 'gror nga rgyal gyis khrid cing / 'ib dpon dbyig gnyen la rang dang mnyam pa'i slob ma bzhi yod pa'i/ dang po blo gros brtan pa ni/ nub phyogs bram ze rab bstan gyi grong na/ slob dpon 'bru mar gyi bcing ba byas te/gzhung 'bum sde gya bzhi'i nang re la 'bum phrag bcu gnyis zhal thon mdzad de/—89—

mkhyen brtse'i 'od snang las/ spyod 'jug sgrung 'grel/zhag bdun na tshar ba/ bram ze'i bus rdzogs par thos te/ dad bzhin du tshe'i dus byas nas/ yang de'i bur skyes te/ na len+d+rar rab tu byung nas/ blo gros brtan par grags so/ /sngar slob dpon la gsan pa'i bag chags sad de mkhas par gyur pa'i tshe/ nyi ma'i dngos grub kyis bsregs pa'i mdo mang po zhig 'dus kyang / zab rgyas mngon pa dang / dkon brtsegs sogs ma rnyed par/ tshangs byin gyis bsnyen bkur byas te/ 'di dag thugs la sdud nus pa byung nas/ paṇa chen kun gyi'ang gtsug gi nor bur khur ro/ /zhes pas/thams cad slob dpon la lta ba'i tshe/ bzhengs nas/ bdag blo phyogs gcig bzhag pa dang / /'gro blo phyogasagacig bzhag pa gnyis/ /gal te de la ljid rung na/ /srang la bcal na bdag blo lci/ /zhesaso/ /'o na dbyig gnyen zhesapa'i lan du/ dbyig gnyen gzhung lugs rgya mtsho yi/ /pha rol son yang tshul ma shes/ /chang bum gang gi mya ngan gyis/ /sangs rgyas bstan la dal por mnal/ gsung nas bstud pas/ so dgu tshar ba dang / slob dpon la smad pas/ sku che'i bar chad du gyur te/ nga rgyal gyis dmyal bar khrid nas btsos te/dbyug pas bsngogs pa na zug gzer ma bzod par dbyug tho la 'jus pas/phyag tshig ste/ tshig bar mnyam pa la dbyug pa mi tsha ba/ nga'i bdag 'dzin gyis lan snyam nas/ gnas lugs la spyad pas/ chos thams cad bdag med du rtogs te/ 'dzam bu gling du thon nas/ yang smrasapa/ nga yi nga rgyal lcagasadang 'dra/ /nga yi shesarab gru dang 'dra/ /lcagasakyisargya mtshor bying ba yang khru yis steng du thon la ltos/ zhes so/ khing / phag sogs dman pa'i gnas —90—

spyod 'jug sgrung 'grel las 'bras gsal ba'i me long zhes bya ba bzhugs/bdun brgyud pa'i tshe/ paṇ+ḍitas mdun gyi phag mo'i lto ba nas/ /nga ni sngon gyi ma ti sbi ra ste/ /nga rgyal dbang gisaphag mo'i mngal du skyes/ /'di ru ma bzhag rgyal po'i khab tu khyer/ ston nas dga' ldan lha gnas skye 'gyur gyis/ /gsungs pa lta bu ste/ mkhas pa'i nga rgyal gyis ngan 'gror gshegs kyang myur du grol rkyen byed de/ 'o skol rmongs pa'i nga rgyal gyis gtan 'khyams byed pas/gnyen po sgom pa gces so/ /yungs mar bkang pa'i snod bskur la/ /༈ gtum po rab snang gis lho phyogs su g.yul las rgyal ba'i sdig sbyong la/ka t+ya na spyan drangs/ rtsed 'jo ba du mas bsu ste/ de dag gang mkhas par gda' zhus pas/ lta long med pas ma mthong gsungs pas/ yid ma ches pa la/khyod kyi chab 'og na chad pa phog pa yod zer ba/ lam stegs 'dred pa'i steng nas 'bru mar gyis bkang ba'i snod bskur te/ ral gri thogs pas drung du bsdad nas/ thigs gcig bo na gsod do/ lta bo na chad pa las thar par bya'o/ /zhes rtsed 'jo ba mang pos skor te/ de dag gang mkhas par 'dug drisapas/ ltas te bo na srog dang bral dwogs kyis 'jigs nas/ lta skabs ma mchis lags zer ba la/ de ni tshe 'di'i srog dang bral dgos tsam yin gyi/'dir bag med kyi nyes pas reg na/ gtan gyi phan bde'i srog dang 'bral bas/ brtul zhugs can gyis lhag par yang sgrim 'tshal lo gsungs pas/rgyal po lhag par dad do/ /le'u bdun pa'o// //—91—

mkhyen brtse'i 'od snang las/ spyod 'jug sgrung 'grel/ka8 le'u brgyad pa'i skabs kyi gtam rgyud bshad pa/༈ gtsang 'byor chusmad nya ba dang / /legs dkar shan pa lcags khyim dang / /byi po rta dbyangasadage tshul dang / /zla mdzesaseng ge lha chen dang / /rgyal 'byung dgra rgyal spyi bo skyes/ /desapa paṇa chung sgom dad dang / /semasaskyed klu sgrub nyi shu'o/ ༈ shi ba'i 'og tu 'jigs pa skye/ ston pa kun dga' bo dang bcas pa/ rgyal khab tu bsod snyoms la byon pa'i tshe/ skye bo thams cad kyi bshang gci 'dor sa'i grogs po gting rings kyi chab btsog de'i nang na/ srin bu mi'i gzugs 'dra ba la rkang lag mang ba zhig /ston pa la ltas nas mchi ma 'dzag go /'khor gyis gsol ba/ 'di'i lasaci/ der skyesanasaji srid cig lon lags zhugs pas/ bka' bstsal pa/ sngon 'das pa'i dus na/khyim bdag cig gis dge 'dun la mar dang / 'bru mar dag phul te/ dge slong mgron po zhig kyang 'ongs pa la/ gtsang sbyor bas mkhyen nas/ khyod ni mgron po/ nged ni bza' tshang yin no zhes/ de la skal ba ma byin no/ /mgron pos/ yon bdag gis dge 'dun la phul gyis/ kho bo dge 'dun yin pas byin cig zer ba la/ zhal ta ba khros te/ khyod bshang gci mi za bar nga la 'bru mar dag 'dod dam zhes tshig ngan smras pas/ las des bskal ba bye ba dgu brgya'i/ bar du rgyun du chab btsog pa 'di'i nang du skyes so/ /de'i phyir khyed rnoms kyang ngag gi las bsrung zhing sdoms shig ces drin bsab las gsungs sa/ /—92—

spyod 'jug sgrung 'grel las 'brasagasal ba'i me long zhesabya ba bzhugs/༈ de dang de sdongs stong gyur du/ rta'i dpon 'byor ldan bza' mi gnyis la / rgyu skar chu smad la bu gcig btsas pa/ nye dus chu smad ces ming du btagasaso/ /de cher skyes te pha shi nasakhyim gyi bdag por gyur to/ /ma la rab tu 'byung bar zhus pas/ nga shi ba'i 'og tu rab tu byung zhig ces so/ /bus ji snyed pa thams cad ma la phul te/ dge sbyong dang bram ze dang bkren pa rnams la byin cig /zhesabasgo'o/ /ma ni shin tu 'jungasapas/ busabyin pa thamasacad sbas te/ kho mosabyin no/ /zhesabu rdzun gyisabaslu bar yang byed la/ dge sbyong slong pa mthong na ni khyed ni yi dwags su skyes pa bzhin khyim thams cad yang yang ci'i phyir nyul zer ro/ /de shi nas yi dwags su skyes te/ bus sbyin pa dag byin nas sdod rab tu byung ste/ dgra bcom pa thob nas/ gaṅgā'i 'gram na 'dug pa'i drung du/ ma yi dwags mo 'jigs su rung ba de lhags te/ bu bdag gis ni lo nyer lnga'i bar du chu'i bag kyang ma mthong na kha zas lta ci smos/ kho mo la chu stsol cig zer ro/ /chu smad kyis smras pa/ yum khyod mir gyur pa na ngas sbyin pa dag byed du ma bcug gam/ bu bdag ser snas non nas/ rdzasathams cad sbas te sbyin pa cung zad kyang ma byas kyi/ da bdag gi don du/ sangs rgyas dang dge 'dun la bshos gsol nas bdag gi ming gis yon bsngos shig /'on kyang bdag yi dwags kyi skye gnas 'di nas thar srid do zer/ chu smad kyis smras pa / de ltar bgyid pas/ khyod rang yang gral dpon gyi mdun du 'dug cig /bu bdag ni gcer bur 'dug pa 'di ngo tsha'o/ /yum khyod gang gi tshe sdig pa byed pa de'i tshe ngo mi tsha na/ da lta ci'i phyir ngo tsha 'dod na de bzhin bya'o zer/ chu smad —93—

mkhyen brtse'i 'od snang las/ spyod 'jug sgrung 'grel/kyis/ nye du rnams kyi khyim khyim du dad pa dris nas/ phyi nyin gdugs tshod drangs pa'i/ gral dpon gyi drung du yi dwags mo'ang 'dug pa srog chags 'bum phrag du mas mthong nas/ skyo ba skyes pa de dang mthun pa'i chos bstan pas thams cad bden pa mthong bar gyur to/ ta ོma ldan 'das kyis/ sbyin pa 'di'i bsod namasagang / /de ni yi dwags phyi bzhin song / /yi dwagasa'ajig rten rab 'jigasalas/ /de ni myur du thar gyur cig khresapas/ yi dwagasamo de yang shi 'phos nas/ yi dwags rdzu'aphrul chen mor skyes so/ /chu smad kyis/yum da ni mthu yod kyis sbyin pa thong zhig /bu mi nusaso/ khin mang du bcos pas/ ras zung gcig sbyin pa/ chu smad kyisadage 'dun la phul ba/ dge slong zhig gis nyan thos te/ gdang bu la bkal ba/ yi dwags mos/ mtshan mo 'ongasate brkusaso/ /yang chu smad kyisabakug pa/ lan gsum du brkus so/ /der dge slong des kyang ras de gshags nas phyogs bzhi'i dge 'dun gyi stan la blan pas/ de nas rku ma nus so/ /zhes snying rje pad dkar las so/ /༈ semasacan mos pa sna tshogis pa/ gzugs can snying pos/ bcom ldan 'das thugs rje thabs su ldan pa yin lags na/ mu stegs kyi ston pa drug po 'di lam rnal ma la ci'i phyir mi sbyor zhus pas/ bka' bstsal pa/ rgyal po khyod kyis 'bangs thams cad thul lam gsung / thul lo zhus pas/ 'o na rigs ngan nya ba de thul cig gsung / der rgyal pos nya ba bos nas khyod la longs spyod mang po sbyin no/ /nya shor ba spongasashig byasapasam nyan no/ /der rgyal pos/ 'khor rnams la 'di ma bsad par nya ba mi yong na gsod ces —94—

spyod 'jug sgrung 'grel las 'bras gsal ba'i me long zhes bya ba bzhugs/sdigs shig gsungs pas/ nya ba na re/ nga'i bu smad sbron cig tshig gsum smra'o zer/ skyed 'ong snyam nas bu smad sbran pas/ 'u cag nya shor ba'i rigs su nges shing dpral ba na mtshan ma'ang yod pas/ lus dang srog gi phyir yang nya ba las ma log cig zer ro/ /der nya pa'ang ma bsad de/ bcom ldan 'dasakyisasems can mos pa sna tshogs pas de nyid ngas kyang thul bar dka'o gsungs pas/ rgyal po gdod yid ches so/ /༈ gang phyir byis pa rang don ni/ /legs dkar ston pa'i gzim g.yog byed pa na/ ma gzims par nye gnas nyal du med pas/ kho/ gcer bu can 'gro ring ste/ go tam/ myur du nyol/ ba gu la 'ong ngo zer/ bka' bstsal pa/klu skyong khyod snying las chung ngur gyis shig dang lha dang bcas pa'i 'jig rten na/de pa la/ rdzi bar nus pa su yang med de/ 'on kyang khyed kyi ston pa gcer bu pa sdug bsngal 'gyur ni/ zhag bdun na ma zhu ba'i nad kyis dus byas te/ mi gtsang ba'i srin bu dang / dmyal sogs su skye bar 'dug go gsungs pas/ kho ma bzod par rings par song ste/ go tam gyi mngon shes rdugs su gzhug gi /zhag bdun zasachod cig zer/ bdun nas zosapas dusabyasate/ srin bur skyes nas/ smre sngags dang bcas ste/ go tam thams cad mkhyen par 'dug go /'u rang zhag drug la bdun du zhabrul te/ 'di ltabu'i sdugabasngalamyonganasadamyal ba mtha' med du 'khyamasapar 'dug go /log lam dang sdig grogs spongs/ go tam la bzod par gsol la/ skyabasasu song zhig byasapas/ ston pa 'di la rtag med pa/ de la bzod par gsol na re ba skye mod/ nga las ji la —95—
