mkhyen brtse'i 'od snang las/ spyod 'jug sgrung 'grel/thug kyang go tam la 'dud dus mi yong / mi che chung la 'chi ba yin gyis/ smre sngags ma byed par sdug sems skyed cig zer te/ drung du song nas/ khyod kyi mngon shes rdugs so zer/ 'o na dmyal sogs su brgyud de lhung zer ba gsungs pas/ kho skyengs te 'khrugs nas/ nga'i ston pa la skyon sna tshogis brjod pa khyod kyi g.yog mi byed zer te song nas/ kun tu rgyu ston pa'i skyon brjod byed pa'i nang du song ste/ khyod la rgyus med pa yin kho la 'di 'dra 'di 'dra'i skyon mang po yod zer ba la/ mo'u 'gal gyi bus phyin nas/ ston pa nyes skyon thams cad dang bral ba la sgro skur byas na ngan 'gror sdug bsngal myong gi /de lta bu ma zer byas pas/ khyod kyi thos pa'i grangs pas/ ngas mthong ba'i grangs mang / 'jim pa rlon pa chu phyogs mi dgos g.yo sgyu'i rdzu 'phrul sna tshogs kyis sbyin bdag gi mgo bo bskor nas dad rdzas sna tshogs zos pas ngan 'gror 'gro na khyed rang dpon slob 'gro mod/ nga ston pa gcer bu ba lta bus rjes su bzung ba la/ ngan 'gror 'gro don med do zer te/ phyir la tsog tu song te/'brum bu me dbal nag pos lus dum bu chad de/ smre sngags dang bcas nas mnor med du song ngo / /des nas sdig grogs spangs te dam pa la brten par bya'/ /༈ sdug bsngal bskal gzhan mi len na/ tanan pa zhig la bu ma/dzes pa zhig skyesapa lo bcu gnyis lon pa'i tshe/ gnyen 'dun rnams na re/ khyod shan pa'i rigs yin pas srog bcad la nged rnams gso dgos byas pas/ bus/rigs de ltar yin yang / nga ni sdig la mi 'jug ste/ ngan song gis 'jigs —96—

spyod 'jug sgrung 'grel las 'bras gsal ba'i me long zhes bya ba bzhugs/pas so zer/ gnyen rnamasan re/ khyod kyis shan pa byos shig dang / sdig pa ni yu bu spyi yis bgor ro/ /zhesapa la/ busakyang cung zad cig bsamasanas/mdun na rang gi grogs po zhig 'dug pa la/ nga la nad cig yod pas rgyab tu khu tshur zhig rgyob byas pa bzhin brgyab pas/ bu na re/ nga na bas/ khyed rnamasana'am zer/ khyod la brgyab pas nged ci la na zer/ de bzhin du ngas shan pa byas pa'i rnam smin nga rang gis myong dgos kyis/ khyed la bgor gar btub zer te/ spang zhing chos bsgrubs pas 'bras bu thob bo/ /༈ de srid du ni nags su song / /ston pa 'di sngon rgyal po zhig gi sras su gyur pa na/ sras snga ma mang du shi bas gdon gyis nyen par bzung nas/ lcags kyi khang pa rin chen gyis spras par bcug ste/ gdon gyis mi tshugs pa'i bsrung ba du ma byas te cher skyes nas/ rig pa'i gnas mang du lobs te/ re zhig rang gi yul der ku mu da'i dga' ston byung ba la/ lta ba'i phyir shing rta'i mchog la bzhon nas zhabs 'bring ba du mas bskor te phyin pa na/ glu dang bzhad gad dang / rol mo mkhan sogs skye bo 'bum phrag du ma dga' dga' ltar 'dug pa gzigs kyang / mi rtag pa'i 'du shes la goms pas skyo bar gyur te/ ku mu da yi dpal 'di yang / /dran par bya ba nyid du 'gyur/ /zhes/ pha la rab tu 'byung bar zhus pas/ pha glang po che dug mda' phog pa bzhin du sdug bsngal bar gyur te/ ngas nyes pa'am/ 'bangs kyis nyes pa ma byas par glo bur du cis te nags su 'gro/ bu na re/ bdag la gnod pa byed pa su zhig mchis//bdag ni rtag par 'chi bas 'jigs pa'i phyir/ /rab tu 'byung ngo / /zhesapa —97—

mkhyen brtse'i 'od snang las/ spyod 'jug sgrung 'grel/dpe du ma'i sgo nasazhusapas/ pha na re/ 'chi bdag gi dgra'o/ /de bcosasu mi rung na/ nags su phyin kyang cis phan zer bas/ 'chi bar nges kyang chos pa dga' zhing 'chi/ khyim gyi nang na 'gyod bzhin 'chi ba'i phyir/ /rab tu byung nas nags su bsgoms pas bsam gtan gyi sems thob ste/ tshangs pa'i 'jig rten du skyes so/ /mos pa bzhin du 'gal ba'i kyang / /spyan ras gzigs so skye'i dus na/chung ma byi kho na byas mi thub pa/ grogs po 'jam dpal can phyin nas bzlas pas/ 'jam dpal ni de tsam na shes rab che bas/ khyod nyal khar/ chung ma sgren mor phyung ste skra shig la/ lag tu gri kyog po ring ba zhig bskur la/ ha ha zhes rtag tu zer du chug cig zer ba bzhin nub re bzhin de ltar byed du bcug pas/ chung ma goms so/ /der spyan ras gzigs kyi tshong la phyin pa'i shul du/chung mas grogs po bkug nas nyal khar mos sgren mor sngar bzhin byas pas/byi po bred de bros so/ /de nas tshong log pa'i lam du/ byi po dang phrad de/ gcig gis gcig ngo ma shes yul 'di na mi snyan pa med dam dris pas/ byi po na re/ yul 'di na bud med 'di 'dra ba zhig nub mo nyal khar spyod pa 'di 'dra byed pa zhig kho bos mthong ngo zer/ sdod byi po yin par shes te/ khyim du phyin nas chung ma dang mgo 'jug rnol nas nyal lo/ /sang khyod kyi yongs nas 'di 'dra ba'i gtam byung ngo / /zhes chung ma'i mtshang bzlas pas/ ngas khyod la nges par mngon shes yod snyam nas/ phyis byi mi shor ro/ /—98—

spyod 'jug sgrung 'grel las 'bras gsal ba'i me long zhes bya ba bzhugs/༈ sprin bral nyi zer gyis phye ba'i/ /mnyan yod na/ bcom ldan 'dasa'akhor bcas chos gsungs pa na/ bya rog cig gis phrag pa g.yas su bya thal g.yogs te song ngo / /'khor rnams kyis 'di ci'i ltas zhes zhus pas/ nga mya ngan las 'das pa'i 'og tu/ bram ze rta dbyangs zhes pas nga'i bstan pa rgud par byed pa'i ltas so/ /de cis 'dul zhus pas/ de la dbang phyug gisamangal skyes thams cad kyis mi thub pa'i dngos grub byin nas 'ong bas/ rdzus skyes shig yod na des 'dul gsung / der 'khor de'i nang nas zhig langs te/de'i tshe bdag brdzus skyes su 'gyur la/ de'i gnyen por gyur cig ces smon lam btab bo/ /der dus phyis bya rog de rta dbyangs su skyes pa dang / mnyam du sing ga la'i gling du me tog pad ma zhig 'khrungs so sprin dang bral ba'i nyi mas kha phye ba'i nang nas mi zhig skyes pa ming yang ar+ya de bar btags so/ /de shin tu mdzes mod khyad par du'ang sbyan legs pa des rab tu byung nas skyes thob kyi shes rab dang ldan te/ slob dpon klu sgrub la chos nyan cing dpal gyi ri la bzhugs so/ /de tsa na bi ta ra'i gtsug lag ni mu stegs pas dbang byed do/ /dge 'dun rnams ma dga' nas/ rdo sku'i mgon po la gsol ba btab pas/mgon po'i thugs ka nas bya rog cig byung ba'i ske sa na len+d+ra'i gtsug lag ni mu stegs pas dbang byed do/ /zhes pa'i yi ge btags btang bas/ bya rog gis 'phags pa yab sras kyi drung du babs te/ yi ge gzigs nas/ yab sras gnyis gcig gis rta dbyangs kyi gzhung bzung nas rtsod pas/ ar+ya de ba ma thub nas/ der ar+yas/ shing khur gyi nang du chos gos rnams sbas te/ na —99—

mkhyen brtse'i 'od snang las/ spyod 'jug sgrung 'grel/len+d+rar byon nas/ nga ni 'phagasapa lha'o/ /zhesapasadage 'dun dga'o/ /der tsha ba gsol zhing bzhugs pa'i dus la rta dbyangs 'ongs nas/ dkar tshod 'thung ngam nag tshod 'thung zer bas/ 'phags pas dkar po gsol byas pas kho dpyad pa skyes te/ sngar med pa'i mgo ni gang nas 'ongs zer/ ske las so zer/ mig te lam lasaso zer/ 'o na lam rang la dris zhes sogs byung kyang /sang rtsod pa'i dusabatab bo/ khu stegasal/ sring mo/ ne+e tso/ rdo rgyus/ kho rang dang bzhi yod/ 'phags pas/ de'i nub byi la la ne tso'i gzugs bsnyad do/ /sang rtsod pa'i sa gzhi mar nag gis byugs dge bsnyen zhig gcer bur phyung nas 'phongs dang dbang po la me tog gis brgyan/ mu stegs kyi bla re la bre la cam lham chur bcug pa gcig btags so/ /sang gnyisaka seng khri la 'dug ste rtsod pa na/ mu stegs na re/ nga mi dgos rdo rgyus 'dis lan thob zer/ sngon du btang bas/ mar nag gi gzhi la brir ma btub bo/ /der ne+e tso btang nas mdun du sgra sbyor ba na/ 'phags pas byi la btang ste 'phur te song ngo / /sring mo btang bas/ 'phags pas dge bsnyen gcer bu btang bsango tsha nas bros so/ /der mu stegs khorang na re/ khyed sangs rgyas pa ne tso la byi la gtong ba snying rje med do zer/ nga'i mas/ sdig bshagasabyed cing yod/ khyod kyi sdig la mas sdig bshags pas ci la phan zer/ byi las ne+e tso bsad pa nga la ci la gnod/ kho la smra ba'i thabs med de/ 'phags pa la mig gsum bltas pas/ 'phagasapas/ brgya byin mig stong ldan kyang de nyid mthong ba med/ /de bzhin rta dbyangs mig gsum gyis ni ci zhig mthong / /ar+ya de ba mig gcig —100—

spyod 'dug sgrung 'grel las 'bras gsal ba'i me long zhes bya ba bzhugs/gis ni thams cad mthong / /de bas mig gsum bstan pa'i dgos pa ci zhig yod/ /ces smras te/ rkang pa sa la brdabs pas rkang mthil thams cad mig gis gang bas mu stegs la bstan pas/ des der skyengs pas mig nam mkha' la bltas pas/ cag lham gyi chu thigs khar lhung bas lha mnal nas smra ma shes der yi mug ste lce la sbu gri btab ste lcebs so/ /sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa ni dar bar byas sa/ /༈ dur khrod dag tu bor ba'i lus/ /ta ra be'i gtsug lag khang na/ dge tshul shin tu 'dod chags che ba zhig yod pa/ bud med kyi reg bya la chags te/cha lugs sgyur bar byed pa'i skabs su/ shāri'i bus/ bsil ba'i tshal gyi dur khrod du khrid de/ bud med kyi ro bam pa dang sngos pa dang / keng rus su 'dug pa / sogs rim bzhin bstan nas 'di lta bu'i chosacan no/ /zhes chos du ma bstan yang ma nyan/ de nas bud med kyi rul pa'i mngal na srin bu mang po 'dug pa bstan nas 'di lta bu la su zhig chags zhes mi gtsang ba'i chos du ma gsungs pas/ dge tshul ni re/ srin bu 'di kun re dga' na zhes ma nyan pa/bocom ldan 'dos la zhusapas/ nga kho na'i gdul bya'o/ /zhes btul bas/stan pas thul la/ / ༈ de nas me tog zla mdzes kyi/ sngon sangs rgyas mngon 'phags rin chen rgyal po 'jig rten du byon nas/ sems can dpag tu med pa byang chub la bkod de/ mya ngan las 'das nas bstan pa'ang nub tu nye ba na/ pho brang rin chen ldan du/ rgyal po dpa' byin zhes pa/ bu stong / bu mo lnga brgya/ btsun mo —101—

mkhyen brtse'i 'od snang las/ spyod 'jug sgrung 'grel/brgyad khri bzhi stong yod pa zhig byung ngo / /de'i tshe bstan pa nyams pas nag phyogs kha rgyal te/ yul der mug nag sogs mi shis pa du ma byung ba/ de nas byang sems bdun stong yod pa'i nyes par bzung ste bskrad pa/ pho brang dang ha cang yang mi ring ba na/ kun tu bzang po'i nagasakhrod ces pa na/ chos smra ba me tog zla mdzes bzhugs pa de la brten nas/ chos kyi rnam grangs 'di nyan zhing rnal 'byor la brtson par gyur to/ /de nas zla mdzes gcig pur yang dag 'jog la bzhugs te/ lha mig dag pas gzigs pas/ phyogs bcu'i zhid sna tshogs nas byang sems mang po 'dir skyes pas/ de dag la chos bstan na rang gi srog gi bar chad du 'gyur kyang / sems can rnams byang chub la phyir mi ldog la / ma bstan na bar chad du mi 'gyur mod / sems can rnams log par lhung par gzigs te/ ting nge 'dzin de las langs nas 'khor byang sems rnams la smras pa/ kho bo ni grong khyer du chos ston du 'gro'o zhes pas/ byang sems rnams na re/ khyod ni mdzes sdug cing yid 'ong la/ grong khyer 'di ni/ dam pa'i chos spong zhing 'phags pa la skur pa 'debs pa log pa'i nga rgyal can mang pos gang nas/ rgyal po la sogs pa phrag dog can gyis khyed kyi srog phral na mi rung ngo //zhes nga sa/ kho bos srog bsrungs nas bstan pa bsrung bar mi 'gyur ro/ /zhes song nas bza' btung yid la mi byed par/ nyin mo chos bstan nas srog chags bye ba brgya stong mang po phyir mi ldog pa la bkod de/ mtshan mo bcom ldan 'das kyi sen mo'i mchod rten gyi drung du 'greng bzhin du mnyam par bzhag go/de ltar zhag drug 'das nas kyang zas kyi bya ba ma byas par/ nyi ma bdun pa la —102—

spyod 'jug sgrung 'grel las 'bras gsal ba'i me long zhes bya ba bzhugs/rin chen ldan du byon pas/ rgyal po rin chen shing rta la bzhon nas/ bu mo brgyad brgyas rin chen tha gus drangs te/ rgyal rigs bram ze sogs du mas zhabs 'bring du byas nas/ bu mo dang btsun mo rnams kyang rin chen gyi khyogs su bteg ste mdun nas 'gro ba de dag gis/ dge slong de mthong ba tsam gyis dad de/ rang rang gi bzhon pa las babs nas phyag 'tshal nas/ chos bstan pas phyir mi ldog pa la bkod do/ /der rgyal po 'di snyam du/ kye ma/ 'di dag thams cad ni dge slong 'di'i dbang du gyur nas/ kho bo la rgyab kyis phyogs so snyam mo/ /rgyal po'i lam na/ dge slong 'dug pa de'i mig tu sdug bsngal song bas/ kye ma dge slong 'dis bdag gi btsun mo la zhen sems kyis bltas nas/ mig gis kyang brda byas so snyam phrag dog lhag par skyes nas/ dge slong 'di gsod nus pa su yod ces dris pas ma byung bar/ rang gi bu stong la dge slong 'di srog dang phrol cig /zhes pas/ bu rnamasakyisakyang slar bzlog pas/kye ma bu dag kyang bka' mi nyan na gzhan lta cis smos/ bdag gcig pu gnyis su med par bzhag na/ da dge slong 'di gsod pa su yod dam snyam du sems khong du chud pa'i tshe/ rgyasnyesmu po dang ha cang yang mi ring ba na/ gshed ma dga' byed ces pa 'dug pa la/ khyod la bya dga' cher byin no// /dge slong 'di srog dang bral nus sam byas pas/ de dga' nas/ lha rngo thogs so go zhes zer nas/ de la mtshon bskur te/ 'disanga'i btsun mo+ocan phyin pasarkang pa gtsinachod cig/ brda zhig byasapasalag pa gnyisachod cig /chagasasemasakyisabaltas pas mig gnyis kyang skam pas phyung zhig /sna dang rna ba yang chod cig ces —103—

mazhi h+phu'i 'od snang las/ spyod wīg sgrung 'grel/sna lus dum bu brgyad du d+kud pas khrag 'o zlor 'bab cing /d+kud ༵ la saltasabargyad dang /ma3 bzang zlo+o sornyinyasakyang snang ngo / /ṭ+wā+oṃd radu ma yang phyogs bcur bskor nasaskunyado lam mo//der 'dusopa kyaibo//thasnas cad kyang brgyal ba sangs nas pha brang du sang nga //rgyal po'adā dga' k+tan du zhag zlodun nags su lkoms nas/slar pha ḍing ṣ+yo 'gra ba' lar+sha// 5ga pa sha nas zhag bdun lan yang /sku sngisna kya mdag ma skyar /mtshan ltas bzang po rnams kyang mthong nas/'ad bla na med pa' byang chub lasaphyir mildogapar ngesan/cwagagis༅ra ne duskye pho lasabyasaso//rme mi /༷/ spres/ci 1nge/snyamasnadang /nam mkharnyilas/lha' bu brgyad ༷da dbyangs ga tu/ de ban te/las des khyod myur du mnar med pa' dmyal bar bsreg par 'gyur ro//zhesapas/rgyalapobaspu'akhrugasmra te/smre sngagasabaton nas 'gyod sems drag pos bshags te/sku gdung na r+pā snro+ogs la spyan drangs nas/ā+oṃridanadadā/akaru dang /'bru mar soljasakyasabasregasate/sku gdung la na po gī mchod rten dz+nyo nardzu/drung du+o ga pa 3gas te/'isdug bsngal dz+nyoms cad kya rtsabargyal da kyar+shar+shadayan spangs nas tshul khrams bzungasdi/gsosbyongal༅sakyang/lus mthagamanar/r+sha dulhungango/'i/mthar gapabashaṅgisate/'akro+o yon spangs nas tshul ba sems pa' 'bras bu gsang drung ṭ+wāṃ thob pa yan no//zhes so//mi ༈denyad mesdon ji dgara'agyuraphyi//:sna posudapa de/sngar seng ge'i nga thos pa tsam gyas 'gas pa la/0rdo dwags bshor du phyin pa na/seng

spyod 'jug sgrung 'grel las 'bras gsal ba'i me long zhesabya ba bzhugs/ge mo gcig dang bza' mir gyur nas/ de nas seng ge mo med dus mi dga' ba bzhin no/ ༈ pha dang ma yang gsod byed cing / /ston pa 'das nas lo nyis brgya na/ lho phyogs bha ru nar/ bram ze lha bzang zhes pa rnam thos kyi bu ltar 'byor kyang / bu med par lha la gsol ba btab pas/ zla ba bcu na khye'u zhig btsas pa lha chen du btags te/ de'i btsas ston gyi phyir pha rgya mtshor lo mang du thogs nas/ bu de skyed drag pas myur du lang tsho la bab ste/ ma dang 'byar/mas khyod nga dang lhan cig sdod 'dod na pha gsad dgos byas pas/ bus lam du pha gsad kyang ma rang bzhin gyis g.yem la dga' bas skyes pa gzhan bsten pas/ bu 'khrugs te ma yang bsad/ mchod gnas dgra bcom la chos mnyan pa'i tshe/ las 'bras kyi chos bstan te/ mi dge ba'i nang nas mtshams med kho na lci'o/ /zhes pas/ kho'i rang gnong gis/ 'di'i mngon shes kyis tshor nges so snyam nas dgra bcom kyang bsad de yi mug pas longs spyod thams cad su 'dod pa la byin nas/ dbus su 'khyamasanas/ 'tsho ba slong ba'i phyir/ btsun gzugs byas nas/ bas mtha' gcig tu bsdad pas/ shing thun dang ba rdzi sogs kyis mthong nas chos zhus pas/ mchod gnas dgra bcom pa la thos pa bag re bzlas pas/ de dag gis kho'i snyan pa brjod de/ 'khor 'bum phrag du ma 'dus nas/ khagasag dang / g.yo sgyu'i 'bul nor byung ba thams cad slar yang de dag la 'gyed pas/ thams cad dad nas dgra bcom du khas blangs so//mi chos bla ma'i rdzun rlabs can de'i drung du thams cad 'dus nas/ spyil po'i dbus nor byung ba thams cad du sgom byed pa'i tshul du bsdad de bsams pas/—105—

mkhyen brtse'i 'od snang las/ spyod 'jug sgrung 'grel/'dod log gi phyir pha ma dgra bcom bsad nas/ rdzun gyis skye bo mang po'i mgo bskor bas/ 'gro ba ni dmyal ba las med na snyam pa'i yi mug ste/ kye ma/sdug bsngal lo zhes smras pa'i smre sngags/ mkhan bu rnams kyis thos te/ dgra bcom sdug bsngal las grol ba yin na/ ci'i phyir smre zhes pas/ ngas ni bden bzhi bos pa'o/ /zer/ 'khor rnamasakyisamosadrisapas/ nga rang yang the tshom za zer/ dgra bcom pa la'ang yid gnyis mchis sam zer/ shin tu'ang yod de/ the tshom thams cad spangs pa ni sangs rgyas nyag gcig go zer/ rdzu'aphrul ston par zhus pas/ da nang tho rangs nyams zer/ dgra bcom la'ang nyams pa mchis sam byas pas/ yod de/ yongs su nyams pa'i chos can gyi dgra bcom pa zhes pas so/ /'dod yon brten pas/ dgra bcom la yang 'dod chags yod dam ces pas/ lus sems ma bsrungs na yod zer/ de bsrung dgos sam byas pas/ dgos te/ rjes su bsrung pa'i chos can gyi dgra bcom pa zhes gsungs pas so zer/ der 'chi khar sa'i bar 'thongs phye nas lus de nyid kyis mnar med du song ngo / /༈ dkon mchog gsum gyi dkor brkus nas/ /na len+d+ra'i byang phyogs na/su khyen grong zhes pa sa phug dang bcas pa zhig na/ byis pa mang po rtse ba'i dbus su/ rlung tshub 'khyil ba/ mi 'phro ba zhig byung ba la/ byis pa rnams kyis rdo rub byas pas/ byis pa zos dus su 'bog pa zhig la btab nas/ rkang pa phyed ka log tu 'gro zhing / lpags pa'i skyi shig shig byas te/ kha nas me lce nyug cing / saṃskṛ ta'i skad du thams cad la 'bar ro/ /de'i nye 'khor na byams pa —106—

spyod 'jug sgrung 'grel las 'bras gsal ba'i me long zhes bya ba bzhugs/sgom pa'i rnal 'byor pa zhig yod pas des gsan nas byis pa 'di 'dras kyang saṃskṛ ta'i skad shes pa ngo mtshar che'o/ /snyam nas nyan du phyin pas/ de la mi 'bar bar 'dug nas rgyu mtshan dris pas 'di rnams sdang sems kyis nyan pas 'bar la/ khyod dang sems kyis nyan pas mi 'bar ba yin zer/ 'o na 'dir las gang gis skyes dris pas/ btsun g.yi+on 'di rnams thon zhig /khyod byams pa'i rnal 'byor pa bzang po zhig 'dug pas drang por bshad do zer te/ ston pas/ nga na len+d+ra'i mkhan po rgyal 'byung yin te/ nga rang bdag po yin snyam nas/ dge 'dun gyi 'bras snyigs bre phyed thub chod du bcad pas/ da lta lto sreg pa'i yi dwags su skyes nas/ rtag tu nang khrol thams cad 'bar mes sreg pa'i me lte kha sna nas nyug pa yin/ sde snod bzhugs pa'i gtsug lag khang du mchil lham ma phud par phyin pas/ rkang pa phyi ka log tu 'chu ba dang / nga'i 'du khang gi thub sku la sgron me phul bas sku mnye byas te/ sbyin pa 'tshab pa ma grub par/ lhags pa'i skyi shig pa'i rdul rtag tu yod pas dkor 'di 'jigs/dkon mchog gsum la dge 'dun gyi dkor 'di kho na lci bar 'dug go zer/'di las dag lo stong phrag bco lnga na thar te/ de nas mnar med du 'gro dgos pa 'dug pa zer/ 'di la bshags thabs med dam byas pas/ las 'bras la khyad bsod byas pas ye med zer/ dge 'dun gyi dkor la 'dzems na phan yon che ste/ nga'i nye gnas dpal yon bya ba/ dge 'dun la srog pas gces shing yo byad la dug pas 'jigs pa zhig yod de/ kho 'chi khar 'ja' 'od dang rol mo dang bcas nas/ lha dang chos skyong gis bsus nas song / kho da tsam 107—

mkhyen brtse'i 'od snang las/ spyod 'jug sgrung 'grel/'khor ba las grol te 'chi gsung / 'o na btsun gzhon rnams gdon pa'i rgyu mtshan drisapas/ de thamasacad nga'i mkhan bu yin te/ thos na nga ngo tsha/ khong rnams yi mug nas 'gro zer/ de nas dar tsam zhig dran med song / yang lab pa la/ da ci nas gar phyin dris pas/ phu ya gi na rnal 'byor pa zhig 'dug pa'i dge sbyor gyi bar chad la phyin zer/ khyed mkhan po sde snod gsum shes pa zhig de 'dra byed pa zhan byas pas/ bden te nga'i shesapa la rang dbang med zer/ yang / sad kyang byis pa de la btab nas lusathams cad drod du byas te/kha sna nas ni me lce nyug cing / thamasacad la 'bar ba la/ sngar gyi rnal 'byor pa de spyan drangs te/ kho bo'i dmigs pa gcig byas pas/ kho rgod cing /gtum po'i skye rim la bstan pa thob pas 'jig rten gyi nus mthu can su la'ang mi 'jigs zer/ 'o na kho can 'ongasapa'i rgyu mtshan drisapas/ ngas zas bag re rnyed kyang zos na/ lho'i me la shing bsnan pa bzhin 'gyur gin 'dug nas/sngar 'dris kyi bag chags kyis/ kho ltogs pa la ster du 'ongs pa yin te/kho'i las ngan sad rkyen byed kyin 'dug pa zer/ de dag gi rgyu mtshan dris pas/nga mkhan po byed dus su/ kho na len+d+rar brda sprod slob tu 'ongs nas/ brtul zhugs dang mi ldan par/ dge 'dun gyi tshul dang chu shing la dpyad pa'i mthong chosasozer/ desamadzad dam drisapas/ myong 'og btsugasakyis/ rnam smin/phyi ma yi dwags su 'gro zer/ de la bshags thabs yod dam dris pas/ dge 'dun rang la bsnyen bkur byas te/ spyan sngar mthol zhing bshags nas 'dag go zer/ rnal 'byor pas de la dmigasapa'i byams pa yud tsam skyes pas/—108—

spyod 'jug sgrung 'grel las 'bras gsal ba'i me long zhes bya ba bzhugs/thal mo sbyar te/ ma yang byon bdog gam zer nas 'chi ma phral byas te/ song nasaphyin chad der ma 'khor ro/ /der de bzhin du tshogasasu mthol te/ gleng bas der 'dus tsho khong gi mkhan bu yin par 'dug nas thams cad cho nges so//des na/ bcom ldan 'das kyis dge 'dun gyi rdzas la sha bu'i 'du shesabazhag par bya'o/ /zhes pa'i don to/ /༈ rmongs rnams sdug bsngal mi zad len/ khyim bya'i lha khang na dge 'dun gyi gnas gzhi zhig yod pa las/ der skyes bu lnga brgya tsam gyis dge 'dun gsol ba'i 'bab chu rtogasaso/ /der 'brasabasdur ma btub nasadago'adun gyi chosaston chag go /de ni byang chub sems dpa' dgra las rnam rgyal bzhugs pa la / dge 'dun rnams kyi tshogs dpon byas pas/ rdo rje gdan na skar ma sa ga'i mchod pa la blta ru gshegs zer ba bzhin phyin pa'i lam du bye rlung chen po zhig na bud med kyi skad cig gnya' tser gyis drag nas bltas pas/ yi dwags mo chen mo zhig la bu lnga brgya skyes nas 'dug pa gzigs so/ /der yi dwags mo na re/ byang chub sems dpa' bdag cag la zas skom byin cig zer/ byang chub sems dpa' 'gyur mgul de nas chu blud pas gre bar ma song bar/ khro bo mi g.yo ba'i sngags kyis byin gyis brlabs nas byin pas tshim par gyur ro/ /der yi dwags mo na re/ khyed rdo rje gdan du gshegs na 'phrin cig gsungs shig /nga'i khyo zasa'atshol du song nasazla ba drug lon te/ zasakhyer la myur du shog /nga ni shi la khad na zer ro/ /gsungasashig /de ngasango mi shesabyasapas/mig ya gcig med pa/ rna ba ya gcig med pa/ lag pa dang rkang pa'ang ya re —109—

mkhyen brtse'i 'od snang las/ spyod 'jug sgrung 'grel/med pa zhig bdog go zer/ de ngas mi mthong byas pas/ rdzas 'di bcangs pas mthong zer te rdzas shig bskur ro/ /der byang chub sems dpa' gdan du byon nas snying rje'i bsam pas/ yi dwags mo'i 'phrin ma brjed de/ lho ngos gshin rje'i lha khang du phyin nas bltas pas/ 'dre thams cad gong bu gcig tu 'dus nas 'dug /sa bslang bas/ thams cad langs pa'i yi dwagasamo'i khyo byung ba gzigs te/ 'phrin bzlas pas/ yi dwagasan re/ ngas zla ba drug gi bar du zla zas btsal yang ma rnyed/ da lta mi gcig gis lud pa bor ba thob pas/ 'dre thams cad 'dus te brdungs nas sdug bsngal ba gzigs so/mchil ma de yang da ni bskams 'dug na zer/ byang chub sems dpas ngas zas skom sbyin gyis khyer la song byas pas/ yi dwags gzhan gyis 'phrog zer/der byang chub sems dpas zas skom bum pa gnyis la/ khro bo mi g.yo ba'i sngags kyis srung ba byas nas bskur bas/ bu smad gyi gam du phyin nas zos pas tshim par gyur te/ de nas skar ma sa ga'i dus mchod thos nas/ byang chub sems dpa' 'khor bcas kyis slar bhang ga lar byon pa'i lam du sngar gyi yi dwags rnams dang 'phrad de/ phyag 'tshal nas/ der yang zas skom byin no/ /byang chub sems dpas khyed du yod dris pas/ lnga brgya'o zer 'dir las cis skyes byas pas/ khyed 'dzam bu gling pa yid ches par dka' bas mi smra zer/ngas mngon sum du mthong bas yid ches so byas pas/ nged rnams kyis khyim bya'i lha khang gi dge 'dun gyi chu rnyogs te/ chos ston bcag pas so zer/ nged 'di las thar pa'i thabs mnga'am zer/ byang chub sems dpas thabs yod —110—

spyod 'jug sgrung 'grel las 'bras gsal ba'i me long zhes bya ba bzhugs/ kyis sems rtse gcig tu gyis la/ yi ge drug pa bzlos shig gsungs pa bzhin/yi dwags rnams kyis kyang de bzhin du byas pas/ de ma thag tu tshe 'phos nas sum cu rtsa gsum du skyes so/ /༈ bsam pa nyams pa'ang skye bar 'gyur/ /bskal ba dang po'i tshe 'dzam bu'i gling 'dir/ rgyal po bsnyen pa'i spyi bo'i lba ba las khye'u mdzes pa zhig byung ba / mtshan mkhan gyis gling bzhi la dbang bar lung bstan nas/ spyi bo skyes su btags te/ yab 'das pa dang rgyal tshab zhus pas/ nga la rgyal po'i dbang thang zhig yod na/ de dag 'bad med du 'byung bar gyur cig ces pas/ 'dzam gling kun du ci 'dod babs pas/ blon po rnams la/ 'di su'i mthu dris pas/rgyal po'i yon tan dang sems can gyi bsod nams so zer bas nga'am/sems can su'i yin par 'bab par gyur cig ces pas/ gzhan du 'bab 'phro chad nas pho brang nyid du zhag bdun babs te/ 'dzam gling du lo khri phrag mang po bde ba spyad pa dang / rgyal po nyid kyis gzigs pa'i gnod sbyin lha gnas kyis/'di bas kyang lus 'phags pa gling na 'byor pa che bas/ der gshegs par nga/gyes pa tsam gyis 'khor lo nam mkha' la 'phags te/ rgyal phran rnams kyis bsus nas/ der lo stong phrag du ma dga' bde spyad pa dang / yang lha gnas kyis/ ba glang spyod dang / sgra mi snyan dang / ris bzhin yang sngar bzhin spyad do/ /yang rtsa gsum du bskul te/ sna bdun 'phags pas/ de ma thag tu/rgyal po 'khor bcas nam mkha' la 'gro bas/ rta glang gi rtswa chus ri rab kyi khong seng na drang srong lnga brgya yod pa'i lus la phog na/ 'di ci zhig rtog pa —111—

mkhyen brtse'i 'od snang las/ spyod 'jug sgrung 'grel/dang / drang srong blo dang ldan pa zhig na re/ spyi bo skyes sum stortsa gsum du song / zer gyis/ de'i rta glang gi bshang gci'o zer nas/ bshang gci phog pas khros nas/ drang srong de dag gis ting nge 'dzin gyis bcings pas/ rgyal po dpung bcas kyis 'gro bar ma nus par/ rgyal pos kyang de ltar shes nas/nga la rgyal po'i dbang thang yod na/ drang srong de dag nga la phyag 'tshal te/ nga'i zhabs 'bring la 'byung bar gyur cig ces pas/ de ma thag tu thams cad byung nas zhabs 'bring byas te byon pa mthong nas lha rnams sngangs te/ sgo thams cad bcad nasabatang ba sum rim bcug go /der spyi bo skyesakyisadung bus/ gzhu rgyud bsgrengs pas/ sgo thamasacad rang bye nas/ brgya byin gyis ma bzod par rings par bsu ste/ stan phyer bstabs nas/ lha'i dbang po drug gi bar du dga' bde spyad pa'i/ lha dbang tha ma byang sems 'od srung gi tshe/ lha min gyi dmag gis pham par byas te/ lha dbang brosapa na/ spyi bo skyes kyis dung bus/gzhu rgyud bsgrengs pas/ lha min chu nang du byer bas nga rgyal skyes te/ 'dir dbang po gnyisami dgosapas/ 'di bsad la nga 'ba' zhig gisabya'o/ /snyam pa'i ngan sems skyes ma thag tu pho brang rnying pa'i sgo drung du lhung nas de'u rer shi'o/ /der mi rnamasalhagasate su yin zhesa'adri'o/ /sngar gyi blon rgan gling skyong zhes pas ngo shes te/ 'jig rten pa dag 'dri na ji ltar lan gdab par bya zhes dris pa'i lan du/ gling bzhi/ lha gnas gnyisakyisa'adod pas chog ma shes par bsam ngan skyes te rtsa gsum nas lhung nas/ 'dzam gling du tshe'i dus byas te/ mnar med du song ngo zhes lan thob cig zer nas 'gyod bzhin du —112—

spyod 'jug sgrung 'grel las 'bras gsal ba'i me long zhes bya ba bzhugs/tshe'i dus byas so/ /de lta bu'i 'byor pa de ni sngon sran 'tshong du gyur pa na/sangos rgyas pa ru sha la sran ma phyed dang lnga dad gus kyis gtor ba'i 'bras bu'/ /༈ de yi phun tshogasazad mi shes/ /mnyan yod dang ha cang yang mi ring ba na / sngon gyi de bzhin gshegs pa la bya ba byas pa des pa zhes pa zhig yod pa des/ gsal rgyal chog mi shes shing 'dod pa la brkam pas/ khyim bdag lnga brgya'i bdog pa phrogs nas mi kun bzung ba de gdul ba'i phyir/ phyags dar khrod nas rin chen 'dzam gling gi nor thams cad pas dga' ba zhig rnyed pa dang / su dbul ba la ster ro zhes pas/ der tshogs pa'i mul sprang sogs la mi ster bar/ khyod pas ches dbul ba gsal rgyal la ster zer ba thos nas/nga la gter mdzod 'di rnyed cig yod na/ dbul ba'i rgyu mtshan ci dris pa'i lan du/ rin chen gter mchog dpag med kyang / /chog mi shesashing brkam pa khyod/ /'jig rten 'di na chesadabul lo/ /byasapas/ de ldodapang po su yod zer/ mosakyi rje'o/ /ngasaspyan drang ngo zer ba la/ mi dgosa'abyon par 'gyur gyis zer te/ kun mkhyen rgyal po kun gzigasapas/ /bdag gisabasam pa mkhyen mdzod la/ /byang chub bdag gi drung bzhud cig khresapasabyon nas/rgyal pos zhus pas/ des pa bden te/ khyod ni zhesasogs 'dod yon gyi nyesadamigs gsungs pas/ khyim bdag nor dang bcas pa btang nas/ rang gi rgyal srid kyang spangs te/ sems bskyed do/ /༈ 'phel phyir skabs dbye mi bya ste/ /dz+nyā na shrī'i paṇa chung gu na shrī zhes pa/—113—

mkhyen brtse'i 'od snang las/ spyod 'jug sgrung 'grel/'dod pa chung zhing chog shes pa/ sbyangs pa'i yon tan la gnas pa de ci yang mi 'dzin pas/ gtor ma rdo leb kyi steng du/ khyor bas chu ldugs pa la/ bla chen stag tshas mi bzhed bzhin du gtor snod cig nan gyis phul/ de'i grogs su chu bum zhig kyang phul/ de nas mchod cha/ dpe rten sogs 'bul ba bag re blangs pas/ phyis 'dod pa 'phel te/ mnga' ris kyi mkhan po mdzad nas/stod phyogs kyi gnas dgon thams cad btad kyang chog ma shes par/ thang chung du yi ge skur phyin pa zhig byung ngo / /gang zhig yid 'ong mi 'dzin pa/ /spyal chos bzang rdo rje gdan na/ lo tsā slob pa'i rgyags skyel ba lho phyogs kyi tshong pa mang po dang 'grogs te/ phyin pa'i lam du shi skyid byung nas/ nor kun khyer/ mi kun bsad de/ gser mid yod de zer nas rgyu ma'ang ded pa la/ nyang stod sgom dad ces pa skud pa tsam zhig kyang bdag tu mi 'dzin pa zhig kyang sangs rgyas kyi gdan sa lan gcig mthong na snyam nas 'grogs phyin pa de la/ nam bza' phyag dar lhum po zhig las med par/ pen da ba de la reg na/ mkhar che ldog go zer te/ gsod 'phrog lta zhog reg pa'ang ma byung ba bzhin no/ /'gro la phan phyir lus btang bya/ /tshong pa mang pos rgya mtsho la nor bu 'don du phyin pas/ gzings zhig nas tshong pa thams cad shi /sems bskyed pa'i mi zhig yod pa ma shi nas 'ongs pas/ rgya gar gyi phyug po'i lugs kyis/rgyal po'i chad pa'am/ dgra byung na gsug gtong ba'i gser srang gsum bzhi re lus la 'chang ba yin pas kho la'ang gser srang gsum yod pa/ nub mo mgron —114—

spyod 'jug sgrung 'grel las 'bras gsal ba'i me long zhes bya ba bzhugs/khang zhig tu nyal bas rkun po kha cig byung ste/ kho la nor blang byas pas/ kho sems bskyed pa yin pas/ gser srang gsum po mod la byin pas/ rkun pos/'di tsam dus la ster lugs kyis/ da dung yod snyam nas/ da dung blang byasapas/ med do zer/ 'o na khyod gsod do byasapas/ gsod kyang med zer/der snying khar pha bong zhig gis mnan nas mig tu gri btsugs te 'don no byas pas/ mig 'don kyang da nga la nor ni med kyis thon cig byas pas/ rkun po dpyad pa skyes nas/ khyod la yon tan ci yod dris pas/ nga la yon tan gzhan med/sems bskyed de lus srog chags med du semasal btang bas so zer/rkun po dad de/ gser yang slar byin/ kho rang yang g.yog tu byas so/ /༈ yang slob dpon klu sgrub klu'i yul nas 'bum spyan 'dren pa'i dus su/slob dpon byad gzugs shin tu mdzes pa la/ klu rnams chags te/ khyod la nged kyi bu mo sbyin no sdod zer/ slob dpon na re/ sngon la ngas mi yul du phyin la / mchod rten bye ba phrag rgya brtsigs te 'ong ngo zer/ der 'bum gyi po ti gcig rting par bzhag nas gzhan spyan drangs so/ /der mi yul du mchod rten re'i nang du sgrol ma la sogs pa'i sku re re bzhugs pa bye ba phrag brgya ru gcig gis ma tshang ba brtsigs te/ klu thamasacad kyisagrogasabyas pas myur du/ grub bo/ /gcig ni ma brtsigasate/ klu'i yul du 'gro ba dgag pa'i phyir ro/ /der slob dpon gyis lho phyogs dpal gyi ri la byon nas seng khri la bzhugs te/nang re bzhin du/ mi rnams la ci 'dod sbyin no zhes smras nas/ bcud len dang / rig pa la sogs pa gang dang gang 'dod pa ster ro/ /de nasanam zhig —115—

mkhyen brtse'i 'od snang las/ spyod 'jug sgrung 'grel/rgyal po sa lam ba ha na zhes bya ba zhig bcud len slob par 'dod pa'i skabs su/ de'i bus ma la smrasapa/ ngas yab kyi rgyal srid 'di nam thob/ ma na re/khyod kyi pha ni slob dpon la bcud len bslabs nas tshe nyi zla dang mnyam par 'gro ste/ khyod kyisargyal srid mi 'thob bo zer/ bu na re/ 'o na thob pa'i thabs 'dra yod dam/ yod de/ sang slob dpon klu sgrub seng ge'i khri steng nas ci 'dod sbyin no zer gyis/ de'i drung du song la dbu slongasashig /'on kyang khyod kyi pha labacud len mislobapas/ pha myur du'achol/ der khyod kyisargyalasrid thobabozhesasmrasaso/ /der bus/ ber nag cig gyon nasaral gri mchan du bcug ste/ slob dpon gyi drung du phyin nas/ bdag la dbu stsol cig byas te/lag pa bzed pas/ slob dpon gyis rtswa ku sha zhig phyag gnyis kyis bzung ste/dbu d+kud nas byin no/ /der ske'i rtsa bo che lnga'i nang nas/ nga yi yid ni bde ba can gyi zhing du 'gro/ /tshe lo lnga bcu pa la 'gro ba'i don du 'ong / zhes sogs/ tshigs tshogs bcad mang du byung ngo / /de nas rgyal po'i busadabu khyer te phyin pas/ slob dpon gyi mngag gzhug pa'i gnod sbyin rnams kyis/ rgyal bu ske btsir te bsad do/ /gnod sbyin rnamasakyis/ dbu btegasal/ sker bzhag par gzas pas dbu ma theg go /lo re zhing nas tsam gyis je nye je nyer 'ong ste/ phrad tsam na slob dpon 'byon no/ /da lta lasadag pasakyang sku dang /dbu mthong ste/ rtag tu 'o ma 'dzag cing / rlangs pa thol le/ deng sang ni phrad la khad yod par grags te/ tshe lo lnga bcu par nye ba'i phyir ro/ /le'u brgyad pa' —116—

spyod 'jug sgrung 'grel las 'bras gsal ba'i me long zhes bya ba bzhugs/ka9 le'u dgu pa'i skabs kyi gtam rgyud bshad pa/bcom ldan sgyu ma mkhan gsum dang / /mig sman sang ku gsal thub dang //sgur chung me mgal khyi gu dang / /las 'brasabar phyug bzang po'o/ /bcurtegasum nor ba yang blo khyad kyi/ bcom ldan 'das 'khor bcas/ bya rgod phung po'i ri la bzhugs pa'i tshe/ /kun dga' bo'i shes rab brtag pa'i ched du/bka' bstsal pa/ kun dga' bo/ 'di nas rgyal po'i khab tu khyod song la/ nga na ba la 'o ma tshol la shog cig ces so/ /der kun dga' bos grong khyer du phyin pa dang li tsa byi dri ma med par grags pa shes rab mchog tu gyur par mthong nas dris pa dang / kun dga' bos lan ji lta ba bzhin du gsol bas/ dri med grags pas smras pa/ bcom ldan 'das ni rdo rje'i sku ste/ sdug bsngal ma lus pa nye bar bcom pas na/ sku la snyun mi mnga' ste/ de ltar sems dpa' ni khyod rab tu 'khrul lo zhes sogs rtsod pa du ma'i sgo nas sun phyung pas/ kun dga' bo slar log nas bcom ldan 'das kyi drung du phyin pas/ khyod kyis 'o ma rnyed dam gsungs/ lan du dri ma med pa'i gtam rgyud smras pas/ bcom ldan 'das na re/ de de bzhin du bden te/ 'on kyang ngas ni/ 'khor ba'i mosadang bstun te/ khyod kyi shes rab brtag pa'i ched du'o/ /gsung ngo / /༈ gal te sems can sgyu 'dra na/ /mnyan yod kyi grong khyer na sgyu ma mkhan zhig gi khyim du/ mgron po lha bzo ba zhig gis zhag sa byas so/ /der sgyu ma mkhan des/ bu mo shin tu mdzes pa zhig sprul te/ nub mo mgron po lha sgro117—

mkhyen brtse'i 'od snang las/ spyod 'jug sgrung 'grel/bzo ba de la rngul yab byed du bcug go /der mgron po de bu mo la sems shin tu chags nas lag pa 'jus pas/ shing khrog la sogs par gyur te/ bu mo zhig go /der mgron po skyengasanasango tsha ste/ nyal ba'i logasade nyid du/kho rang bkyigs te shi ba'i gzugs brnyan cig bris te bros nas phyin no/ /der nang par nyi ma shar tsam na/ sgyu ma mkhan gyis mgron po bos pas/ med de/nang du phyin tsam na bkyigs nas shi bar mthong ngo / /der chad pa byung gis dwogs skrag nas/ gnyer byed pa'i rgyal po'i 'khor 'du sa ta zhes bya ba bos nas khyim du khrid de/ ngas ma bsad pa'i rgyu mtshan yid ches par bya ba'i phyir bstan no/ /der des kyang mthong nas bkyigs pa'i thag pa la gri btab pas/gyang logs kyi ri mor song nas/ yang sgyu ma mkhan skyengs so/ /༈ rgyun ring tsam gyisaji ltar na/ /sgyu ma mkhan gyi khyim du/ slob dpon klu sgrub kyis zhag 'ga' bzhugs nas/ de nas sgyu ma mkhan gzhan zhig gi grong du phyin pas/ sgyu ma mkhan des mthong ste/ 'di lta buli dge slong mdzes pa 'dir 'ong ba/ nges par sgyu ma mkhan gyis nyams sod pa yin snyam nas/ khos kyang /de lta bu'i dge slong zhig sprul nas drung du btang ngo / /klu sgrub kyis/ dge slong de la bde bar 'ongasasam drisapas/ sgyu ma'i dge slong gis smra ma shes so/ /de nas ring zhig lon nas sgyu ma'i dge slong slar zhig ste song nas/ sgyu ma mkhan de 'di snyam du sems te/ nga bas sgyu ma mkhan gzhan nges par mkhas so snyam mo//de'i bsam pa mkhyen nas/ 'phags pas/ nga ni klu sgrub yin no/ khyod ni sgyu ma yin te/ sgyu ma mkhan gnyisamathu mnyam mo/ /zhesagasungasapas/ sgyu ma —118—

spyod 'jug sgrung 'grel las 'bras gsal ba'i me long zhes bya ba bzhugs/mkhan de bdag mi mkhas so snyam pa'ang med do/ /༈ sgyu ma de yang sna tshogasanyid/ /rgyal po zhig gi drung du/ mi zhig lag pa g.yas su ral gri zhig khyer g.yon du phub cig bzung / bud med cig khrid de byung nas/ bud med rgyal po la bcol nas/ kho nam mkha' la thag pa zhig brgyangs nasade la 'dzegasasong ngo / /dar cig na kho'i lag pa dang / rkang pa dang / mgo bo dang / gri phug rnams kyang rim par lhung byung bas der lha dang lha min 'khrugs pa'i bar du kho shi bar bzung bas/ skyes bu na re/ da kho ni shi /chung ma 'di nga la blang zer bas/ rgyal pos kyang byin no/ /der kho'i mgo lus kun tshogs pa na/ khong langs byung ste/ rgyal po la nga'i chung ma bcol ba 'dod zer/ khyod shi snyam nas bud med gzhan la byin byasapas/ ma nyan par/ slar kho rang la byin no/ /༈ grub pa'i mig sman sbyor ba las/ /mig sman phyogs gcig tsam ni/byi la la/ ma he sha'i mar snyod do/ /de ma bzhu bar 'phongasanasabyung ba/ thod pa'i nang du ar ka'i lo mas sdong bu byas te/ mar me btang ba'i dud pa/ thod pa steng ma'i+o nang du chags pa mig la bskus na'o/ /yang na ar ka'i lo ma'i cang lham gyan pa'/ /de min na/ khye'u 'am/ bu mo rkang pa sngon la skyes de'i gnya' khung du bzhen nas rkang po sa la ma reg par phyin na/ sa 'og gi gter bum rin chen gyis gang pa mthang nga / /༈ dper na nam mkha' lding gi ni/ /zhes pa'i skabs su lho phyogs grong —119—

mkhyen brtse'i 'od snang las/ spyod 'jug sgrung 'grel/khyer kri yar/ bram ze spun bdun yod pa klu dang 'gras te/ klus spun drug rim gyis zos so/ /tha chung bram ze sang ku zhes pa zhig lus pa de'ang zos kyis dwogasanas/ mkhar sum brtsegasabyasate/ 'og tu byi la mang po bzhag /bar du sang ku bza' mi gnyis bzhag nas/ steng khang du rma bya mang po bzhag nas bsrungs so/ /nyin cig sang ku'i chung mas klu'i grong du phyin nas mchod mang po byas so zer/ sang ku khrosanasaklu'i khang pa thamasacad bshig go /der klu rnams kyis gros byas te/ 'di la gnod pa sus nus byas pas/ sus kyang 'gro ma nus pa la/ klu mo mchu can ma chen mo na re/ ngas nus kyisazer nas phu zhes brjod pas/ rlung chen po langs pas/ steng khang gi rma bya rnams 'og tu bros so/ /der klu mos sbrul chung ngu zhig tu sprul nas/ steng khang du 'dzegs te/ sang ku nub mo nyal ba'i brla la so btab bo/ /nang bar chung mas sang ku longs byas pas shi nas 'dug go /de nas mya ngan byed cing chu bo gaṅgā la gru chen po zhig gi nang du/ sang ku'i ro dang / chung ma rnamasabacug ste phyin no/ /de nasachu bo'i phar 'gram tshur 'gram na phyugs rdzi mang po yod pas/ gru'i nang na bud med ngu ba mthong nas dris pa dang / nga'i khyo klus bsad khyed la gso thabs yod dam zer ro/ /la la na re med zer/ la la na re ngas khyo bya yis tshur shog zer/de bzhin nyi ma gsum phyin pas/ yang phyugs rdzi zhig snga ma bzhin du 'dri ba la/sngar bzhin lan byas pas/ de na re tshur chod cig dang / 'di na klu'i grong khyer yod kyis zer nas/ der phyin tsam na phyugs rdzi na re/ yo byad phyung zhig zer/bud med kyis yo byad phyung ste klu la mchod pa byas pas klu yis dug phyung ste/—120—

spyod 'jug sgrung 'grel las 'bras gsal ba'i me long zhes bya ba bzhugs/sang ku sos par byas so/ /der phyugs rdzi la de na yod pa'i yo byad lhag ma thams cad byin nas nga'i yul du 'dong zhig /yo byad mang po sbyin no/ /byas pas/ thag ring zer te 'gror ma nyan/ khyo shug gnyis pos yul du phyin nas/mi zhig dang phrad de/ yul 'dir mi snyan pa med dam dris pas/ gzhan med/bram ze sang ku shi ba'i bdun tshigs dang chos ston byed do zer/ der mi de slar btang nas/ nga bram ze sang ku shi ba slar gsos kyis/ pha ma la phyir phrad du shog bsrings pas/ shi ba gsosapa med do/ /zhesapha ma slar ngusaso/ /der bza' mi gnyis pos nang du phyin pas/ gnyen 'dun thams cad yid gnyis su gyur bzhin du dga'o/ /der sang kus klus mi tshugs pa'i rig pa du ma yang bslabs so/ /yul gzhan zhig tu phyin pa na/ bud med mang po chu 'gram na ras 'khru ba mthong nas der phyin tsam na bud med gcig pu gcig khur byung ba/bu des ngus nas/ ras zhabrur mi ster ba la/ bud med des shog byas pas/sbrul cig byung nas des bu'i rkang pa la so btab pas dran med du song ngo / /der ras bkru ba zin nas/ yang shog byas pas sbrul cig gis blags pas/bu de bos te khyim du song ngo / /der sang kus zla ba drug tu thal ba phyag cing bzhag tabs tog byas pas/ bud med na re/ khyod ci 'dod zer/ der sang kus lo rgyus zhib tu gsol nas/ klus mi tshugs pa'i man ngag 'dod byas pas/snod du mi rung bas phan mi thogs zer/ nan gyis zhus pas/ dam rdzas kyang rnyed dka' zer/ 'bad pas rnyed de/ mkha' lding gi rigs sngags kyis byin gyis brlabs nas 'thung du bcug pas/ phul drug gi bar du rim bzhin yog /—121—

mkhyen brtse'i 'od snang las/ spyod 'jug sgrung 'grel/lhag ma lus na gnyis ka la gnod ces sdigs kyang / bdun las ma yog par/phul gang lus nas bud med na re sngar du snod du mi rung byas ste mi nyan 'dug /brgyad bar 'thungs na klu rigs brgyad bar gyi dug las grol te/ phul gang lus pas/ khyod la nam zhig na/ klu nor rgyas kyi gnod pa 'byung bas/ de'i gso thabs su rgya mtsho'i lha ba dam tshig gsum gyisalongs la byugs shig /klu rigs bdun las grol ba'i dngos grub thob pa yin no zer/ de nas sang kus klu nad sngar byung sos shing phyis 'byung gso ba'i thabs su/ mkha' lding gi mchod sdong zhes pas/ rdo ring gi steng du bya khyung gi gzugs byas te/ gzungs sngags kyi nus pa bgos nas bzhag go /sngagaba'ikyi nusapasaklu'i bu mo thams cad bkug cing longs spyod pa na/ nor rgyas kyi sring mo la/ sang kus klu ci rtse thub dris shig byas pa bzhin/ dris pas/ sang kus gsang ma thub kyis dwogs nas thams cad thub byas so/ /der klu mos ming po la smras pas nor rgyas kyis sang ku'i ltag par so btab pas/ der g.yog gnyis la rnal 'byor mas bsgo ba bzhin du/ phyir mig ma lta/ ltas na'ang gtam ma smra/ smras pa'ang ma nyan zhes pa'i dam tshig gsum gyis rgya mtsho'i sbu ba longs shig ces btang bas/longs nas dris pa'i grong 'dabs su slebs pa dang / klus ma bzod par sman par sprul nas bdas pas/ zin nas 'bod kyang ma ltas pa la sman pa'i skad du grag nas bltas pas/ 'di ltar phyin byas pas/ kho shi zin na/ da sbu bsaci byed pho las thong zer nas pho phyin pas/ sang ku ma shi bar sbu ba longs sam zer/ longs te/ 'di ltar zer nas pho byasapas/ dam tshig gsum gang rung —122—

spyod 'jug sgrung 'grel las 'bras gsal ba'i me long zhes bya ba bzhugs/zhig bsrungs na 'grub pa la/ de klu'i sprul pa yin gyis/ slar song la sbu ba sa dang 'dres pa phyogs las shog zer te/ phyin pas/ sbu ba pho ba'i shul kyang /klu gdug pa'i stobs kyisardzing bu zhig tu byas nas 'dug go /der bram ze yi ched 'das na'ang / des bsgrubs pa'i mchod sdong des da dung klu nad zhi bar byed pa bzhin no/ /༈ 'das kyang don rnams thams cad mdzad/ /sngon bskal ba grangs med pa'i sngon rol du/ 'dzam bu'i gling 'dir/ rgyal po gsal thub ces bya ba/rgyal phran brgyad khri bzhi stong snyed la dbang bskur ba zhig byung ba des/ sangs rgyas bi shwa zhes pa zhig 'jig rten du byon pa de la/ yo byad rnam pa mang po'i sgo nas mchod cing bsnyen bkur yang / mya ngan las 'da' khar/ rgyal pos zhus pa / ston pa thugs rje dang ldan pa lags na/ bdag gi rgyal phran brgyad khri bzhi stong 'di/ mi dge ba'i sems dang ldan pas/ ston pa'i zhal ma mthong zhing mchod pa'ang ma phul bas 'di rnams ngan song du 'khyam pa ji ltar bgyi zhus pas/ bka' bstsal pa/ 'das pa'i 'og tu nga'i gzugs brnyan bzhengs su gsol la/ mchod pa lugs su phul cig 'bras bu thob par 'gyur/ zhes gsungs sa/ / de nas rgyal po gsal thub kyis/ rin chen lugs su blug pa dang / ras bris la sogs pa sku brgyad khri bzhi stong bzhengs te/ rgyal phran brgyad khri bzhi stong po thams cad sbran nas/ mchod pa phul cig par bsdams te/ thams cad kyisade bzhin du byasapas/ 'brasabu thob bo/ /nor bu/ de'i tshe/ de'i dus—123—

mkhyen brtse'i 'od snang las/ spyod 'jug sgrung 'grel/na / rgyal po gsal thub ni/ da ltar gyi shākya thub pa'o/ /rgyal phran brgyad khri bzhi stong ni/ nyan thos kyi dge slong brgyad khri bzhi stong dang / zhes so/ /7/ las kyi nus pa mthong ba yin/ /mnyan yod kyi grong khyer na/ khyim bdag dbul po zhig gi chung ma la/ bu zhig btsas pa cher skyes nas kyang pha ma dang bcas pa 'dam pa 'ba' zhig za'i/ gzhan bzar med pas/ bu'i ming yang 'dam zan sgur chung zhes grags so/ /deng sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa la/rab tu byung nas/ bden pa bzhi bsgoms pas dgra bcom pa thob bo/ /de nas grong khyer du bsod snyoms la phyin pas cung zad kyang ma rnyed de/ zhag gsum du ltogs so/ /der mnyan yod kyi grong khyer du 'phags pa sgur chung ni zhag gsum du ltogs so zhes grags so/ /der gnas brtan 'od srung gis/ lhung bzed gnyis khyer te bsod snyoms byas nas bkang ste 'ongs pas/ sgur chung la spyin rgyu'i lhung bzed lam du bya rog gis pho nas/ der zhag bzhi ltogs so/ /yang shā ri'i bus kyang sngar bzhin lhung bzed gnyis blangs te 'ongs pas/ ba zhig gisabardungasate sgur chung gilhung bzad bobs/ zhagalngar ltogasago /yang mu+o'u 'gal gyi bus kyang sngar bzhin 'ongs pas/ rang gi bsod snyoms gsol ba'i bar la/ sgur chung la dmigs pa'i lhung bzed sa'i steng du song ste/ de ltar zhag bdun du ltogs pa'i nangs par/ 'phags pa sgur chung de nyon mongs med kyang / sngon gyi las kyi nusapasaltogs grir shi'o/ /de nas/ 'khor rnamasakyis/ bcom ldan 'das la gsol ba/ 'phags pa sgur chung ni nyon mongs pa bcom nas dgra bcom par gyur bzhin du/ 'tsho ba'i zhal zas la rkyen du mas —124—

sbyong/ 'a༄ go/ sgrung 'grel las 'bras sa/sa' ba'i me long zhes bya ba bzhugs/bar du bcad nas/ ltogs par 'gro ba'i rgyu thams cad mkhyen pas bshad du gsol/ ces/zhus/pas/ bka' bstsal pa/ sngon ma ta ga'i grong du/ khyim bdag phyug po gcig la bu med nas/ sde pa drug gi ston pa la chos ston drangs te bu blangs pas/ smon lam btab ste lo dus na bu zhig btsas te/ de cher skyes nas pha shi /der ma des dge 'dun la sbyin pa du ma gtong ba la/ bu shin tu ser sna can du gyur te/ mas nga'i nor rdzas brlag par byed snyam nas/ sbyin gnasarnams la ni khro zhing / mdzod sgo la lcags bcug go /der ma na re nga la bza' ba blang zer ba la/ bus 'dag pa byin pas/ zhag bdun na ma ni ltogs grir shi'o/ /der bu de'ang rjes su 'gyod pa drag pos sangs rgyas la bshags shing / tshe'i dus byas nas/ skye ba lnga brgyar ltogs grir shi ba'i rnam smin gyi lhag ma'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /yang / ༈ mchog zung zhig 'gro lngar ci rigs su 'chags pa na/ dmyal ba'i mtha' zhig na/ lus ri bo tsam pa'i lce yul ljongs tsam zhig la/ rmos dor lnga brgya'i gshol mda' 'bar bas rmos pa'i sdug bsngal nyin mo myong la/mtshan mo ni rmos glang skyes nas bde bar gnas pa zhig gzigs te/ de'i rgyu mtshan dris pas/ bdag 'dzam gling du/ mu stegs kyi ston pa 'od srung rdzogs byed du gyur pa na/ nyin par chos log bstan cing / mtshan mo ni dpal dal bar bsdad pa'i las 'bras so/ /'phags pa dag 'dzam gling du gshegs na/bdag gi slob ma rnams la/ chos log bstan pas shin tu sdug bsngal lo//khyed kyis chos bshad pa dang nga'i rus bu la mchod pa tsam gyis nga'i sdug bsngal —125—

mkhyen brtse'i 'od snang las/ spyod 'jug sgrung 'grel/rgyas par 'gyur gyin 'dug pas/ khyed thams cad kyis log lam bor la drang lam la zhugs shig ces bsrings te/ gnyis pos 'dzam gling du byon pa'i tshe/kho'i slob ma rnams chos bshad cing 'dug pas mthong nas/ kha cig na re/shākya sras kyi dge sbyong dag snang na/ de la 'o skol gyis ji ltar sgrub par bya zer/kha cig na re/ gzhan sgrub rgyu ci yod/ ldal du zad mod zer/ kha cig na re de kho nar ldal na ma legs kyis sngon la bsnyad brtsal bar bya'o zer/ der shā ri'i bus sngon la 'ongs pa dang / kun tu rgyu de dag na re/ shāri'i bu nged kun tu rgyu la dge sbyong yod dam med zer/ shā ri'i bus dgongs te/ kun tu rgyu la dge sbyong yod/ dge sbyong yang dag lam zhugs yin zhes smras pas skabs ma rnyed de/legs par smras kyis thongs shig zer/ mo'u 'gal gyi bus phyi nas 'ongs nas/yang / de dag na re/ nged kun tu rgyu la dge sbyong yod med dri ba la/ khyed kun tu rgyu la dge sbyong med/ dge sbyong nang pa'i khyad chos yin zhes brjod de/ slob dpon gyi 'phrin yang bzlas pas/ de dag sngangs shing 'khrugs nas dge sbyong 'go reg pa 'dis/ bdag cag la kha zer du ma zad/ bdag gi ston pa la yang mi snyan pa brjod pa 'di la ji ltar bsgrub par bya/ gzhan sgrub rgyu ci yod/brdeg tu zad mod ces dbyug brdungs byas te/ 'dam bu'i khyim du glang po che shor ba ltar rtsib ma thams cad bcom nas de nyid du sa la 'gyel lo/ /der thogs nas shā ri'i bus gzigs su byon nas drin dris pas/ mu stegs pas 'di ltar byas so/ /zer/ khyed sangasargyasakyi rju'aphrul can rnamasakyi nang nas mchog tu lung bstan pa ma yin nam/ 'phags pa rdzu 'phrul gyis mi byon par —126—

spyod 'jug sgrung 'grel las 'bras gsal ba'i me long zhes bya ba bzhugs/byas pas/ dge sbyong dag las kyi nus pa la ltos/ 'dir las kyi nus pas non nas/ rdzub lta zhog 'phrul ba'ang ma dran na zer/ shā ri'i bus/ bu chung la bya ba ltar chos gos kyi khud du khur 'ongs te/ gsal rgyal la rgyu mtshan bshad pas/ kun tu rgyu la chad pas gcod par thos te bros nas ma rnyed do/ /mtsho byed bos nas/ 'di ma sos na khrims dang sbyor zhes btad kyang / bgres shing brdung tshabs che bas skrag nas/ nyid la skyabs su song bas/ nga'i las kyi nus pa mthong zhing / ston pa'ang myur du gshegs pasabasdad long med kyis/ kho bos zhag bdun na rdzul 'phrul gyis chad pa las bkrol te 'da'o/ /zhes pa la/sman pas kyang zhag bdun na gdangs te/ grong khyer du bsod snyoms la byon no//zhes bsgrags te/ bdag nyid ji lta bar sprul nas mnyan yod nas bsod snyoms blangs te/ lha mi dad pa'i rdzul 'phrul sna tshogs bstan te/ na len+d+rar dgra bcom pa bdun khri dang bcas te mya ngan las 'das so/ shwa ri'i bu de'i sngon la dgra bcom brgyad khri dang bcas te/ grong khyer shing 'thag can du mya ngan/ las 'das te/ chung bu grogs mya ngan las 'da' ba'i sdug bsngal mi bzod pas so/ /las kyi nus pa ji ltar na/ sngon ri brag cig tu bram ze khyo shug gnyis kyi bur gyur pa na/ khyim thab kyi phra ma la brten nas/ pha ma rgan rgon 'di dag gi yan lag kun 'dam bu dkrugs pa bzhin btang ngo / /zhes pa'i ngag rtsub kyis/ skye ba du mar ngan song myong / mir gyur kyang / skye ba lnga brgyar rtsib ma 'dam bu dkrugs pa bzhin gyur cing 'chi ba'i sdug bsngal myong la/ da lta nyon mongs zad kyang las kyi nusapa de lta bu mthong ba yin no/ /zhes so/ /—127—

mkhyen brtse'i 'od snang las/ spyod 'jug sgrung 'grel/sdug bsngal de nyid du yod na/ ma gha dha na mi zhig la shu ba gsar pa chus bkang pa zhig yod pa'i nang du/ khang thog nas khyi yis chu btang ba sa bon dang 'dres nas lhung ngo / /der mi des de ltar ma tshor bar 'thungs pas/ khong par lhums su gyur te ya mtshan che bar gyur te/ der zla ba mang po lon nas yid shin tu mi bde ba la/ sman pas chu mang po 'thung du bcug pas/ chus khyi gu khong pa'i stod du bteg go/snying kha'i gong du slebs tsam na/ mi de mi gtsang ba la bsgom du bcug pas/ khong pa'i nang gi khyi gu shin tu dga' ste/ mi gtsang ba bza' bar 'dod pas mi de'i kha nas skyes so/ /de nas/ mi gtsang ba'i dri la snom pa'i dus su/ mi la sdug bsngal yod la/ khong pa'i khyi gu la bde bar yod pas/bde sdug don la bden par mi rigs so/ /rigs na gnyis ka mtshungs dgos so/ /zhes pa'o/ /༈ re zhig 'jig rten mngon sum gyis/ /kun rgyu byang chub bam/ tshangs pa'i skye rabasasogs brjod nas/ las rgyu 'bras mi bslu bar gtan la dbab bo/ /dbang phyug 'gro ba'i rgyu yin na/ rgya gar du bram ze spun gsum skyes pa'i/phu bo ni/ ba ra su mi ste/ rdo rje gdan bzhedasaso/ /bar pa ni/ pa ki la swā mi ste/ mu stegasakyi gtsug lag khang bzhedasaso/ /de gnyis/ bcom ldan 'dasadang / dbang phyug gang zag la rtsod pa byasaso/ /phu bo na re/ khyod gangasate sel dbang phyug chen po bzhugs kyis der song la/ gang bzang dbang phyug rang la dris shig zer ro/ /der nu bos gangs ti se la phyin nas sgo phye byas pas/ de'i nang nas dge —128—

spyod 'jug sgrung 'grel las 'bras gsal ba'i me long zhes bya ba bzhugs/slong bdun nam mkha' la 'phur te rdzul 'phrul gyis song ngo / /de'i rjes la/dbang phyug chen po yum dang bcas pa byung ba la/ dbang phyug khyed dang bcom ldan 'das gang bzang byas pas/ dbang phyug na re/ de de lta ma yin te/ go'u ta ma'i nyan thos bdun po 'di'ang nga'i mchod pa'i gnas yin na/ bcom ldan 'das nga bas bzang ba lta ci smos zer/ der pa ki la su mi'ang sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa la zhugs sa/ /༈ sgyu ma la ni khyad ci yod/ /rgyal po'i khab na/ bzang po zhes pa sgyu ma'i rtul zhugs la shin tu mkhas pa des/ sgyu ma'i sgo nas skye'o/ /thams cad 'dun par byas kyang / 'khor rnam bzhi po sangs rgyas kyi cho 'phrul gyis ngos nas/ bzang pos mgo rmongs par bya ma nus pa'i tshe/ go tam thams cad mkhyen pa min par sgyu mas mgo me+ongs par nus na/ skye bo ril bdag la 'dun par 'gyur ro/ /snyam nas thams cad mkhyen pa yin min sad par bya ba'i phyir/bya rgod phung po'i ri la song ste/ sang bdag cag can gdugs tshod la byon par zhus pas/ bzang po 'dul ba'i dus la bab par mkhyen nas/ zhal gyisabazhes pa'i tshe/ mo'u 'gal gyis/ bzang po dad pa min par/ tho 'tsham pa la mi gshegs par zhus pas/ khyod snying lasachung ngur gyis shig /lha dang bcasapa'i 'jig rten na/ de pa la sus kyang tho 'tsham par mi nus so gsung ngo / /der bzang pos rgyal khab tu sgyu ma'i khang bzangs su/ khri stan zas sogs bshams pas/ lha klu mir bcas thams cad tshogs te/ bzang pos de bzhin gshegs pa la tho 'tsham pa lta'o/ /de nasabasamasapa/ sangs rgyasadage 'dun —129—

mazhi phre'i 'od snang las/ spyod khug sgrung 'grel/dngo d+ku+os te byon pa la/ṭ+wāṃk+ṣiṃ cad phyag marnyi+o byed pa ṭ+wāṃr na/bdog gis mgo mengs su gozhug par gas zloman/ ngasadīr+shananas/nangs pa bzad par gsal nas/gdugasadal g.yi ñcā gsaṭārakhris pas/bka' a+yo pa/'isgyu ma'am sangs rgyas la sgyu ma'o bar+sha bkur gyas shag darnyi /'bros bu sgyu ma' sangs rgyasa'agrub par 'gyurār// gsungs nas byaṭ+wāṃ/stir rnams la/ngas stan la ma zlosdad pard r+shams stan la ma 5ga 'iṭ+wāṃ/ngas zas sags ṅgi ma spyad par/ da /lha ma za ga gsung nas byan pa' /bzadī posa'i/gag para'adodakyang ṭ+wāṃle ma nus par/ghimarten zhus pas/ngasan gyasabarlabs pas gsung gsanas/gang san pa gang la poto/khyenapadzitimirtogapa/smyun pamanyalapa de ṣ+ka kyis//gleng po //)/ ///byelha yangasardzags shasna sadang /ngasamasathamasacad sgyu ma lta bu'/ri/sam bstananam/ sa k+ṣiṃsa'i gasnganga~X nas bzang pa dad par byas ta/'thu 'bras bu la bkad da//ra phyan gya 'u dgu pa'// //ka10le'u r+sā pa'i skabs kyi gto rgyud ltad pa/༈grang pasnakhos sbyi dro thob shog/tsha grang lage sogasag song k+ṣiṃm//zag bocasna / bsalha dang //thabs ma/snak+ta baṭ+wāṃ 'tshang rgya /kyi/blang dar tu bshad par byasas//'ga' 'i ses/ na gsum sags nom bza' bzhus pa dang /skam la gnas pa' mas can chur skyur ba zel sagasapas/grang dmyal/chu bur tso ḍing /chu bur rdal ba dang /a chu ra

spyod 'jug sgrung 'grel las 'bras gsal ba'i me long zhes bya ba bzhugs/ba dang / kye hud zer ba dang / so tham tham pa dang / ut+pal ltar gas pa dang /pad ma ltar cher gas pa ste/ brgyad po der skyes pa na/ sdug bsngal gyi longs spyod ni/ ming gisashesal/ tshe tshad ni/ mdzod las/ til sbyangasanang nasalo brgya zhing / /til gcig phyung bas zad gyur pa/ /chu bur can gyi tshe tshad yin/ /gzhan gyi 'gyur ni nyi shu 'gyur/ /zhes sogs las rgyu 'bras zhib tu bshad da/ /7/ tsha bas nyams thag bsil bar shog /'gro ba drug gi tshig le'ur byas pa las/ chags dang gti mug 'jigs dang khros/ /mi gang mi ni gsod pa dang / /gzhan yang skyes nas bsad byas na/ /de dag yang sosa'agro bar 'gyur/ /zhes pa nas/ med par lta ba gang zhig gis/ /chosadang chosamin log ston zhing / /gzhan dag la ni nyon mongasabyas/ /zhesasogasadang / yon tan dag gis che ba la/ /gnod pa drag po byas pa'am/ /pha ma bla ma bsad byase na/ /mi de mnar med bsreg par 'gyur/ /zhesapa'i bar du gsungasapa ltar/ lasade dang de dag bsagasapas/ yang sosathig nag /bsdusa'ajoms/ ngu 'bod/ ngu 'bod chen po/ tsha ba/ rab tu tsha ba/ mnar med de/tsha dmyal brgyad po der skyes pa na/ me de rnams kyis sreg pa shin tu bzod dka' ste/ tha mal gyi me dang / mgar ba'i me dang / tsan dan gyi me dang /dus mtha'i me dang / dmyal ba'i me brgyad po thams cad snga ma snga ma las/ phyi ma phyi ma rnams bzhi 'gyur gyisatsha'o/ /mo'u 'gal gyi bus/ dmyal ba'i me nyungs 'bru tsam zhig /lhung bzed du khyer 'ongs pas/ gling bzhi'i mi dang /—131—

mkhyen brtse'i 'od snang las/ spyod 'jug sgrung 'grel/sum cu rtsa gsum pa'i lha thams cad dmyal bar gyur te/ gzhan du dor yang sems can la gnod pa mkhyen nas rdzu 'phrul gyis chu bzhi'i rgyun phab ste/ zhi bar byas pa bzhin no/ /tshe tshad ni/ yang sos la sogs drug rim bzhin/ /'dod lha'i tshe dang nyin zhag mnyam/ /des na de dag rnams kyi tshe/ /'dod pa'i lha dang 'dra ba yin/ /rab tu tsha byed mnar med ni/ /bar gyi bskal ba'o/ /dud 'gro rnams/ mchog ring bskal ba'o/ /yi dwagasarnams/ zla ba nyin zhag gis lnga brgya/ /zhes sogs ltar/ mdzod dang / 'gro ba drug gi tshigs bcad sogs sbyar te/ ngan song de rnams kyi rgyu/ tshe tshad/ lusatshad/ sdug bsngal gyi longs spyod kyi tshad sogs zhib tu bshad nas/ spang bya dang nyes dmigs kyi gnyen po'i sgo nas/ gdul bya 'jigs shing skrag pa skyed nus par yang bshad do/ ༈ lha rnams dang lhan cig dal gyisa'abab gnas shog /zag bcas kyi dge ba 'ga' byas pas/ gling bzhi'i mi dang / 'dod pa khams kyi lha rigs drug dang / gzugs khams gnas rigs bcu bdun dang / gzugs med skye mched mu bzhi sogs su skyes pa na/ de dag gi lus tshad/ tshe tshad de/ bde ba'i longs spyod kyi tshad la sogs pa'i sgo nas zag bcas kyi bde ba rgyu 'bras dang / yang / skye mched dam bsngo bas zin pa'i dge ba 'ga' bsags pas/gnas skabs kyi 'bras bu lam lnga sa bcu dang / mthar thug gi 'bras bu rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas zag med kyi yon tan sde tshan nyer gcig dang ldan pa sogos zhib tu bshad de/ blang dor gyi gnas la mkhas par bya'o/ /le'u bcu pa'// //—132—

spyod 'jug sgrung 'grel las 'bras gsal ba'i me long zhes bya ba bzhugs/gsum pa/ mjug gi don bshad pa/thub pa'i gsung dang de yi dgongs 'grel rnams/ /dpang du byas te legs par bshad mod na'ang / /bdag blo byis pa'i dbang gyur 'gal zhabrul rnams/ /dam pa rnams kyisabazod par mdzad du gsol/ /bdag gi phan sems rgya mtsho las 'ongs pa'i/ /sgrung 'grel ngo mtshar rin chen phreng ba 'di/ /skye rgu'i blo yi dbul ba gtan bcom nas/ /kun mkhyen rgyal ba'i dpal gyis 'byor gyur cig /bdag kyang 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyis rjes bzung ste/ thos bsam sgom pa'i dpal 'byor gyis phyug cing / /'bras bu sku bzhi'i dngos grub myur thob nas/ /kun tu bzang po'i dpal la spyod par shog /dpe legs la dag pa 'di/ /dge ba'i bshes gnyen dam pa/ yon tan dbang phyug gis bsam pa bzang ba'i bsgo nas/ bzhengs pa lags/ maṅge le bha wan+tu/ shur+ghaṃ/zhus dag / //—133—

༄7/ /byang chub sems dpa'i sbyodo pa la 'jug pa'i gtam thre/da bzhugs sa/ /legs pa don grub ni yi ge bstsal rigs su gda'o/ tage'o/ /༄7/ /mā+oṃ su sti/ /mkhyen pa brtse ldan 'dren pa dang mtshungasapa/ /rgyasasras spyod mdzad yon tan kun gyisaphyug /'gro ba'i sgron 'dzin bshes gnyen la btud de/ /skabs mkho'i ngo mtshar gtam rnams gsung bzhin bri/ /phyag 'os kun la'ang gus par phyag 'tshal to/ /zhes pa nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas kyang phyag gi yul yin pa'o/ /de lta na lung dang 'gal lo zhe na/ lung dgongs pa yin te/ sngon rgyal po ma skyes dgra dgra bcom pa 'od srung chen po dang/ dgra gcan 'dzin la sogs pa gdugs tshod la spyan drangs pa'i tshe/ rgyal po de sems la bu mo mya ngan med pas byin pa zhes bya ba/ byang chub sems dpa'i sprul pa bud med kyi lus bzung ba zhig yod pa khri la bsdad nas dgra bcom pa de dag la dad pa dang phyag la sogs pa mi byed pas/ yab kyis khyod dgra bcom pa 'di dag la phyag mi byed pa ci yin gsungs pa la/ bu mo na re/ yab kyi ri'i rgyal po ri rab nyungs dkar la phyag byed pa gzigs sam/ nyi ma dang zla ba'i dkyil 'khor srin bu me khyer la phyag byed pa dang / rgya mtsho'i chen pos ba glang gi rmig rjes kyi chu la phyag mi byed pa dang / seng ge ral pa can wa skyes la phyag byed pa gsan nam gzigs sam la sogs pa brjod pas/ bu mo khyod ni nga —134—

byang chung sems dpa'i spyod pa la 'jug pa'i gtam rgyud bzhugs/rgyal che'o byas pas/ yab rgyal po rang yang nga rgyal che'o zhes so/ /bdag nga rgyal che ba ci ste byas pas/ bu mo na re nga rgyal che ba ci ste zer/ khyod dgra bcom pa 'di dag la phyag mi byed pas/ rgyal po yang grong pa'i skye bo tha mal pa kun la phyag mi byed do zhes brjod pas/ rgyal pos khyod gzhan la phyag mi byed kyang dgra gcan 'dzin ni bcom ldan 'das kyi sras yin pas phyag bya bar rigs so byas pas/ bu mo na re seng ge la seng ge'i phru gu 'byung ba las/ wa skyes kyi bu mi 'byung ba bzhin du/ sangs rgyas seng ge dang 'dra ba la sras byang chub sems dpa' gzhan don byed pa med par/ nyan thos rang don byed cing sgrub pa wa skyes dang 'dra ba skyes pas phyag mi 'tshal zer bas de nyan thos dman pa la dgongs pa'o/ /dgos pa ni de dag theg chen la drangs pa'i phyir ro/ /sgra ji bzhin pa la gnod pa ni/ bu mo de dgra bcom pa de dag dang bgro gleng byas pas bu mo rgyal yang nga rgyal med par khri las babs te lus thams cad kyis phab nas phyag btsal bar bshad nga/sa/ snga ma sgra ji bzhin pa ma yin no/ /dal 'byor 'di ni shin du rnyed par dka'/ /zhes pa la/ de thob par dka' ba mtha' bzung gi dpe ni bri/ 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad ni rgya mtsho chen po zhig tu gyur la de'i gting nas rus sbal zhar ba zhig gnas pa lo brgya brgya na steng du lan re 'byung zhing rgya mtsho'i steng na gnya' shing bu ga gcig pa zhig shar gyi rlung gis nub tu bdas la/ nub kyi rlung gi shar du'o/ /de bzhin du byang bdas rlung gis lho/ lho'i rlung gi byang du bdas te/ sa gcig pu la skabs skabs ni gnas so/ /de ltar rgya mtsho rgya che ba dang rus sbal thon pa —135—

mkhyen brtse'i 'od snang las/ spyod 'jug gi gtam rgyud/ nyung ba dang / gnya' shing gcig tu mi gnas pas gnya' shing gi bu gar rus sbal kyi mgrin pa chud pa shin tu dka' ste/ de bas kyang ngan song las dal 'byor thob dka' bar bstan pa dang / byang chub sems bskyed gyur na skad cig gis/ /zhes byang chub kyi sems dang ldan na tshe 'dir yang sdug bsngal dang bral zhing gzhan gyis bkur ba'i gnas su 'gyur te/ sngon gyi dus na rgya mtsho la nor bu rin po che len pa'i tshong pa 'ga' phyin pa dang rdzings zhig nas tshong pa gzhan thams cad shi ba la sems bskyed can cig yod pa shing leb la 'jus nas ma shi bar rgya mtsho'i 'gram du thon pa la/ rgya gar na mi phyug po'i lugs kyis dgra la sun ster ba'i sun bag re lus pa tshor pa bzhin/ 'di kho la yang gser srang gsum yod pa dang mtshan mo dge khang zhes bya ba ste/ mgron khang stong pa zhig tu nyal ba la/ rkun po zhig yong nas rdzas gzhan ma rnyed pas/ kho la nor blang byas pas/ kho sems bskyed pa yin pas gser srang gsum po de byin no//rkun po'i bsam pa la 'di tsam ster tshod kyis 'di la da dung nor che ba zhig yod dam snyam nas slong bas/ da nga la ci yang med zer/ 'o na khyed gsod byas pas/ bsadakyang nga la med zer ro/ /de'ang snying khar pha bong gisamanan te mig tu mtshon btsug /mig 'don zhing byas nas dbyig pas mig bton kyang nga la nor ni med/ nor med kyang 'don na nga la mi dga' ba med kyis thon cig zer bas chom po ngo mtshar skyes nas khyod la yon tan ci yod ces dris pas/ nga la yon tan gzhan ni med kyi byang chub tu sems bskyed pa yin byas pas/ rkun po shin tu dad par gyur nas gser yang slar byin rkun po yang slob ma byas nas —136—

byang chung sems dpa'i spyod pa la 'jug pa'i gtam rgyud bzhugs/sems bskyed zhus te/ lus ngag yid gsum gyis bsnyen bkur byas pa lta bu'o/ /sems can rnams kyi klad nad tsam zhes pas/ gzhan la phan pa'i bsam pa skad cig tsam skyes pa'i phan yon dpag tu med de/ sngon ded dpon mdza' bo zhes bya ba zhig la bu 'tsho bar ma gyur pa las/ de'i tshe mo ltas byas mdza' bo'i bu mor ming btags na 'tsho bar 'gyur ro/ /zer nas/ bu btsas pa dang mdza' bo'i bu mor ming btags/ de nas ring po ma lon par pha shi bar gyur to/ /de'i tshe bus ma la bdag gi pha'i bya ba gang byed pa yin zhes dris pas/ma rdzings zhig pas 'jigs te/ nor bu lon pa gsang ste tshong byed pa yin zhes smras pas/ kar sha pa ṇi'i tshong byas pas/ khebaskyed 'gron bu gsum byung ba ma la byin te 'tsho bar byed do/ /de nas spos kyi tshong byas pas/ kar sha pa ṇi bzhi tshong khe la thon pa ma la byin/ de nas yang grong khyer gyi tshong byas pas kar sha pa ṇi drug la sogs pa mang po ma la byin no/ /de nas yul 'khor gyi tshong byas pas 'gron bu brgyad kyi 'phel byung ba yang ma la byin te gsos so/ /de'i tshe yul mi rnams kyis pha ma'i bya ba ni/ snga ma rnams ma yin te/ rgya mtsho la nor bu rin po che len pa'i ded dpon yin no/ /zhes brjod pas/ rin po che len par chasapa dang / mas bshol bas ma nyan par thabs gzhan med nas sgo'i 'phred bcad de nyal bas ma'i mgo rdog pas brdzis te song ngo / /de nas rgya mtshor zhugs te phyin pa las rdzings zhig ste mgron po rnams chus khyer mdza' bo'i bu mo chu'i gling zhig la chags te/ mgron po rnams gar 'gro yis gnas med pa'i dus su/lha'i bu mo gnyis dang / bzhi dang drug dang brgyad kyis rim pa bzhin dga' byed —137—

mkhyen brtse'i 'od snang las/ spyod 'jug gi gtam rgyud/dang / tshangs pa'i bla ma dang rtag tu nyos dang / 'od mdzesadang / bzhir 'dusate/ lo gnyis dang drug dang brgyad dang 'dod pa'i ston la longs spyod/ de nas ma la bsnyen bkur ba'i las 'phro bzang po zad nas ji zhig na nyi tshe ba'i sems can dmyal ba'i gnam lcags kyi khang pa 'jigs su rung ba sgo med pa zhig tu tshud par gyur pa de'i tshe sgo rang bye ba dang de na dmyal ba pa zhig gi mgo la lcags kyi 'khor lo bskor zhing sdug bsngal dpag tu med pa dang ldan nas/khyod kyi sdug bsngal 'di ci las byung zhes dris pas/ ma la gnod pa byas pa las byung zhes/ 'di las nam thar zhes dris pas/ 'dzam bu gling du ma la gnod pa byas pa zhig nam byung na thar zer/ de'i tshe nam mkha' nas gang bcings pa ni grol ma bcings pa ni 'ching bar gyur cig ces pa'i sgra byung bas/ma la gnod pa'i las sad nas 'khor lo mgo la 'khor bar gyur te/ de'i rigs kyi stobs kyis snying rje'i sa bon dngos su sad nas/ rang gi sdug bsngal gyis dpags nas sems can klad pa'i nad kyis na ba kun gyi sdug bsngal thams cad bdag la smin par gyur cig ces sems bskyed pas de nas tshe 'phos nas lhar skyes pa dper byas pa'o/ /lhas kyang / dga' byed tshangs pa'i bla ma dang / /rtag tu myos byed 'od mdzes dang / /grong khyer bzhi lasarab thar nas/ /lasakyi dbang gisa'adir 'ongasaso/ /zhes zer/ sems can grangs mtha' yas la dusaring du zhesapa byang chub sems dpa' gzhan chos la sbyar na nor chen por 'gyur te/ 'di ltar 'khor los sgyur ba'i rgyal po nam mkha' zhes bya ba rin po che sna bdun dang ldan —138—

byang chung sems dpa'i spyod pa la 'jug pa'i gtam rgyud bzhugs/pa zhig byung ste/ des gling bzhi btul nas chos dge ba bcu la btsud pa la/lo 'ga' ste thul zhing yang mi dge ba la zhugs par gyur nas rgyal pos bsams pas lus kyis btul yang sems yengs pas lan snyam ste/ rin chen gyi bang rim la bsdad nas sems skyed yongs su dag pa bsgoms pas gling bzhi thams cad thul bar gyur to/ /de la lha rnams ngo mtshar che nas/ tshigs su bcad nasasmras pa/ rin chen bdun ldan rgyal chen gyis/ /lusakyi thul bar ma gyur pas//se+oms bskyed yongs su dag pa yis/ /semasakyi thul ba ngo mtshar che/ /zhesaspros/ /'on te gang zhig yid rab dang byed na/ /zhesapa/ byang chub sems dpa' la dang ba'i sems kyis lta ba ni shin tu dge ste/ tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bus grong 'khyer du bsod snyoms la phyin pas khyis rkang pa la so btab ste/ phyis mi 'ong bar bya ba'i phyir 'bras zan byin pa dang / khyi de shin du dang bar gyur te mthong ba dang mdun du rgyug /khyi de shi 'phos pa dang khyi'i skye ba lnga brgya len rgyu las/ dang ba skyes pa'i phan yon gyis khye'u snang ba bsam gyi mi khyab pa zhes bya ba rab tu byung nas dgra bcom pa thob par gyur to/ /nyan thos la dang ba skyes pa'i phan yon la de ltar che na byang chub sems dpa' la smos ci yod/ de yang 'di ltar sngon/ byang chub sems dpa' dga' byed ces pa gzugs phun sum tshogs pa dang ldan pa'i dge slong zhig gis grong khyer zhig tu bsod snyoms la phyin pa dang / bu mo dpal gyi yon tan gyi mchog ces pa de ni/ mdzes shing lta na sdug pa lus rgyan gyis brgyan pa zhig de la chags par gyur pas 'dod pa —139—

mkhyen brtse'i 'od snang las/ spyod 'jug gi gtam rgyud/bsten par zhus pa dang ma snang nas/ de chags pas yid gdungs nas lus rngul te sa phyogs der 'greng zhing 'chi ba'i dus byas so/ /byang chub sems dpa' des smon lam btab ste/ dga' byed smon lam phyir phyir 'debs pa ni//bud med gang dag chags sems kyis blta ba/ /de ni bud med lus kyang yongs spangasate/ /skyesabu spangasapa'i semasacan gyur par shog khresaso/ /bu mo de'i pha'i bsam pa la dge slong 'dis bdag gi bu mo la spyad byas so bsam nas sdang bar gyur to/ /bu mo de'i bsam pa dang byang chub semasadapa'i smon lam gyi stobs kyis sum cu rtsa gsum gyi lha'i nang du skyes te/ der skye ba'i rgyu ci yin zhes mngon shes kyis bltas pas gong ltar shes te/ lha rdzas kyi me tog la sogs pa khyer nas 'dzam bu'i gling du bcom ldan 'das dang byang chub sems dopa' dga' byed la mchod pa phul la ma la yang gong gi lo rgyus brjod de mi mas pa bzlag pa lta bu'/ /rgyal sras rnams la do gal chen posakyang / /zhes pa/ rgyal srasarnams la ni nyes pa chen pos khong khro mi skye la slar dge ba 'phel te/ sngon mi zhig la ba zhig yod pa gtor te 'brog dgon pa ring mo zhig tu phyin pa na/ bkres pa dang ngal bas nyen nas g.yang sa zhig na shing gyen du zhes pa/ yal ga dang lo ma dang 'bras bu phun sum tshogs pa dang ldan pa zhig 'dug pa de'i 'bras bu zos pa dang yang yal ga nas bzung ste 'bebs pa'i 'bad rtsol byas pas shing chag ste 'og na chu chen po yod par lhung ste/ de'i tshe da ltar gyi ston pa 'di nyid spre'u byang chub sems dpa' zhig tu gnas pa spyod yul dngos po dang shing des —140—

byang chung sems dpa'i spyod pa la 'jug pa'i gtam rgyud bzhugs/g.yab pa bzhin du gyur nas phyin pas mi de mthong ba dang snying rje stobs dang ldan pa skyes/ mi de 'don par bsams pa la stobs kyi mi theg par shes nas/rdo ba chung ba nas rim gyi mi tsam gyi bar du khur cing lus sbyangs te theg par gyur pa na mi de la kho bos khyod 'don par bya yis khur cig ces rgyab tu khur nas 'jog ste gom pa sa'i steng du thon pa dang / spre'u shin tu ngal zhing dub par gyur nas mi de la smras pa/ bdag shin tu ngal zhing dub par gyur te gnyid cung zad cig log par bya yis/ mi rgod dang gcan gzan la sogs pa'i 'tshe bar sems pa dag ltos shig zer nas nyal lo/ /mi de'i sems pa la 'dzam bu'i gling pa rnams ni/ legs pa byas pa'i lan nyes pa byed pa yin/ bdag la yang spre'u 'di shin tu drin che ste bdag bkres pas nyen pas 'di bsad la sha bza'o snyam nas/ rdo ba zhig spre'u'i mgo la bsnun pas spre'u ma bzod par gnyid sad nas mi de la snying rje skyes nas/ kyem 'di lta bu'i sems can log pa'i 'du shes dang ldan pa 'di'i skye ba ci 'dra bar 'gyur snyam nas/ slar kho rang gi yul du bskyal lo/ /mi de la mthong chos kyis rnam smin me tog lta bu la mdze byung ste nye 'brel dang yul pa dag gi yul zhes lus shin du mdzes pa sdug bsngal bar gnas pa dang / rgyal po zhig skyo bsangs la phyin pas de mthong nas khyod mi ma yin pa zhig yin nam zhes dris pas/ des smras pa/ byams la snying rings byas pa yi/ /me tog 'di ni re zhig myong / /de bsarab tu mi bzad pa'i/ /'brasabu gzhan zhig slad kyi mchi/ /zhesate/ sngar gyi bya ba dag brjod do/ /de nasatshe'i dus byas pa dang skye ba phyi ma'i 'bras bu zhal las shes so/ /—141—

mkhyen brtse'i 'od snang las/ spyod 'jug gi gto rgyud/gang la gnod pa byasapa bde 'brel ba/ /zhes pas/ skyes bu dam pa rnams la ni gnod pa byas kyang slar dge ba skye ba ni/ sngon 'das pa'i dus na rgyal po byams pa'i stobs zhes bya ba byang chub sems dpa' chen po zhig byung / /de'i yul phyogs kyi nags kyi gseb na ba glang rdzi zhig dgra sta dang mchil lham g.yas rol du bzhag /srad bu 'khal glu len pa glang 'tsho ba zhig 'dug pa na/gnod sbyin 'jigs su rung ba lnga rang gi yul du nyes pa byas pas gnod sbyin gyi bdag pos chad pas bcad pas 'khyam zhing 'ongs pa na ba glang rdzi de rnams dang phrad pas de la mi 'jigs pa mthong nas gnod sbyin de dag gis tshigs su bcad de smras pa/ rigasasngagasadaka' thub bde legasaldan pa dag /grogs kyis bskor ba'i nang na 'dug gyur cing / /dpa' la 'jigs pa med pa'i mi dgakyang / /gang lasathar par 'gyur b.roladagazha bar/ tagasatshalarolatu dben zhingazasapal/ /'jigasapa'i san grogasakyangayongamed par/ /mi'i sha dang tshiladagazabayi/ /srin bu de dgalani ci phyir khyed mi 'jegs/ /zhesapa dang / ba glang rdzis de dag la bshad pa/ rgyal po yon tan dpag tu med pa'i mthus/ /'jigasapa med cesasmrasapa ni/ /bde legasachen posa'agro ba ni//yongasasu bskyabasapar gyur pasan/ /lha yi dbang po dag gisakyang / /'di dag brtse bar mi nusan/ sha za rnamasakyisag lanus/ /de bsanagasana'ang khyim bzhin du/ /mtshan mo dag kyang nyin par bzhin/ /gcig pu'ang grogasakyi nang 'dug 'dra/ /bdag ni 'jigs pa med par 'dug khresabyasapas/gnod sbyin de dag gis rgyal po la de lta bu'i yon tan yod dam med bltar phyin —142—

byang chung sems dpa'i spyod pa la 'jug pa'i gtam rgyud bzhugs/pa dang / sngar brjod pa bas kyang ngo mtshar ches lhag par rig nas ngo mtshar du gyur to/ /des rgyal po la bstod pa/ gser gyi ri bo'i brag ltar yangs pa'i brang / /ston ka'i zla ba dri med mdzesapa'i zhal/ /dbu ma gser gyi sdong po lta bur rgyas/ /mi dbang khyu mchog spyan 'dra rnam par gnon/ /zhesargyal po la bstod do/ /rgyal pos khyod ci 'dod ces dris pas zas skom 'dod zer nas/rgyal pos blon po la 'di rnams la zas skom byin cig ces byas pa dang / zas shino tu zhim pa sos pa sno tshogs pa drangs pa na/ dper na stag gzig la rtsa bsngas pa ltar zar ma 'dad da/ /'o na khyod ci 'dod dris pa dang / mi sha shin tu dron mo dang / /mi yi khrag ni dron mo dag /nod sbyin dag gi bza' btung lags/ /rtul zhugasam nyamasapad ma'i spyan/ /ces zer nas rang rang gis gzugs 'jigs pa rnams bstan no/ /de nas rgyal pos de rnams mi ma yin yin par shes nas da rang gi sha khrag sbyin par bza' ba las blon po rnams kyis zhus pa/ kye rgyal po chen po ma nas khyed nyid kyi bka' dang 'gal ba byas pa ni ma dran/ byas pa mchis par gyur na bzod par mdzod la bdag cag gis 'di rnams la sha khrag sbyin gyis/ bdag cag blo brtse ba'i 'bangs rnams log par mi btang bar zhu/ zhes gsol bas/rgyal po na re/ 'di rnams khyed rnams la mi slong nga la slong zhing nga la med na khyed kyis sbyin par bya ba yin pa la/ bdag la yod pas bdag gis sbyin no zer nas/ sman pa bos te rtsa btar nas khrag tsan dan dmar po'i khu ba lta bu la gnod sbyin rnams rang rang gi snyim pa bzed nas 'thung du bcug /ral gri ut+pa —143—

mkhyen brtse'i 'od snang las/ spyod 'jug gi gtam rgyud/la mthing kha'i mdog lta bus brla dang dpung pa las sha bcad nas kyang de la byin nas tshim par byas so/ /de nasade dag shin tu dga' nas/ bde ba brnyes par gyur pa na/ /rgyal po'i dpal yang bor nasani/ /'di lta bu yi spyod pa yis/ /med du byung ba'i gnasaci zhig /thamasacad pa yi bdag po'am/ /nor gyis phyug pa'am dbang po'am/ /tshangasapa'am rnam par grol ba'am/ /de dag dka' thub 'di yis bzhed lags sam/ /'di lta bu yi rtsol phod pas/ /bached pa'i don ni mi ring ste/ /gal te bdag cag thos rung na/ /bdag cag la ni bka' bstsal rigs/ /zhes drin lan ci 'dod ces dris pa dang / rgyal pos smras pa/ rnyed par dka' la 'jig par sla ba dang / /chog pa'i bde med rab tu zhi med pa'i/ /srid pa'i longasaspyod bde ba'ang nga mi 'dod/ /lha dbang dpal yang 'dod pa ma yin na/ /de las gzhan pa smos kyang ci zhig dgos/ /bdag gi sdug bsngal zad pa tsam gyis ni/ /nga yi yid ni mgu bar 'gyur ma yin/ /sdug bsngal mi bzad nad kyisanyen pa yi/ /lusacan mgon med 'di rnams ngas bltas pas/ /bsod rnams 'di yis thams cad gzigs pa yi/ /go 'phang thob nas skyon gyi dgra btul te/ /rga nad 'chi ba'i rba rlabs zhabrug pa yi/ /srid pa'i mtsho lasa'agro ba 'don par 'dod/ khesagasungasapas/ de dag rab tu dga' nas/ lus kyi ba spu langs pas rgyal po la phyag byas te/khyod kyi brtson pa'i spyod pa 'di lta bus myur du byang chub thob par nges pas/de'i tshe bdag cag rnams kyang thugs la thogs/ zhes zhus nas/ sngar yon tan du ma rig nas 'o brgyal bar byas pa ni bzod par gsol/ khyed kyi mdzad —144—

byang chung sems dpa'i spyod pa la 'jug pa'i gtam rgyud bzhugs/pa 'di kun ni/ /'jig rten phan pa'i phyir lagasakyang / /bdag cag rang la phan 'tshal bas/ /de tshe bdag cag dgongs su gsol/ /ma 'tshal bsan bdag cag gis/ /bdag gi don yang ma mthong bas/ /de ltar khyod ni 'o brgyal bas/ /de yang bzod par mdzad du gsol/ khyed kyi dka' yang bdag canal/ /rjesasubazuraba'i rgyuragyurapa/ blunaposabadagalabagyibabazhin/— /'dzem pa med par bstsal bar rigs/ /zhes smras pa dang / rgyal po na re/chos kyi lam la 'di ltar grogs gyur pas/ /byang chub thob nas brjed par ga la 'gyur/ /rnam par dag pa'i chos kyi bdud rtsi las/ khyed cag rnams la thog mar bsgo bar bya/ /nga ni de la dga' bar shesabyasanas/ /srog gcod khyed kyi dug bzhin spang bar byos/ /g.yin nor chung ma dag la'ang chags pa dang / /rdzun du smra dang chang gi sdig pa spongs/ /zhesade dag la dge bsnyen gyi sdom pa phog pas/ de bzhin bgyi'o zhes khas blangs nas rgyal po la bskor ba byas phyag btsal nas de nyid du mi snang bar gyur to/ /de nas phyis rgyal po de ni bcom ldan 'das su gyur/ gnod sbyin sde lnga ni lnga sde bzang por gyur te/ grong khyer chen po wā ra ṇa sīr drang srong lhung ba ri dwags rgyu pa'i tshal du bden pa bzhi'i chos kyi 'khor lo bskor nas de rnams kyi don mdzad de 'bras bu gzhan la byin pa'o/ /thams cad bor te 'chi dgos par/ /zhes pa/ yul mi rtag pa la rtag par bzung nas/ sdig pa sna tshogs pa la sogs pa ci la yang ma chen par bya'o//de yang sngon rgya gar gyi yul dbus na khyim bdag go'u ta ma zhes bya ba la/ bu —145—

mkhyen brtse'i 'od snang las/ spyod 'jug gi gtam rgyud/gzhon nu ne tso zhes bya ba nor rnam thos kyi bu dang mnyam pa zhig yod pa la/khyim bdag gzhon nu des mi mang pos sbrang tshang 'don pa'i drung du phyin pas/sbrang rtsi mi mang posa'athu bu rnamasabasad/ ma rnamasal la bsad la la bros pa mthong bas/ de'i bsam par khyim bdag gi mi dang nor la sogasapa rnams bung tshang zhig pa dang 'dra'o snyam nas skyo ba skyes te/ so nam gyi bya ba yang bzhaganor rdzas kyang gzhan la byin pas pha na re/ bu so nam yang ma chag par gyis/nor rdzas kyang chud ma gzan byas pas/ bu na re khyim bdag chen po bsags pa la don ci yod/ thams cad bung tshang zhig pa dang 'dra'o/ /phasasmras pa de dang cis te 'dra/ bus smras pa/ 'o skol la dgra chen po thub pa med pa zhig 'ong ngo / /phas smras pa dgra de 'ong ba'i bya byung ngam ji ltar yin/ bus smras pa skra dkar gnyer ma la sogs pa bya yin te yin snyam pa med/ /lus ni zil pa dang 'dra ste 'bo la khad/ dbugs ni na bun dang 'dra te yal du nye/ sems ni glog dang 'dra ste skad cig ma/ longs spyod sgyu ma dang 'dra ste snang la med/ mdor na thams cad bung tshang zhig pa 'dra/ phasasmras pa/ dgra de thul ba'i thabs su la yod/ bus smras pa/ dgra de thul ba'i thabs sangs rgyasamakhas zer spyan sngar phyin nas zhus pas/ bka' bstsal pa/ 'khor ba mi rtag bung tshang zhig pa 'dra//rtag par 'dzin pa thams cad phung bar 'gyur/ /de la mi rtag skyo ba skyes pa ni//sdug bsngal las grol mya ngan 'da' bar 'gyur/ /zhes gsungasapas/ khyim bdag pha bu'i rdzas nor thams cad sbyin gtong byas te chos byas so/ /nyin mtshan sdod pa yong med par/ /zhesapa/ tshe yun thung zhing mi rtag pas—146—

byang chung sems dpa'i spyod pa la 'jug pa'i gtam rgyud bzhugs/te/ dper na mi zhig g.yang sa chen po'i 'og na mtsho chen po zhig tu lhung ste/ rtsa 'jag phung zhig la 'jus pa dang / gter nas sbrang rtsi cung zad khar 'dzag pa la chags so/ /de la byi ba dkar nag gnyis kyis re mos rtswabacad pas zad pa dang mi de lhung ste rgya mtshor 'gro ba las/ yar 'dzag pa'i 'bad rtsol yang mi byed/ byi ba yang mi bsrungs na mi de shin tu blun no/ /de bzhin du 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho dang ngan song gi g.yang sa dang da ltar dal 'byor thob pas 'dod pa'i ro la chags pa dang / nyin mtshan gnyis kyis tshe zad nas 'chi bar nges kyang chos mi spyod pa rnams dang ci rigs su sbyar ro/ /de bzhin yang dag skyabs su mchi'o/ /zhes pas skyabs su 'gro ba snying thag pa nas byas na phan yon shin tu che ste/ sum cu rtsa gsum gyi gnas nas lha'i bu zhig tshe zad de/ me tog gi thod rnying pa dang lus la rngul byung / gos la dri ma chags/ rang gi stan la sdod snying mi 'dod/ lha'i bu dang bu mo'i rtse grogs kyis spangs pa ste/ 'chi ltas lnga byung nas zhag bdun na 'chi bar 'dug pas mngon shes kyis bltas pas/ 'dzam bu'i gling du rgyal po'i khab tu phag phrug tu skye bar shes te sdug bsngal drag pos yid gdung ste/ kyi hud sum cu rtsa gsum gyi gnas zhes pa la sogs pa/ smre sngags 'don cing nya bye tshan la 'dre ba ltar gnas pa/ lha'i dbang po brgya byin gyis mthong ste/ khyod ci nyes dris pas/des gong ltar rgyas par bsnyad pas/ lha'i dbang pos de skyabs su 'dzin tu bcug ste de tshe 'phos pa dang / dga' ldan gyi gnas su lha'i bur skyes so/ /brgya byin gyis der skyes pa ma shesate/ gong ma la shes pa mi 'jug pas so/ /—147—
